sql_infos.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, d.a2 AS district_name, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction, d.a10 AS avg_salary FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= (SELECT MIN(trans.date) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id IN (SELECT trans.account_id FROM trans WHERE trans.amount > 610065)) AND d.a16 > (SELECT AVG(district.a16) FROM district WHERE district.a11 > 854) AND t.amount > 629870 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a10 HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 127908.54 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.duration > 59 AND l.payments < 5268.76 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM disp d WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' ) GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 2 ORDER BY loan_count DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, d.a11 AS district_unemployment_rate FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 369755 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a11 UNION ALL SELECT a.account_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, d.a11 AS district_unemployment_rate FROM account a JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE o.amount > 71466.33 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a11 ORDER BY district_unemployment_rate DESC, account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 232633 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 2860218 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 7467 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 425117;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 11441 ) AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 303571 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 141564) AS high_value_transactions FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dist.a4 > 8771 AND l.duration >= 51 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 2436 AND l.duration > 28 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 4 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 3668 AND t.balance < 8301 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) <= 547 ORDER BY account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 34 AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 307412) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) <= 2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 271716 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 209757 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 20 AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 119222) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) <= 3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 49 AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 454461) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) <= 4 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, cl.client_id, d.type AS disp_type, c.type AS card_type, c.issued AS card_issued, lo.loan_id, lo.amount AS loan_amount, lo.duration AS loan_duration, lo.payments AS loan_payments, lo.status AS loan_status, o.order_id, o.account_to, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol AS order_symbol, t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance AS trans_balance, t.k_symbol AS trans_symbol, t.operation AS trans_operation, ds.a2 AS district_name, ds.a3 AS district_region, ds.a4 AS district_inhabitants, ds.a5 AS district_municipality_499, ds.a6 AS district_municipality_500_1999, ds.a7 AS district_municipality_2000_9999, ds.a8 AS district_municipality_10000, ds.a9 AS district_cities, ds.a10 AS district_urban_ratio, ds.a11 AS district_avg_salary, ds.a12 AS district_unemployment_rate_95, ds.a13 AS district_unemployment_rate_96, ds.a14 AS district_entrepreneurs, ds.a15 AS district_crimes_95, ds.a16 AS district_crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS num_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, AVG(t.balance) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS avg_district_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE lo.amount > 10209 AND o.amount > 58554.93 AND t.amount > 89754 AND ds.a11 > 8263 AND cl.birth_date >= '1930-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, cl.client_id, d.type, c.type, c.issued, lo.loan_id, lo.amount, lo.duration, lo.payments, lo.status, o.order_id, o.account_to, o.amount, o.k_symbol, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.operation, ds.a2, ds.a3, ds.a4, ds.a5, ds.a6, ds.a7, ds.a8, ds.a9, ds.a10, ds.a11, ds.a12, ds.a13, ds.a14, ds.a15, ds.a16 HAVING SUM(lo.amount) > 384698 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 29 AND AVG(t.balance) > 616024 ORDER BY loan_amount_rank, total_withdrawal DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.type AS disposition_type, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE a.district_id = 6 AND (c.issued >= '1993-01-01' OR c.issued IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.type HAVING COUNT(c.card_id) <= 1 ORDER BY card_count DESC, a.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, t.date, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE t.amount > 69406 AND l.amount > 75866 AND di.a4 > 5494 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, t.date, t.amount, t.balance, t.account HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 994937 ORDER BY a.account_id, t.date;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.account_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '970101' ) AND l.amount > 653460 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 547935) AS high_amount_trans_count FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration >= 24 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, 'account' AS source_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id >= 64 AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '930101') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id UNION ALL SELECT c.client_id, cl.district_id, 'client' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS record_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM client c JOIN district cl ON c.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dc ON c.client_id = dc.client_id JOIN trans t ON dc.account_id = t.account_id WHERE c.district_id >= 8 AND t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY c.client_id, cl.district_id ORDER BY district_id, source_type;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_cnt, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_cnt, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_id = a.account_id AND o2.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_order_cnt, (SELECT MAX(CAST(t2.date AS INTEGER)) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU') AS last_card_withdrawal_date FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 786115 AND l.duration >= 24 AND t.amount > 16044 AND CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 947239 AND 978371 AND d.a10 > 989.18 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 123267 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 1 AND AVG(t.balance) < 958831 AND SUM(o.amount) > 581757.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 377 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 12491 AND t.amount < 2973 AND l.status = 'A' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND d.a16 > 1031 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 3 AND SUM(l.amount) < 70456 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(o1.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS withdrawal_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.amount > 169729 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount < 50968.21 AND d.a10 > 4351.99 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 9725644 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 733751 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id UNION ALL SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 465392 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id ORDER BY account_id, district_id;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND l.amount > 297635.74 AND t.amount < 2994.98 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 4 AND SUM(l.amount) > 204337.48 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 50995 AND t.amount > 3023 GROUP BY a.account_id, l.loan_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 43359 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 34266 AND l.duration >= 38 GROUP BY a.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 7 ORDER BY a.district_id, amount_rank;

SELECT a.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.account_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 565239 AND l.duration > 37 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 10 ORDER BY a.district_id, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a1.account_id AS account_id_1, a2.account_id AS account_id_2, a1.district_id AS district_id_1, a2.district_id AS district_id_2, d1.a10 AS district_unemploy_rate_1, d2.a10 AS district_unemploy_rate_2, d1.a12 AS district_avg_salary_1, d2.a12 AS district_avg_salary_2, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.card_id) AS cards_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.card_id) AS cards_count_2, SUM(l1.amount) AS total_loan_amount_1, SUM(l2.amount) AS total_loan_amount_2, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_trans_amount_1, AVG(t2.amount) AS avg_trans_amount_2, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_1, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_2, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS orders_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS orders_count_2, MAX(l1.duration) AS max_loan_duration_1, MAX(l2.duration) AS max_loan_duration_2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a1.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l1.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_in_district_1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a2.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l2.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_in_district_2 FROM account a1 JOIN account a2 ON a1.district_id = a2.district_id AND a1.account_id < a2.account_id JOIN district d1 ON a1.district_id = d1.district_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id AND dp1.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id AND dp2.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN client cl1 ON dp1.client_id = cl1.client_id LEFT JOIN client cl2 ON dp2.client_id = cl2.client_id LEFT JOIN card c1 ON dp1.disp_id = c1.disp_id LEFT JOIN card c2 ON dp2.disp_id = c2.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id WHERE d1.a10 > 6.21 AND d2.a10 > 4.28 AND l1.amount > 539185 AND l2.amount > 847312 AND t1.amount > 41197 AND t2.amount > 67359 AND (cl1.birth_date IS NULL OR cl1.birth_date < '1900-01-01') AND (cl2.birth_date IS NULL OR cl2.birth_date < '1900-01-01') GROUP BY a1.account_id, a2.account_id, a1.district_id, a2.district_id, d1.a10, d2.a10, d1.a12, d2.a12 HAVING SUM(l1.amount) > 236937 AND SUM(l2.amount) > 437649 AND AVG(t1.amount) > 16101 AND AVG(t2.amount) > 42415 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c1.card_id) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c2.card_id) > 5 ORDER BY total_loan_amount_1 DESC, total_loan_amount_2 DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS loan_amount_sum, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD'))) AS latest_loan_year, SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'credit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS credit_cards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sipo_order_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a15 > 9897 AND d.a10 < 347.73 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.duration > 24 AND l.amount IN (SELECT l2.amount FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.duration > 57 AND l2.status = 'A' GROUP BY l2.amount HAVING COUNT(l2.loan_id) > 42) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 7646364 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) BETWEEN 67 AND 99 ORDER BY total_balance DESC, district_loan_rank;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 882187 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 303736.73 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 47623.75) AS high_value_orders_per_account, (SELECT AVG(l2.payments) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.duration > 56) AS avg_payment_for_long_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' WHERE d.a4 > 23318 AND d.a10 < 2.46 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 9 AND SUM(t.amount) < 998408 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients ASC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a4 AS num_inhabitants, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a4 > 222849) AS avg_amount_by_population_segment FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration >= 38 AND l.amount > 353594 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a4, l.amount HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 122021 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND d.a3 LIKE 'central' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 15828 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) < 38 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' ) AND d.a4 >= 1177 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 58 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 64956 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 171283 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.client_id, c.birth_date, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 84366 AND l.duration >= 26 AND c.birth_date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.birth_date, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 111301.33 ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(CAST(l.amount AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(l.duration, 0)) AS avg_monthly_loan_payment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 874249 AND l.duration >= 38 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 883605 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS loans_in_district, SUM(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS total_loan_amount_in_district FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 314303 AND l.duration > 19 UNION ALL SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, NULL AS duration, NULL AS payments, t.type AS status, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS trans_in_district, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS total_trans_amount_in_district FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.amount > 50971 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ORDER BY district_id, loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 48834) AS high_value_trans_count, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date::date >= '1998-01-01'::date) AS avg_recent_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 281474 AND l.duration >= 56 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 3577) AS high_value_trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount >= 200052 AND a.district_id = 71 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 242004 ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l1.loan_id AS loan_id_1, l2.loan_id AS loan_id_2, d.district_id, a1.date AS account_creation_date_1, a2.date AS account_creation_date_2, SUM(t1.amount) AS total_trans_amount_1, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_trans_amount_2, AVG(t1.balance) AS avg_balance_1, AVG(t2.balance) AS avg_balance_2, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS order_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS order_count_2, MAX(l1.amount) AS max_loan_amount_1, MAX(l2.amount) AS max_loan_amount_2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY (SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount)) DESC) AS district_trans_rank FROM loan l1 INNER JOIN loan l2 ON l1.account_id < l2.account_id AND l1.duration = l2.duration INNER JOIN account a1 ON l1.account_id = a1.account_id INNER JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id INNER JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id INNER JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id INNER JOIN district d ON c1.district_id = d.district_id AND c2.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id WHERE l1.amount > 47648 AND l2.amount > 426381 AND l1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l2.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l1.loan_id, l2.loan_id, d.district_id, a1.date, a2.date HAVING SUM(t1.amount) > 128504 AND SUM(t2.amount) > 682809 ORDER BY (SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount)) DESC LIMIT 629;

SELECT s.client_id, s.avg_loan_amount, s.total_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = s.account_id AND l.amount > 299806) AS high_loan_count FROM ( SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE c.district_id = 2 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY c.client_id, a.account_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 350859 AND COUNT(t.trans_id) > 626 ) s WHERE s.avg_loan_amount < 91240 ORDER BY s.total_transactions DESC;

SELECT s.client_id, s.avg_loan_amount, s.total_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = s.account_id AND l.amount > 64571) AS high_loan_count FROM ( SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE c.district_id = 15 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY c.client_id, a.account_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 213571 AND COUNT(t.trans_id) > 1006 ) s WHERE s.avg_loan_amount < 164133 ORDER BY s.total_transactions DESC;

SELECT s.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.frequency, ', ') AS account_frequencies FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district s ON a.district_id = s.district_id WHERE l.amount > 91007 AND s.a3 LIKE 'Prague%' GROUP BY s.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 30509 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.trans_id) AS trans_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS trans_count_2, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount_1, AVG(t2.amount) AS avg_amount_2 FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.date <= '1993-01-01' WHERE t1.amount > 77361 AND t2.amount < 78880 GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.trans_id) > 35 ORDER BY trans_count_1 DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, t1.k_symbol, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 445301 AND t2.amount > 849696 GROUP BY t1.account_id, t1.k_symbol HAVING COUNT(*) > 17 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, t1.type, t2.operation, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(t1.amount) AS total_amount_t1, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_amount_t2 FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.date < t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 78727 AND t2.amount > 342953 GROUP BY t1.account_id, t1.type, t2.operation HAVING COUNT(*) > 22 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(aa.total_amount) AS district_total_amount, AVG(aa.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 1919 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(aa.total_amount) > 385618.14 ORDER BY district_total_amount DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(aa.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 1196 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 43 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(aa.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 581 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 37 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

WITH account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.trans_id END) AS credit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE t.amount > 71298 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 17245.03 AND l.amount > 130979 AND dist.a4 > 8199 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_summary AS ( SELECT am.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS active_accounts, SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) AS district_total_transactions, SUM(am.total_order_amount) AS district_total_orders, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transaction_count, SUM(am.order_count) AS district_order_count, SUM(am.loan_count) AS district_loan_count FROM account_metrics am GROUP BY am.district_id HAVING SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) > 1259945.88 AND SUM(am.total_loan_amount) > 17173334.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) >= 259 ) SELECT ds.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, ds.active_accounts, ds.district_total_transactions, ds.district_total_orders, ds.district_total_loans, ds.district_avg_balance, ds.district_transaction_count, ds.district_order_count, ds.district_loan_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.district_total_transactions DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.district_total_loans DESC) AS loan_rank, (ds.district_total_transactions / NULLIF(ds.district_total_loans, 0)) AS transaction_to_loan_ratio FROM district_summary ds JOIN district d ON ds.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 3141 AND d.a5 > 5696 ORDER BY ds.district_total_transactions DESC, ds.district_total_loans DESC LIMIT 58;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_crime_rate, d.a12 AS district_unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS district_entrepreneurs_rate FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN card c ON dsp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT account_id, district_id, transaction_count, total_transaction_amount, avg_balance, loan_count, total_loan_amount, order_count, total_order_amount, card_count, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC ) AS district_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_population > 135317 ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC ) AS population_percentile, LAG(total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC ) AS prev_account_transaction_amount, LEAD(avg_balance, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_unemployment_rate > 6.45 ORDER BY avg_balance DESC ) AS next_account_avg_balance FROM account_stats WHERE total_loan_amount > 47909 AND transaction_count >= 938 ) SELECT district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(*) AS high_value_accounts, AVG(total_transaction_amount) AS avg_high_value_transactions, SUM(total_loan_amount) AS total_high_value_loans, AVG(total_order_amount) AS avg_high_value_orders, MAX(transaction_count) AS max_transactions, MIN(avg_balance) AS min_avg_balance, CORR(total_transaction_amount, total_loan_amount) AS trans_loan_correlation, STDDEV(total_order_amount) AS order_amount_stddev FROM ranked_accounts WHERE district_rank <= 46 AND population_percentile >= 0.11 GROUP BY district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 14 AND AVG(total_transaction_amount) > 5058528 AND SUM(total_loan_amount) >= 72474 ORDER BY total_high_value_loans DESC, avg_high_value_transactions DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id) as account_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 29 AND 59 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(t.trans_id) as trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) as unique_symbols, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) as latest_trans_date FROM client_accounts ca JOIN account a ON ca.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 12938 OR t.amount IS NULL GROUP BY ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT am.client_id, am.district_id, am.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 'GOOD' WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'BAD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as loan_quality, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.client_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM account_metrics am JOIN loan l ON am.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount >= 142796 AND l.duration > 34 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as population, d.a10 as crime_rate, d.a12 as unemployment, d.a13 as entrepreneurs, d.a15 as urban_ratio, d.a16 as avg_salary, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 0.12 THEN 'HIGH_CRIME' WHEN d.a10 > 0.04 THEN 'MEDIUM_CRIME' ELSE 'LOW_CRIME' END as crime_category FROM district d ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount FROM loan_analysis la JOIN order1 o ON la.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount BETWEEN 1714.91 AND 71969.82 GROUP BY la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.account_id, COUNT(c.card_id) as card_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 END) as gold_cards, MAX(CAST(c.issued AS INTEGER)) as latest_card_issue FROM order_analysis oa JOIN disp d ON oa.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id GROUP BY oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.account_id ), final_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.unemployment, ds.entrepreneurs, ds.urban_ratio, ds.avg_salary, ds.crime_category, am.trans_count, am.total_credits, am.total_withdrawals, am.avg_balance, am.unique_symbols, am.latest_trans_date, la.loan_amount, la.duration as loan_duration, la.payments as monthly_payment, la.loan_quality, la.loan_rank, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.unique_banks, oa.avg_order_amount, ca.card_count, ca.gold_cards, ca.latest_card_issue, (am.total_credits - am.total_withdrawals) as net_flow, (oa.total_order_amount / NULLIF(am.avg_balance, 0)) as order_to_balance_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY oa.total_order_amount DESC) as spending_rank FROM card_analysis ca JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN account_metrics am ON ca.account_id = am.account_id JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id AND ca.client_id = la.client_id JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id AND ca.client_id = oa.client_id WHERE am.trans_count > 133 AND oa.order_count >= 35 AND ca.card_count > 1 ) SELECT crime_category, loan_quality, COUNT(*) as client_count, AVG(loan_amount) as avg_loan_amount, AVG(total_order_amount) as avg_spending, AVG(avg_balance) as avg_account_balance, SUM(net_flow) as total_net_flow, AVG(order_to_balance_ratio) as avg_order_ratio, CORR(loan_amount, total_order_amount) as loan_spending_correlation, CORR(avg_salary, avg_balance) as salary_balance_correlation FROM final_metrics WHERE spending_rank <= 5121 GROUP BY crime_category, loan_quality HAVING AVG(loan_amount) > 209655 AND COUNT(*) >= 14 ORDER BY client_count DESC, avg_spending DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 327378 AND d.a4 > 2549 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 8 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_trans_amount, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount, AVG(di.a10) AS avg_district_unemploy_rate_95, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, MAX(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS latest_trans_date, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) DESC) AS order_amount_percentile FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' WHERE CAST(a.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a4 > 2876 AND (CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) > 44063 AND COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) > 521404 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT AVG(trans.amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'CREDIT') AS avg_credit_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 572968 AND l.duration >= 56 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, l.status, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount >= 397261 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a.account_id, d.district_id, l.status), (d.district_id, l.status), (l.status), ()) ORDER BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.status;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 533135 AND o.amount > 228688.71 AND t.amount > 83795 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 27 AND SUM(l.amount) <= 3058084 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 180242 AND l.duration >= 47 AND l.status = 'A' GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING AVG(l.amount) < 85065 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 9261 AND l.duration >= 12 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 5 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 96907.84 AND l.amount >= 144544 AND d.a4 >= 3685 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 35 AND SUM(l.amount) >= 3003296 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 197 AND AVG(t.amount) >= 7187 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 62 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 512088 AND t.amount > 419311 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 11 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_transactions, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS total_credit_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 7835 AND l.amount > 116956 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS unique_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS unique_transactions FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 4019 AND t.amount > 357859 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY unique_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS unique_clients, SUM(lo.amount) AS total_loans, AVG(lo.payments) AS avg_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id AND lo.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.date >= (SELECT MIN(t2.date) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.amount > 23734) WHERE d.a4 > 29497 AND (c.birth_date < '1900-01-01' OR c.gender = 'M') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 7 AND SUM(lo.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 850778 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.balance > ( SELECT AVG(balance) * 0.9 FROM trans WHERE account_id = t.account_id ) ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 40 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 328358 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.date::date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 91828 AND l.date::date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.date, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 54217 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS num_inhabitants, d.a5 AS num_municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 AS num_municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 AS num_municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 AS num_municipalities_gt_10000, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_loan_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS avg_active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp disp_c ON c.client_id = disp_c.client_id JOIN account a ON disp_c.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp_c.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.date IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1995 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 11 AND 1)) AND (t.date IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1994 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) = 1)) AND (a.date IS NULL OR (TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('930101', 'YYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD') <= TO_DATE('930101', 'YYMMDD'))) AND d.a4 > 93998 AND d.a10 > 0.68 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 385 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) > 257157 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 8781 ORDER BY total_active_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC LIMIT 23;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_transactions, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS total_credit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT') AS debit_transactions, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT') AS total_debit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'classic') AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'junior') AS junior_cards, MAX(CAST(l.duration AS NUMERIC)) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(CAST(l.duration AS NUMERIC)) AS min_loan_duration, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(l.duration AS NUMERIC)) AS median_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, (SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') - SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT')) AS net_transaction_flow FROM district d JOIN client cl ON d.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE d.a2 LIKE 'A' AND d.a3 LIKE 'A' AND l.amount > 856550 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 96916.21 AND (l.status LIKE 'A' OR l.status IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 330 AND SUM(l.amount) > 4941826 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 1756 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.date >= '1997-01-01' AND l.amount > 91961.76 AND di.a11 > 1995.61 AND l.status = 'A' GROUP BY l.account_id, a.frequency HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 418184.81 AND AVG(l.duration) < 27.55 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT l.account_id, a.frequency, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_trans, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, SUM(lo.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id WHERE l.amount > 618107 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 135982.66 GROUP BY l.account_id, a.frequency, d.a2, t.date HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 201463 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) > 6 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS trans_count_per_account, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS total_amount_per_account FROM trans t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = t.account_id AND l.amount > 180983 ) AND t.amount > 71255 GROUP BY t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.account_id ORDER BY total_amount_per_account DESC, trans_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_crime_rate, d.a12 AS district_unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS district_entrepreneurs_rate FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN card c ON dsp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT account_id, district_id, transaction_count, total_transaction_amount, avg_balance, loan_count, total_loan_amount, order_count, total_order_amount, card_count, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC ) AS district_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_population > 93227 ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC ) AS population_percentile, LAG(total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC ) AS prev_account_transaction_amount, LEAD(avg_balance, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_unemployment_rate > 2.69 ORDER BY avg_balance DESC ) AS next_account_avg_balance FROM account_stats WHERE total_loan_amount > 235579 AND transaction_count >= 956 ) SELECT district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(*) AS high_value_accounts, AVG(total_transaction_amount) AS avg_high_value_transactions, SUM(total_loan_amount) AS total_high_value_loans, AVG(total_order_amount) AS avg_high_value_orders, MAX(transaction_count) AS max_transactions, MIN(avg_balance) AS min_avg_balance, CORR(total_transaction_amount, total_loan_amount) AS trans_loan_correlation, STDDEV(total_order_amount) AS order_amount_stddev FROM ranked_accounts WHERE district_rank <= 46 AND population_percentile >= 0.8 GROUP BY district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 9 AND AVG(total_transaction_amount) > 948574 AND SUM(total_loan_amount) >= 3811991 ORDER BY total_high_value_loans DESC, avg_high_value_transactions DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id) as account_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 55 AND 128 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(t.trans_id) as trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) as unique_symbols, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) as latest_trans_date FROM client_accounts ca JOIN account a ON ca.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 65761 OR t.amount IS NULL GROUP BY ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT am.client_id, am.district_id, am.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 'GOOD' WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'BAD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as loan_quality, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.client_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM account_metrics am JOIN loan l ON am.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount >= 449733 AND l.duration > 23 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as population, d.a10 as crime_rate, d.a12 as unemployment, d.a13 as entrepreneurs, d.a15 as urban_ratio, d.a16 as avg_salary, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 0.06 THEN 'HIGH_CRIME' WHEN d.a10 > 0.01 THEN 'MEDIUM_CRIME' ELSE 'LOW_CRIME' END as crime_category FROM district d ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount FROM loan_analysis la JOIN order1 o ON la.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount BETWEEN 4184.99 AND 78921.7 GROUP BY la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.account_id, COUNT(c.card_id) as card_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 END) as gold_cards, MAX(CAST(c.issued AS INTEGER)) as latest_card_issue FROM order_analysis oa JOIN disp d ON oa.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id =
