SELECT l.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.date >= '1997-01-01' AND l.amount > 78431.48 AND di.a11 > 252.39 AND l.status = 'A' GROUP BY l.account_id, a.frequency HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 409741.5 AND AVG(l.duration) < 49.1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT l.loan_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 42001 AND t.amount < 19081 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 84497 AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 675984 AND l.amount > 609731 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 1751232 INTERSECT SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.duration > 11 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 997 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 309150 AND d.a4 > 192321 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 417641 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC LIMIT 76;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_account FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '930101' AND t.date >= '930101' AND l.amount > 3588 AND l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = 21) GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.date HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 106633 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date AS loan_date, l.status, AVG(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_30day_trans_before_loan, COUNT(t.trans_id) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_30day_trans_before_loan FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 615570 AND l.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date::DATE >= (l.date::DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') AND t.date::DATE <= l.date::DATE GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status, t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, t.trans_id ORDER BY l.loan_id;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, t.trans_count, a.date AS account_open_date, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, AVG(l.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY l.duration) AS avg_loan_amount_by_duration FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 30654 AND date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY account_id ) t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 174509 AND l.duration = 25 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, t.trans_count, a.date, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(t.trans_count) > 9 ORDER BY loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, t.trans_count, a.date AS account_open_date, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, AVG(l.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY l.duration) AS avg_loan_amount_by_duration FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 49503 AND date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY account_id ) t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 16341 AND l.duration = 47 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, t.trans_count, a.date, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(t.trans_count) > 14 ORDER BY loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, a.district_id, d.a4, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 689134) AS high_trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.duration > 92 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, a.district_id, d.a4 HAVING l.amount > 865674 ORDER BY high_trans_count DESC;

SELECT l1.loan_id AS first_loan_id, l2.loan_id AS second_loan_id, l1.account_id, l1.amount AS first_amount, l2.amount AS second_amount, l1.duration AS first_duration, l2.duration AS second_duration, AVG(l1.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY l1.account_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_account, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY l1.account_id) AS loan_count_per_account FROM loan l1 JOIN loan l2 ON l1.account_id = l2.account_id AND l1.loan_id < l2.loan_id JOIN account a ON l1.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l1.amount > 387893 AND l2.amount > 433611 AND di.a4 > 7526 GROUP BY l1.loan_id, l2.loan_id, l1.account_id, l1.amount, l2.amount, l1.duration, l2.duration HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.gender) > 1 ORDER BY loan_count_per_account DESC, avg_loan_amount_per_account DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, SUM(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS three_day_moving_sum, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS three_day_moving_avg FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 711118 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 417971 GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date AS trans_date, t.amount, t.balance, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 721431 AND t.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01' ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date::DATE;

SELECT t1.account_id, t1.k_symbol, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 603663 AND t2.amount > 395245 GROUP BY t1.account_id, t1.k_symbol HAVING COUNT(*) > 94 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(aa.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 716 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(aa.total_amount) > 31545.06 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 122504 AND d.a10 < 0.98 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(TO_DATE(card.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_card_issue_date FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE TO_DATE(card.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.loan_count DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.order_count DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.avg_balance) AS balance_percentile, LAG(as2.total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS prev_account_transaction_amount, LEAD(as2.total_loan_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_loan_amount DESC) AS next_account_loan_amount, SUM(as2.total_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_total_transactions, AVG(as2.avg_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_avg_balance FROM account a JOIN account_stats as2 ON a.account_id = as2.account_id WHERE as2.transaction_count > 475 AND as2.loan_count >= 3 ) SELECT ra.account_id, ra.district_id, ra.frequency, ra.transaction_rank, ra.loan_rank, ra.order_rank, ra.balance_percentile, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.unemployment_rate, dm.entrepreneurs_rate, dm.client_count, dm.avg_client_age, cf.disposition_count, cf.card_count, cf.latest_card_issue_date, as2.transaction_count, as2.total_transaction_amount, as2.avg_balance, as2.loan_count, as2.total_loan_amount, as2.order_count, as2.total_order_amount, ra.prev_account_transaction_amount, ra.next_account_loan_amount, ra.district_total_transactions, ra.district_avg_balance, (as2.total_transaction_amount / NULLIF(ra.district_total_transactions, 0)) * 100 AS transaction_share_percent, (as2.avg_balance - ra.district_avg_balance) AS balance_deviation_from_district_avg FROM ranked_accounts ra JOIN district_metrics dm ON ra.district_id = dm.district_id JOIN account_stats as2 ON ra.account_id = as2.account_id LEFT JOIN client_financials cf ON ra.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE ra.transaction_rank <= 19 AND ra.balance_percentile > 0.64 AND dm.unemployment_rate < 7.17 AND dm.entrepreneurs_rate > 1.18 AND cf.card_count >= 3 ORDER BY ra.transaction_rank, ra.balance_percentile DESC, as2.total_transaction_amount DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary_ratio, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 6200 AND d.a5 < 16072 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) > 1.71 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.amount > 70721 AND l.amount > 324366 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 35412.09 GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary_ratio, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 6299479 AND cf.total_order_amount > 3935153.98 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary_ratio, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 99694 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 328 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_total_loans DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a10 > 0.27 AND d.a12 > 6279 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 345 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.amount > 14820 AND (l.amount > 289598 OR l.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 13594.89 OR o.amount IS NULL GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS financial_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY am.total_transaction_amount) AS median_transaction_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 7465737 AND cf.total_order_amount > 1976352.12 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 37 AND SUM(am.total_loan_amount) > 21821863 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_total_loans DESC LIMIT 17;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 1336 AND d.a5 < 16537 GROUP BY d.district_id ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE cd.issued >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 15495.0 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_unemployment_rate) AS unemployment_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 801279 AND cf.total_order_amount < 84736.93 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 100 AND AVG(am.avg_balance) < 601211 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 49;

WITH ranked_transactions AS ( SELECT t.account_id, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.date, t.k_symbol, t.type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.amount DESC) as trans_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) as trans_count, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) as total_trans_amount FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 252081 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 164539 AND l.duration >= 52 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a10 DESC) as district_wealth_rank FROM district d WHERE d.a10 > 18385.94 AND d.a4 >= 113455 ), client_account_join AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.birth_date, a.account_id, a.frequency, d.disp_id, d.type as disp_type, cd.card_id, cd.type as card_type, o.order_id, o.amount as order_amount, o.k_symbol as order_symbol FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE CAST(c.birth_date AS DATE) <= '1930-01-01' AND o.amount > 29459.5 ) SELECT caj.client_id, caj.account_id, caj.district_id, rt.trans_rank, rt.trans_count, rt.total_trans_amount, la.loan_amount, la.loan_rank, la.status as loan_status, ds.district_wealth_rank, ds.a10 as district_avg_salary, ds.a12 as SELECT d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE t.amount > 61157 AND l.amount > 76388 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 16024 GROUP BY d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 730006 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 23 AND AVG(l.amount) > 279361 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, amount_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 56309 AND l.duration >= 60 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_active_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a11 > 3017 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 13 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 159769 AND t.amount > 64016 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 85752.89 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 38 AND SUM(t.amount) > 377021 AND AVG(t.balance) < 85946 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_loan_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 586308 AND t.amount > 24398 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 43086.07 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 30 AND SUM(t.amount) > 90607 AND AVG(t.balance) < 29135 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_loan_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_volume, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 125115 AND l.duration > 22 AND t.amount > 86620 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 AND AVG(l.amount) < 401200 ORDER BY total_transaction_volume DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_volume, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 658387 AND l.duration > 52 AND t.amount > 13178 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 5 AND AVG(l.amount) < 20031 ORDER BY total_transaction_volume DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_transactions, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS total_credit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT') AS debit_transactions, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT') AS total_debit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'classic') AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'junior') AS junior_cards, MAX(CAST(l.duration AS NUMERIC)) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(CAST(l.duration AS NUMERIC)) AS min_loan_duration, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(l.duration AS NUMERIC)) AS median_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, (SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') - SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT')) AS net_transaction_flow FROM district d JOIN client cl ON d.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE d.a2 LIKE 'A' AND d.a3 LIKE 'A' AND l.amount > 327351 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 63285.1 AND (l.status LIKE 'A' OR l.status IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 964 AND SUM(l.amount) > 2049485 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 9252 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a3 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status IN ('A','B') AND (l.amount > 423104 OR l.duration < 60) AND NOT (l.payments < 4225.31 AND l.date < '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 991 AND SUM(l.amount) BETWEEN 671178 AND 914574 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, l.status, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, ROUND(AVG(a16) OVER (PARTITION BY l.status ORDER BY d.district_id), 2) AS moving_avg_crimes95, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 530776 AND l.duration >= 25 AND t.amount BETWEEN 31533 AND 583036 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, l.status, d.a16 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 71386 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 28 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_id;

SELECT d1.district_id AS d1_id, d2.district_id AS d2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.account_id) AS d1_account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id) AS d2_account_count, AVG(l1.amount) AS d1_avg_loan_amount, AVG(l2.amount) AS d2_avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS d1_withdrawal_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) AS d2_withdrawal_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS d1_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS d2_order_count, CORR(d1.a10, d2.a10) AS avg_salary_correlation, SUM(d1.a12) AS d1_unemployment_sum, SUM(d2.a12) AS d2_unemployment_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d1.a13) DESC) AS d1_crime_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d2.a13) DESC) AS d2_crime_rank FROM district d1 JOIN account a1 ON d1.district_id = a1.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN card cd1 ON dp1.disp_id = cd1.disp_id JOIN district d2 ON d1.district_id < d2.district_id JOIN account a2 ON d2.district_id = a2.district_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id JOIN card cd2 ON dp2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 292284 AND l2.amount > 464602 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount > 66340.77 AND o2.amount > 88791.88 AND c1.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND c2.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d1.a10 >= 10091.37 AND d2.a10 >= 19584.9 GROUP BY d1.district_id, d2.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.account_id) > 79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id) > 71 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) > 789342 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) > 344619 ORDER BY d1_account_count DESC, d2_account_count DESC;

SELECT di.district_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a10 AS crime_rate_95, di.a11 AS crime_rate_96, AVG(lo.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(tr.amount) AS total_transacted, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_holders_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ord.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(lo.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY di.district_id) AS district_total_loans, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(tr.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district di JOIN client cl ON di.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account ac ON dp.account_id = ac.account_id JOIN loan lo ON ac.account_id = lo.account_id JOIN trans tr ON ac.account_id = tr.account_id JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id JOIN order1 ord ON ac.account_id = ord.account_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan lo2 WHERE lo2.account_id = ac.account_id AND lo2.amount > 240320 AND lo2.status = 'A') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trans tr2 WHERE tr2.account_id = ac.account_id AND tr2.amount > 340258 AND tr2.date >= '1993-01-01') AND di.a10 > 71.21 AND di.a11 > 1 AND lo.amount > 141301 AND tr.amount > 180707 AND ord.amount > 4670.92 GROUP BY di.district_id, di.a2, di.a10, di.a11, lo.amount HAVING AVG(lo.amount) > 96071 AND SUM(tr.amount) > 1731310 ORDER BY total_transacted DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 82946 AND t.amount > 1778 GROUP BY l.account_id ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 533244 AND t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY l.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 527021 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 230969 AND t.amount < 11429 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 493273 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.status, l.date AS loan_date, a.district_id, d.a4 AS district_population, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 13015 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.status, l.date, a.district_id, d.a4 ORDER BY l.account_id, l.date;

SELECT t1.account_id, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(t2.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id < t2.trans_id WHERE t1.amount > 400132.25 AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(t2.trans_id) > 202.59 ORDER BY avg_amount DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id ), client_metrics AS ( SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_count, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.birth_date::date)) AS client_age FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.birth_date ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(aa.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(aa.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, AVG(cm.client_age) AS avg_client_age, SUM(ds.total_crimes) AS total_district_crimes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(aa.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id JOIN district_stats ds ON d.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN client_metrics cm ON c.client_id = cm.client_id WHERE aa.total_transaction_amount > 911113 AND aa.total_loan_amount < 60240 AND cm.client_age BETWEEN 27 AND 74 AND ds.avg_salary > 24187.38 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 338 AND AVG(aa.avg_balance) > 58893 ORDER BY transaction_rank;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 96254 AND d.a10 < 0.76 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(TO_DATE(card.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_card_issue_date FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE TO_DATE(card.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.loan_count DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.order_count DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.avg_balance) AS balance_percentile, LAG(as2.total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS prev_account_transaction_amount, LEAD(as2.total_loan_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_loan_amount DESC) AS next_account_loan_amount, SUM(as2.total_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_total_transactions, AVG(as2.avg_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_avg_balance FROM account a JOIN account_stats as2 ON a.account_id = as2.account_id WHERE as2.transaction_count > 671 AND as2.loan_count >= 2 ) SELECT ra.account_id, ra.district_id, ra.frequency, ra.transaction_rank, ra.loan_rank, ra.order_rank, ra.balance_percentile, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.unemployment_rate, dm.entrepreneurs_rate, dm.client_count, dm.avg_client_age, cf.disposition_count, cf.card_count, cf.latest_card_issue_date, as2.transaction_count, as2.total_transaction_amount, as2.avg_balance, as2.loan_count, as2.total_loan_amount, as2.order_count, as2.total_order_amount, ra.prev_account_transaction_amount, ra.next_account_loan_amount, ra.district_total_transactions, ra.district_avg_balance, (as2.total_transaction_amount / NULLIF(ra.district_total_transactions, 0)) * 100 AS transaction_share_percent, (as2.avg_balance - ra.district_avg_balance) AS balance_deviation_from_district_avg FROM ranked_accounts ra JOIN district_metrics dm ON ra.district_id = dm.district_id JOIN account_stats as2 ON ra.account_id = as2.account_id LEFT JOIN client_financials cf ON ra.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE ra.transaction_rank <= 2 AND ra.balance_percentile > 0.74 AND dm.unemployment_rate < 9.78 AND dm.entrepreneurs_rate > 2.52 AND cf.card_count >= 5 ORDER BY ra.transaction_rank, ra.balance_percentile DESC, as2.total_transaction_amount DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id) as account_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.birth_date >= '1950-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, a.date as account_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.amount > 604765 AND l.duration >= 42 ), transaction_summary AS ( SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) as trans_count, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) as unique_symbols, MAX(t.date) as last_trans_date FROM trans t WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 2474487 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as population, d.a10 as crime_rate, d.a12 as salary, d.a13 as unemployment, (d.a10 * d.a13) as risk_factor FROM district d WHERE d.a4 > 103461 AND d.a13 < 0.12 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 62713.97 GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_info AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, c.card_id, c.type as card_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.disp_id) as cards_per_disp FROM card c WHERE c.issued >= '1993-01-01' ) SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_count, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.salary, ds.unemployment, ds.risk_factor, la.loan_amount, la.duration as loan_duration, la.payments, la.status as loan_status, ts.trans_count, ts.total_amount as trans_total, ts.avg_balance, ts.unique_symbols, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.unique_banks, oa.avg_order_amount, ci.card_type, ci.cards_per_disp, a.frequency as account_frequency, (ts.total_amount / NULLIF(la.loan_amount, 0)) as trans_loan_ratio, (oa.total_order_amount / NULLIF(ts.total_amount, 0)) as order_trans_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_amount DESC) as trans_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.loan_amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM client_accounts ca JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id AND la.loan_rank = 1 JOIN transaction_summary ts ON ca.account_id = ts.account_id JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN card_info ci ON ca.disp_id = ci.disp_id JOIN account a ON ca.account_id = a.account_id WHERE ts.trans_count > 869 AND oa.order_count >= 48 ORDER BY ts.total_amount DESC, la.loan_amount DESC LIMIT 328;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, a.frequency, TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as account_open_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.date) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 761302 AND t.amount > 44301 AND d.a16 > 8202 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, l.date, l.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 159156 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND d.a3 LIKE 'north' GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 5 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_bad_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ca.type = 'gold' THEN ca.card_id END) AS gold_cards_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o1.amount) AS median_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o1.amount) DESC) AS order_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 764947 AND t.amount > 60409 AND o1.amount > 34231.37 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 591 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 23586 AND l.duration >= 43 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON SELECT a1.account_id AS account1_id, a2.account_id AS account2_id, d1.a2 AS district1_name, d2.a2 AS district2_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) AS loans_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) AS loans_count2, SUM(t1.amount) AS total_trans_amount1, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_trans_amount2, AVG(o1.amount) AS avg_order_amount1, AVG(o2.amount) AS avg_order_amount2, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.card_id) AS cards_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.card_id) AS cards_count2, MAX(l1.amount) AS max_loan_amount1, MAX(l2.amount) AS max_loan_amount2, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_trans1, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_trans2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t1.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t2.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank2, (SUM(t1.amount) - SUM(t2.amount)) AS trans_amount_diff FROM account a1 JOIN account a2 ON a1.district_id = a2.district_id AND a1.account_id <> a2.account_id JOIN district d1 ON a1.district_id = d1.district_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id LEFT JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id AND dp1.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id AND dp2.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN card c1 ON dp1.disp_id = c1.disp_id LEFT JOIN card c2 ON dp2.disp_id = c2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 608776 AND l2.amount > 203557 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.date >= '1994-01-01' AND o1.amount >= 86113.47 AND o2.amount >= 7764.89 GROUP BY a1.account_id, a2.account_id, d1.a2, d2.a2 HAVING SUM(t1.amount) > 4490472 AND SUM(t2.amount) > 1824618 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) >= 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) >= 4 ORDER BY trans_amount_diff DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 384859 AND t.amount > 17499 AND l.duration > 33 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1993 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 21 AND SUM(t.amount) > 7468061 AND AVG(l.amount) > 304310 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS total_orders FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.amount > 593488 AND t.amount > 14614 AND o1.amount > 297558.87 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4202058 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 7 AND AVG(t.amount) > 40401 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (d.a4 > 5416 OR d.a5 < 7291) AND (c.gender = 'M' OR dp.type = 'OWNER') AND NOT (l.status = 'A') AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 100 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) BETWEEN 865307 AND 825556 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a4 AS region_population, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_balance) FROM (SELECT t2.account_id, AVG(t2.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.date >= '970101' GROUP BY t2.account_id) sub WHERE sub.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id)) AS avg_account_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.status = 'A' AND l2.account_id IN (SELECT a3.account_id FROM account a3 WHERE a3.district_id = d.district_id AND a3.date <= '970101')) AS active_loans_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 196051 AND d.a10 < 16271.12 AND a.date <= '970101' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a4, d.a10 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 829514 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 14 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, DATE(l.date) AS loan_date, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY DATE(l.date) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount, COUNT(l.loan_id) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY DATE(l.date) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 3518 AND DATE(l.date) >= DATE('1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, l.date ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_date;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 528189 AND l.duration >= 60 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 57717 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 95694 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 996234 AND l.duration >= 19 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 27339 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 174048 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 963220 AND t.amount > 44870 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 47963.55 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 AND SUM(t.amount) > 528460 AND AVG(t.balance) < 51296 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_loan_rank;

SELECT d1.district_id AS d1_id, d2.district_id AS d2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.account_id) AS d1_account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id) AS d2_account_count, AVG(l1.amount) AS d1_avg_loan_amount, AVG(l2.amount) AS d2_avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS d1_withdrawal_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) AS d2_withdrawal_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS d1_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS d2_order_count, CORR(d1.a10, d2.a10) AS avg_salary_correlation, SUM(d1.a12) AS d1_unemployment_sum, SUM(d2.a12) AS d2_unemployment_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d1.a13) DESC) AS d1_crime_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d2.a13) DESC) AS d2_crime_rank FROM district d1 JOIN account a1 ON d1.district_id = a1.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN card cd1 ON dp1.disp_id = cd1.disp_id JOIN district d2 ON d1.district_id < d2.district_id JOIN account a2 ON d2.district_id = a2.district_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id JOIN card cd2 ON dp2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 141867 AND l2.amount > 157540 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount > 6340.9 AND o2.amount > 40591.68 AND c1.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND c2.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d1.a10 >= 6942.37 AND d2.a10 >= 14051.68 GROUP BY d1.district_id, d2.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.account_id) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id) > 10 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) > 225694 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) > 942957 ORDER BY d1_account_count DESC, d2_account_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, a.district_id, d.a4, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 760388) AS high_trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.duration > 67 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, a.district_id, d.a4 HAVING l.amount > 789572 ORDER BY high_trans_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 49447) AS high_value_trans_count, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date::date >= '1998-01-01'::date) AS avg_recent_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 425135 AND l.duration >= 42 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 66575) AS high_value_trans_count, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date::date >= '1998-01-01'::date) AS avg_recent_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 309641 AND l.duration >= 47 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC;

SELECT l1.loan_id AS loan_id_1, l2.loan_id AS loan_id_2, d.district_id, a1.date AS account_creation_date_1, a2.date AS account_creation_date_2, SUM(t1.amount) AS total_trans_amount_1, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_trans_amount_2, AVG(t1.balance) AS avg_balance_1, AVG(t2.balance) AS avg_balance_2, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS order_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS order_count_2, MAX(l1.amount) AS max_loan_amount_1, MAX(l2.amount) AS max_loan_amount_2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY (SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount)) DESC) AS district_trans_rank FROM loan l1 INNER JOIN loan l2 ON l1.account_id < l2.account_id AND l1.duration = l2.duration INNER JOIN account a1 ON l1.account_id = a1.account_id INNER JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id INNER JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id INNER JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id INNER JOIN district d ON c1.district_id = d.district_id AND c2.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id WHERE l1.amount > 282812 AND l2.amount > 35336 AND l1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l2.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l1.loan_id, l2.loan_id, d.district_id, a1.date, a2.date HAVING SUM(t1.amount) > 36960 AND SUM(t2.amount) > 551068 ORDER BY (SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount)) DESC LIMIT 447;

SELECT s.client_id, s.district_name, s.total_loan_amount, s.avg_transaction, s.max_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT s.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(s.order_amount_sum) AS total_order_amount FROM ( SELECT c.client_id, d.a3 AS district_name, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, crd.card_id, SUM(o.amount) AS order_amount_sum FROM client c JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card crd ON dp.disp_id = crd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 675558 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.status = 'A') GROUP BY c.client_id, d.a3, crd.card_id ) s WHERE s.total_loan_amount > 1670631 GROUP BY s.client_id, s.district_name, s.total_loan_amount, s.avg_transaction, s.max_loan_duration HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.card_id) > 2 AND SUM(s.order_amount_sum) < 43761.66 ORDER BY s.total_loan_amount DESC, s.client_id;

SELECT t1.account_id, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(t2.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id < t2.trans_id WHERE t1.amount > 182360.26 AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(t2.trans_id) > 629.47 ORDER BY avg_amount DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id) as account_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 94 AND 50 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(t.trans_id) as trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) as unique_symbols, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) as latest_trans_date FROM client_accounts ca JOIN account a ON ca.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 18958 OR t.amount IS NULL GROUP BY ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT am.client_id, am.district_id, am.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 'GOOD' WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'BAD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as loan_quality, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.client_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM account_metrics am JOIN loan l ON am.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount >= 78125 AND l.duration > 48 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as population, d.a10 as crime_rate, d.a12 as unemployment, d.a13 as entrepreneurs, d.a15 as urban_ratio, d.a16 as avg_salary, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 0.09 THEN 'HIGH_CRIME' WHEN d.a10 > 0.04 THEN 'MEDIUM_CRIME' ELSE 'LOW_CRIME' END as crime_category FROM district d ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount FROM loan_analysis la JOIN order1 o ON la.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount BETWEEN 5598.44 AND 45935.61 GROUP BY la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.account_id, COUNT(c.card_id) as card_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 END) as gold_cards, MAX(CAST(c.issued AS INTEGER)) as latest_card_issue FROM order_analysis oa JOIN disp d ON oa.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id GROUP BY oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.account_id ), final_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.unemployment, ds.entrepreneurs, ds.urban_ratio, ds.avg_salary, ds.crime_category, am.trans_count, am.total_credits, am.total_withdrawals, am.avg_balance, am.unique_symbols, am.latest_trans_date, la.loan_amount, la.duration as loan_duration, la.payments as monthly_payment, la.loan_quality, la.loan_rank, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.unique_banks, oa.avg_order_amount, ca.card_count, ca.gold_cards, ca.latest_card_issue, (am.total_credits - am.total_withdrawals) as net_flow, (oa.total_order_amount / NULLIF(am.avg_balance, 0)) as order_to_balance_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY oa.total_order_amount DESC) as spending_rank FROM card_analysis ca JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN account_metrics am ON ca.account_id = am.account_id JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id AND ca.client_id = la.client_id JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id AND ca.client_id = oa.client_id WHERE am.trans_count > 66 AND oa.order_count >= 11 AND ca.card_count > 4 ) SELECT crime_category, loan_quality, COUNT(*) as client_count, AVG(loan_amount) as avg_loan_amount, AVG(total_order_amount) as avg_spending, AVG(avg_balance) as avg_account_balance, SUM(net_flow) as total_net_flow, AVG(order_to_balance_ratio) as avg_order_ratio, CORR(loan_amount, total_order_amount) as loan_spending_correlation, CORR(avg_salary, avg_balance) as salary_balance_correlation FROM final_metrics WHERE spending_rank <= 7098 GROUP BY crime_category, loan_quality HAVING AVG(loan_amount) > 582748 AND COUNT(*) >= 27 ORDER BY client_count DESC, avg_spending DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 3030 AND d.a5 < 1255 GROUP BY d.district_id ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 35857 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 30433.32 OR ca.type = '{{p6}}' GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_account_transaction, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_total, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.card_count) AS total_cards, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_salary) AS salary_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 592714 AND cf.disposition_count >= 3 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 61715 AND SUM(cf.order_count) > 16 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, salary_percentile ASC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary_ratio, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 3324 AND d.a5 < 10342 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) > 1.9 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.amount > 47950 AND l.amount > 457495 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 21872.2 GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary_ratio, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 9183698 AND cf.total_order_amount > 1304660.67 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary_ratio, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 13599 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 445 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_total_loans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.duration > 113 AND t.amount > 910108 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 860083 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 37080 AND l.duration > 49 AND l.status = 'A' AND d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 4 AND SUM(l.amount) > 14804 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 316449 AND l.duration >= 49 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 61572 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 946 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_loan_date, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_trans_date FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 634851 AND CAST(l.date AS INTEGER) >= 936435 AND t.amount > 26463 AND CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) >= 931461 AND o.amount > 91176.41 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 467085 AND SUM(t.amount) > 3351619 AND SUM(o.amount) > 2310552.12 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_trans_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank_in_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 136876 AND t.amount > 38937 AND d.a4 > 1152 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 12 AND AVG(t.amount) < 286984 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 45150.39 ) AND l.duration >= 22 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 286375.53 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 38675 AND l.duration > 50 AND l.status = 'A' AND l.amount BETWEEN 435443 AND 449266 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 39 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS district_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 13173.89 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 266272.48 AND t.amount > 1569.97 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 7.74 AND SUM(l.amount) > 1223484.13 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1978 GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 734 ) AND l.amount > 572583 AND t.amount > 96487 AND o.amount > 35018.6 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 478 AND SUM(t.amount) > 4188305 AND SUM(o.amount) > 5024780.11 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 374365 AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE status = 'A' AND amount > 6947) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 68 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.client_id, c.gender, COALESCE(MAX(l.amount), 0) AS max_loan_amount, AVG(COALESCE(t.amount, 0)) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_insurance_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS loan_rank_in_district, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_volume FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 7894 AND (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.gender HAVING AVG(COALESCE(t.amount, 0)) > 926679.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) <= 2 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_rank_in_district;
