SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 141511 AND l.duration >= 49 AND d.a16 < 19916 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 29 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AS total_accounts_in_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 849393 AND l.duration >= 51 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 88 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d1.district_id, d1.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.account_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_count FROM district d1 JOIN account a ON d1.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district d2 ON dp.client_id = d2.a14 WHERE l.amount > 38806 AND l.duration > 16 GROUP BY d1.district_id, d1.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.account_id) > 13 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, d.a2 AS district_name, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction, d.a10 AS avg_salary FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= (SELECT MIN(trans.date) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id IN (SELECT trans.account_id FROM trans WHERE trans.amount > 166832)) AND d.a16 > (SELECT AVG(district.a16) FROM district WHERE district.a11 > 959) AND t.amount > 412633 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a10 HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 866776.55 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.duration > 8 AND t.amount > 12352 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 190765 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type LIKE '%' AND l.amount > 57364 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 9492.95 ORDER BY total_loans DESC, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 566 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.trans_id) AS trans_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS trans_count_2, SUM(t1.amount) - SUM(t2.amount) AS net_amount_diff FROM account a JOIN trans t1 ON a.account_id = t1.account JOIN trans t2 ON a.account_id = t2.account WHERE t1.date >= '970101' AND t2.date <= '970101' AND t1.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t2.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING (SUM(t1.amount) - SUM(t2.amount)) > 339898 ORDER BY net_amount_diff DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, 'loan' AS source_type, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.payments) AS min_loan_payment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(l.loan_id) DESC, SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.amount > 158413 AND l.duration >= 26 AND l.status = ANY (ARRAY['A', 'B']) AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND di.a10 > 4.51 AND di.a11 < 9755 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 2 AND SUM(l.amount) > 249712 UNION ALL SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, 'trans' AS source_type, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(t.trans_id) DESC, SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE t.amount > 16117 AND t.date >= '970101' AND t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'PRIJEM') AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND di.a10 > 1.08 AND di.a11 < 5379 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) >= 430 AND SUM(t.amount) > 590828 ORDER BY district_id, rank_in_district;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 16761.85) AS high_order_count, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '980101') AS recent_trans_sum, d.a10 AS district_unemploy_rate, d.a12 AS district_crime_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT AVG(sub_t.amount) FROM trans sub_t WHERE sub_t.account_id = a.account_id AND sub_t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS avg_specific_trans_type_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS status_specific_loan_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.district_id IN (44, 36, 35) AND l.date >= '980101' AND cl.birth_date <= '700101' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a10, d.a12 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 AND SUM(l.amount) BETWEEN 80505 AND 98224 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(dst.a10) AS district_unemploy_rate_sum, AVG(dst.a12) AS district_avg_salary FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district dst ON a.district_id = dst.district_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount > 804053 AND date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(trans_id) > 56) AND l.amount > 884828 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND dst.a10 > 4.9 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 819070 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 AND AVG(t.amount) > 1178 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 932371 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 880998 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE (l.date IS NULL OR TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 101150 AND d.a4 > 126040 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 187377 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 731442 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount < 75212.84 AND d.a10 > 5780.87 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 5118208 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 698 ORDER BY trans_amount_rank, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, l.loan_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 83929 AND t.amount < 47573 GROUP BY a.account_id, l.loan_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.district_id > 67 AND l.amount > 16312 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) >= 10 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.district_id < 147 AND l.amount < 75171 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) <= 9 ORDER BY district_id, client_id;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, MAX(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_loan_date, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_trans_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_in_district, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_rank FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 979181 AND l.duration >= 50 AND t.amount > 74924 AND CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 960310 AND 951115 AND d.a4 > 239516 AND (cd.type = 'classic' OR cd.type IS NULL) GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 5 AND SUM(o.amount) > 40641.4 AND AVG(t.balance) < 391401 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 984;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, MAX(CAST(l.duration AS DECIMAL)) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(CAST(l.payments AS DECIMAL)) AS min_loan_payment FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 860724 AND t.amount > 41244 AND o.amount > 125872.46 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 10175639 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 479 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id)) * 100 AS bad_loan_percentage FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 376101 AND l.duration >= 25 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 613431 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id)) * 100 <= 19.15 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 699639 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 AND SUM(l.amount) < 3138999 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 449387 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 96209 AND l.duration >= 26 AND l.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 79366 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 10 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MIN(l.amount) AS min_loan_amount, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 214028 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 66 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_amount_per_district, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(c.issued, 1, 6) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_issue_yearmonth FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d.a10 > 9219.0 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 7744186.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(CAST(c.issued AS DATE)) AS latest_card_issued, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, LAG(SUM(t.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_total_transaction FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 254185.74 AND t.amount BETWEEN 557526 AND 837533 AND d.a10 > 26.67 AND cl.birth_date < '1910-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 858 AND SUM(t.amount) > 4156136 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, district_id, account_id;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, ROUND(SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0), 2) AS amount_per_transaction, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_transaction_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND l.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 133683 AND l.amount > 284596 AND o.amount > 90399.51 AND d.a10 > 437.14 AND d.a12 > 452.76 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 163 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 AND SUM(t.amount) > 7109499 AND SUM(l.amount) > 575606 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, district_transaction_rank ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, cl.card_id, cl.type AS card_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_month, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payments, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_trans_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id, c.gender ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC) AS dp.disp_id = cl.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 451243 AND o.amount > 21040.87 AND l.amount > 631039 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, cl.card_id, cl.type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.frequency, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 150222 AND t.amount > 97002 AND o.amount > 171828.23 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND c.gender IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency, c.gender, loan_year, loan_month), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency, c.gender, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency, c.gender), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency), (d.district_id, d.a2), (d.district_id), () ) HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 104406 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 5 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_year, loan_month, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_card_withdrawal, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, MAX(d.a10) AS avg_salary, MAX(d.a13) AS unemployment_rate_95, MAX(d.a14) AS crime_rate_95 FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2022 AND 1986 AND d.a4 > 527240 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 468945.92 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 19 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) > 3846605 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC, total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a3 LIKE '%Prague%' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND l.status LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 87 AND SUM(l.amount) >= 149751 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.gender, l.amount AS loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 45338) AS high_value_trans_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND l.status = 'A' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.gender, l.amount, a.account_id HAVING l.amount > 58601 ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.frequency, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) FILTER (WHERE cd.type = 'classic') AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) FILTER (WHERE cd.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) FILTER (WHERE cd.type = 'junior') AS junior_cards FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 430970 AND t.amount > 66284 AND o.amount > 26040.29 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.frequency, c.gender, loan_year, loan_month), (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.frequency, c.gender, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.frequency, c.gender), (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.frequency), (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3), (d.district_id, d.a2), (d.district_id), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 54 AND SUM(t.amount) > 25857988 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_year DESC, loan_month DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a3 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status IN ('A','B') AND (l.amount > 117143 OR l.duration < 40) AND NOT (l.payments < 7732.25 AND l.date < '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 544 AND SUM(l.amount) BETWEEN 632609 AND 2774963 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a3 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 49786 AND l.duration BETWEEN 53 AND 53 AND (l.status NOT IN ('B', 'D') OR l.payments > 4100.59) AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.type = 'CREDIT' AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR t.k_symbol NOT IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO')) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a3 HAVING AVG(l.amount) < 31982 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 49 ORDER BY total_loans DESC, avg_loan_amount ASC;

SELECT l.loan_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 110802 AND t.amount < 85023 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 91595 AND l.duration >= 19 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.status, l.date AS loan_date, a.district_id, d.a4 AS district_population, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 18449 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.status, l.date, a.district_id, d.a4 ORDER BY l.account_id, l.date;

SELECT l1.loan_id AS first_loan_id, l2.loan_id AS second_loan_id, l1.account_id, l1.amount AS first_amount, l2.amount AS second_amount, l1.duration AS first_duration, l2.duration AS second_duration, AVG(l1.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY l1.account_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_account, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY l1.account_id) AS loan_count_per_account FROM loan l1 JOIN loan l2 ON l1.account_id = l2.account_id AND l1.loan_id < l2.loan_id JOIN account a ON l1.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l1.amount > 32526 AND l2.amount > 10395 AND di.a4 > 6658 GROUP BY l1.loan_id, l2.loan_id, l1.account_id, l1.amount, l2.amount, l1.duration, l2.duration HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.gender) > 1 ORDER BY loan_count_per_account DESC, avg_loan_amount_per_account DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS related_trans_count, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_related_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id != t2.trans_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 90557 AND t2.amount < 3267 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) > 2 ORDER BY total_related_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS client_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 >= 189565 AND d.a10 <= 4.09 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.transaction_count, a.total_transaction_amount, a.avg_balance, a.loan_count, a.total_loan_amount, a.order_count, a.total_order_amount, a.card_count, a.client_count, d.population, d.crime_rate, d.unemployment_rate, d.entrepreneurs_rate, d.total_clients, d.avg_client_age, SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, a.date AS account_date, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance, t.date AS trans_date, t.type AS trans_type, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, o.order_id, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol AS order_symbol, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_trans, COUNT(t.trans_id) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id, t.type ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS recent_trans_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 17213.56 AND t.amount > 3735.37 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 > 176.31 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, a.date, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, l.date, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.date, t.type, t.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, o.order_id, o.amount, o.k_symbol HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 43432.05 ORDER BY a.account_id, l.date, t.date;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 6641 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 0 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(lo.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.date) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id JOIN card ca ON di.disp_id = ca.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.amount > 17876 AND lo.amount >= 358520 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1996 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, a.date, lo.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 430925 ORDER BY d.district_id, transaction_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 581078) AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (o.amount IS NULL OR o.amount > 22243.12) AND (d.a15 IS NULL OR d.a15 > 4147) AND (d.a10 IS NULL OR d.a10 < 77.65) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 682 AND (SUM(l.amount) IS NULL OR SUM(l.amount) > 5350157) AND (SUM(t.amount) IS NULL OR SUM(t.amount) < 83655163) ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST, account_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 361;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 338645 AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE')) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 30 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d_self.a10 > 0.01 THEN d_self.district_id END) AS high_unemployment_districts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN district d_self ON d.district_id = d_self.district_id WHERE l.amount > 297398 AND t.amount > 8238 AND o.amount > 9406.2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 1995 AND 1995 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 1998 AND 1995 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 6866502 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 1336 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 521 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'A') AS active_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_insurance_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount > 650480 AND date >= '1993-01-01') AS high_trans) AS high_value_transaction_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a10 > 143.57 AND c.birth_date <= '1940-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 60 AND SUM(t.amount) > 8511164 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 620436 AND t.amount > 76403 AND o.amount > 11467.86 AND l.duration > 29 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 > 614.0 AND d.a12 > 1156.68 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 3076946 AND SUM(t.amount) > 1783243 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 242 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND o2.amount > 219967.71) AS high_value_order_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate_95, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_unemployment_rate_96, AVG(d.a13) AS avg_crime_rate_95, AVG(d.a14) AS avg_crime_rate_96, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') AS male_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'F') AS female_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, (SELECT AVG(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id IN (SELECT a3.account_id FROM account a3 WHERE a3.district_id = d.district_id) AND o.k_symbol = 'UVER') AS avg_loan_order_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 42053 AND d.a5 < 120382 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1998-12-31' AND l.status = 'A' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 635152 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 257746 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 13457 AND t.amount < 40465 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2005 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 34 AND AVG(t.amount) BETWEEN 3851 AND 18112 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 91284.6 AND l.amount >= 263555 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 9241148 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 14 AND AVG(l.amount) >= 431040 AND SUM(t.amount) > 7804375 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.payments ELSE NULL END) AS avg_loan_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, MAX(t.balance) FILTER (WHERE t.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM trans WHERE account = a.account_id AND amount > 126384)) AS latest_balance_above_threshold FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 5715 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date <= '1993-01-01') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 518535.13) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 895 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 673704 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS unique_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 277966 AND l.duration >= 54 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 50 AND SUM(l.amount) < 7079644 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(CAST(l.amount AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(l.duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_payment, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS avg_withdrawal_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount >= 447618 AND l.duration <= 19 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 22670 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 260208 AND l.duration >= 48 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 40 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_row FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 658885 AND t.amount > 64777 AND o.amount > 47156.43 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 72 AND SUM(t.amount) >= 8156642 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'), TO_DATE('1999-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = ast.total_transaction_amount, ast.avg_transaction_amount, ast.loan_count, ast.total_loan_amount, ast.order_count, ast.total_order_amount, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.unemployment_rate, dm.entrepreneurs_rate, dm.client_count, dm.avg_client_age, cf.disposition_count, cf.card_count, cf.owner_accounts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_loan_amount DESC) AS loan_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_order_amount DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.transaction_count) AS transaction_percentile, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.loan_count) AS loan_percentile FROM account a JOIN account_stats ast ON a.account_id = ast.account_id JOIN district_metrics dm ON a.district_id = dm.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON a.district_id = avg_order_amount, MAX(transaction_rank) AS max_transaction_rank, MAX(loan_rank) AS max_loan_rank, MAX(order_rank) AS max_order_rank, AVG(transaction_percentile) AS avg_transaction_percentile, WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.loan_count DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS active_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' WHERE a.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE amount > 969436) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 604 ORDER BY active_accounts DESC;
