SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_credit_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_withdrawal_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(o1.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_percentile FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (o1.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' OR o1.k_symbol IS NULL) AND d.a16 >= 192983 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 288 AND COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) < 914794 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(CAST(t.amount AS numeric)) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 1823 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 363 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) < 3387 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC, avg_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS avg_withdrawal, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.balance) DESC) AS balance_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 11727 AND l.duration >= 31 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.balance) > 763557 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 42 ORDER BY total_balance DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 151935 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 37 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 6850 AND l.amount > 676344 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 82 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS unique_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS unique_transactions FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 347 AND t.amount > 876153 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY unique_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 841784 AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE status = 'A' AND amount > 4565) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 85 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 208849 OR l.duration < 22) AND NOT (t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.amount < 11966) AND (t.date >= '970101' OR l.date >= '970101') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 9187382 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 227 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client cl WHERE cl.district_id = d.district_id AND cl.gender = 'M') AS male_clients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client cl WHERE cl.district_id = d.district_id AND cl.gender = 'F') AS female_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cli ON dp.client_id = cli.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 82218.79 AND d.a10 >= 58.93 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 683405.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 661 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 48 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_account_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_account_balance, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 845088 AND o.amount > 418307.01 AND t.amount > 67551 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM' AND cl.gender = 'M' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 16 AND SUM(l.amount) > 232745 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 25 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, cl.card_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, MAX(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS latest_transaction_date, MIN(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS earliest_transaction_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank_in_district, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank_overall FROM account a JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN card cl ON dp.disp_id = cl.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) <= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 219956 AND l.amount < 202517 AND d.a10 > 1887.53 AND o.amount BETWEEN 43322.02 AND 180240.8 AND t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'PRIJEM') AND dp.type = 'OWNER' AND l.status IN ('A', 'B') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, cl.card_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 244 AND SUM(t.amount) >= 784002 AND AVG(l.payments) < 3330.01 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, loan_count ASC LIMIT 9406;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a10 AS crime_rate_95, d.a11 AS crime_rate_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_post_trans_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 441166 AND l.duration >= 38 AND t.amount > 64700 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 97.81 AND 45.34 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2.account_id FROM account a2 JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE l2.status = 'A' AND l2.payments > 5484.79 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a10, d.a11 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 1 AND AVG(t.balance) < 691121 AND SUM(o.amount) > 178516.37 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC LIMIT 86;

SELECT l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 168445 AND t.amount < 939694 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS related_trans_count, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_related_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id != t2.trans_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 57966 AND t2.amount < 1352 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) > 4 ORDER BY total_related_amount DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS related_trans_count, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_related_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id != t2.trans_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 97476 AND t2.amount < 503 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_related_amount DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 1072 AND d.a5 < 4431 GROUP BY d.district_id ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 67197 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 41382.51 OR ca.type = '{{p6}}' GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_account_transaction, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_total, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.card_count) AS total_cards, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_salary) AS salary_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 811807 AND cf.disposition_count >= 1 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 65994 AND SUM(cf.order_count) > 35 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, salary_percentile ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 44007) AS high_amount_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 1050 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 83849) AS high_amount_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 15 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 578888 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'M') AND t.amount > 290162 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 944281 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date < '1994-01-01') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) < 1 AND COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) > 30312 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, l.status, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 636881 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a.account_id, a.district_id, l.status), (a.district_id, l.status), (l.status), ()) ORDER BY a.district_id, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a15, l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, MAX(TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS latest_loan_date, MIN(TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS earliest_trans_date, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank_per_district FROM account a INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a15 > 152232 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a15, l.loan_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 5275632 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 692 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_cnt, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_cnt, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_id = a.account_id AND o2.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_order_cnt, (SELECT MAX(CAST(t2.date AS INTEGER)) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU') AS last_card_withdrawal_date FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 918599 AND l.duration >= 49 AND t.amount > 78193 AND CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 932436 AND 969139 AND d.a10 > 4456.5 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 3526934 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 AND AVG(t.balance) < 46314 AND SUM(o.amount) > 637848.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 641 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 84338 AND l.duration >= 54 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 126650 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 99612 AND l.duration >= 20 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 248185 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, c.client_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, o.order_id, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount,0)) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(COALESCE(t.amount,0)) AS total_trans_amount, SUM(COALESCE(o.amount,0.0)) AS total_order_amount, AVG(COALESCE(d.a10,0.0)) AS avg_district_unemployment_rate, MAX(COALESCE(d.a13,0.0)) AS max_district_crime_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(l.amount,0)) DESC) AS loan_rank, LAG(SUM(COALESCE(t.amount,0)), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY MIN(t.date)) AS prev_trans_total FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (d.a4 > 8710 OR d.a4 IS NULL) AND (c.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' OR c.birth_date IS NULL) AND (l.amount > 770878 OR l.amount IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 183957 OR t.amount IS NULL) AND (o.amount > 525241.26 OR o.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, c.client_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, o.order_id HAVING SUM(COALESCE(l.amount,0)) > 597299 AND SUM(COALESCE(t.amount,0)) > 1106101 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) > 8 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_trans_amount DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 51362 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 40150.87 AND 145299.59 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, c.client_id, c.gender, dp.type AS disp_type, COALESCE(cd.type, 'No Card') AS card_type, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 AND SUM(l.amount) > 179831 THEN 'High Loan Account' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 0 AND SUM(o.amount) > 96859.87 THEN 'High Order Account' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 0 AND SUM(t.amount) > 533724 THEN 'High Trans Account' ELSE 'Standard Account' END AS account_category, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 0.68 THEN 'High Urban Ratio' WHEN d.a11 > 12342 THEN 'High Avg Salary' WHEN d.a12 > 0.08 THEN 'High Unemployment Rate' ELSE 'Normal District' END AS district_category, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_bad_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO', 'LEASING', 'UVER') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_standing_orders FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1970-01-01' AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, c.client_id, c.gender, dp.type, cd.type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 8 OR COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_order_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_trans_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, l.status, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount >= 968113 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a.account_id, d.district_id, l.status), (d.district_id, l.status), (l.status), ()) ORDER BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.status;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND a.frequency LIKE 'POPLATEK MESICNE' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 292 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.status IN (SELECT status FROM loan WHERE amount > 19531) AND t.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE amount > 75361) AND a.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 556818 GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 3421697 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 817 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, client_count ASC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS account_year, c.gender, card.type AS card_type, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_transaction_date, MAX(TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_loan_date FROM account a JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card ON dsp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.a4 >= 959246 AND d.a5 >= 490229 AND t.amount >= 465259 AND l.amount >= 485190 AND o.amount >= 536110.97 GROUP BY d.a2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), c.gender, card.type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 944 AND SUM(l.amount) > 3024430 AND SUM(t.amount) > 1876405 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 5303 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 4235 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 841028 AND d.a10 < 2933.0 AND l.amount > 318935 AND t.amount > 710318 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 636 AND SUM(l.amount) > 4210626 AND SUM(t.amount) > 3789450 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 3388 ) AND l.amount > 487445 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 94 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_average_salary, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_trans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.operation = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 >= 4.7 AND l.amount > 39967 AND t.amount > 28573 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 211257 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 324 AND AVG(d.a12) < 22176.41 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transactions DESC LIMIT 8051;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS active_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(tr.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(tr.date) AS latest_transaction_date, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_insurance_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') AS male_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'F') AS female_clients, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.payments) AS median_loan_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans tr ON a.account_id = tr.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '930101' AND l.date <= '930101' AND tr.date >= '930101' AND tr.date <= '930101' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1993 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) <= 1997 AND l.amount > 800854 AND tr.amount > 56335 AND (o.k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO', 'LEASING', 'UVER') OR o.k_symbol IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 47 AND SUM(tr.amount) > 83267287 AND COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trans_id) > 2799 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_loan_rank ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 44904 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 95 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.amount IS NOT NULL) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 53898 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 76 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district, RANK() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_rank_by_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 871754 AND l.duration > 12 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 5103 AND l.amount > 858523 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 52 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(loan_counts.total_loans) AS avg_loans_per_account FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN ( SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans FROM loan l WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 2.36 ) loan_counts ON a.account_id = loan_counts.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 13872 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_balance FROM district d INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id INNER JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 5848 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1999 AND l.duration >= 46 AND t.amount > 40357 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 420 AND AVG(t.amount) < 22760.68 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 877363 AND d.a10 < 1401.4 AND l.amount > 288620 AND t.amount > 309220 AND o.amount > 418597.46 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 9385 AND SUM(l.amount) > 9786608 AND SUM(t.amount) > 2766045 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 77;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS high_loan_clients FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = dp.account_id AND l.amount > 486918 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 27 ORDER BY high_loan_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1978 AND 1983 GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 89 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 908399 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 13 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, MAX(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_loan_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) FILTER (WHERE ca.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE CAST(date AS INTEGER) >= '19930101' AND district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE a10 > 162.96 ) ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 608078 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 23 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 317373.8 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS unique_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS unique_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS unique_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS unique_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS unique_cards, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.payments) AS min_loan_payment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 949995 AND t.amount > 68256 AND o.amount > 22973.64 AND l.duration > 45 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND t.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND cr.type = 'classic' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 463 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 80 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 6193 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 496 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) > 23 AND SUM(l.amount) > 175058 AND AVG(t.amount) > 548 AND SUM(t.amount) > 3252271 AND SUM(o.amount) > 362946.2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, unique_transactions DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 489607 AND l.duration = 20 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount < 228 AND t.type = 'PRIJEM' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 24575 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 15 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS num_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS num_cards, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_withdrawal, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_deposit, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_bad_loans, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS account_rank_in_district FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 822102 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 16.32 AND 9.75 AND l.amount > 147018 AND l.duration >= 59 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 12981.98 AND t.amount > 574222 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 42 AND SUM(t.amount) > 9533313 ORDER BY d.district_id, account_rank_in_district;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_card_withdrawal, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, MAX(d.a10) AS avg_salary, MAX(d.a13) AS unemployment_rate_95, MAX(d.a14) AS crime_rate_95 FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1910 AND 1961 AND d.a4 > 313778 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 389763.41 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 13 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) > 1304322 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC, total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank_in_region FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 30241.18 AND t.amount > 31552 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 710996 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 100 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND l.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.balance > 927284 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY t.account_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 80 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_volume, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 928122 AND l.duration > 53 AND t.amount > 86908 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 8 AND AVG(l.amount) < 440491 ORDER BY total_transaction_volume DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 186 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 24.3 AND 82.17 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 20850 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 955 AND AVG(l.amount) BETWEEN 81135 AND 7532 AND SUM(t.amount) > 1581921 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 95129 AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 34401 AND t.amount < 11615 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 180901 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 AS region_code, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 349590 AND l.duration >= 20 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 28 AND t.type = 'CREDIT' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 375418 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) < 32 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 498327 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 3952693 INTERSECT SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM loan l JOIN order1 o ON l.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id HAVING SUM(o.amount) < 8219584.46;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(aa.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 900 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(aa.total_amount) > 30558.95 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_rankings AS ( SELECT am.*, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_avg_salary, d.a12 AS district_unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS district_crime_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.total_order_amount DESC) AS order_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.active_loan_amount DESC) AS loan_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER d.district_id WHERE d.a10 >= 10491.85 AND d.a12 <= 0.08 ), client_analysis AS ( SELECT dr.*, cl.client_id, cl.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(TO_DATE(cl.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS client_age, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS client_card_count, CASE WHEN dr.transaction_rank <= 10 THEN 'TOP_TRANSACTION' WHEN dr.order_rank <= 5 THEN 'TOP_ORDER' WHEN dr.loan_rank <= 3 THEN 'TOP_LOAN' ELSE 'REGULAR' END AS client_segment FROM district_rankings dr JOIN disp dp ON dr.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dr.total_order_amount, dr.transaction_count, dr.total_transaction_amount, dr.avg_balance, dr.median_transaction_amount, dr.district_population, dr.district_avg_salary, dr.district_unemployment_rate, dr.district_crime_rate, dr.transaction_rank, dr.order_rank, dr.loan_rank, dr.balance_percentile, dr.prev_transaction_amount, dr.next_avg_balance, cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date ) SELECT = 'CREDIT' THEN t.trans_id END) AS credit_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY a.account_id ), loan_metrics AS ( SELECT l.account_id, district_aggregates AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) AS distinct_banks FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 93772.23 GROUP BY o.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) AS district_transaction_volume, SUM(lm.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_volume, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, AVG(as1.avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(lm.loan_count) AS total_loans, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_95, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes_95, CORR(as1.transaction_count, lm.total_loan_amount) AS trans_loan_correlation, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY as1.total_transaction_amount) AS dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_stats as1 ON a.account_id = as1.account_id LEFT JOIN loan_metrics lm ON a.account_id = lm.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON a.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 6388 AND d.a5 < 158697 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1998 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) > 6386022 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 706 AND AVG(as1.avg_balance) BETWEEN 5735 AND 83503 ORDER BY district_transaction_volume DESC, total_clients DESC SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, d.a4 AS district_population FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 269935 AND l.duration >= 49 AND t.amount <= 55770 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 70858.05) AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 500568 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 11 AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 288026) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) <= 0 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, MAX(CAST(d.a10 AS numeric)) AS max_avg_salary FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount > 705254 AND CAST(date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01') AND d.a15 > 8511 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 410744 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 682 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, c.client_id, cd.card_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_loan_amount_running, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(t.balance) AS min_trans_balance, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 754022 AND t.amount > 50139 AND d.a10 > 198.44 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, c.client_id, cd.card_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, l.date HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 898571 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) < 88 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, avg_loan_amount_running ASC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id)) * 100 AS bad_loan_percentage FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 455052 AND l.duration >= 29 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1801881 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id)) * 100 <= 10.69 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, a.frequency AS account_frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND t.k_symbol LIKE 'INSURANCE PAYMENT' AND o.k_symbol LIKE 'INSURANCE PAYMENT' AND d.a3 LIKE 'central Bohemia' AND l.amount > 260119 AND t.amount > 4462 AND o.amount > 56724.38 AND l.duration >= 17 AND t.balance > 589425 GROUP BY d.a2, a.frequency, d.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 AND SUM(l.amount) > 3054180 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 663 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_loans DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT l1.loan_id AS loan_id_1, l2.loan_id AS loan_id_2, d.district_id, a1.date AS account_creation_date_1, a2.date AS account_creation_date_2, SUM(t1.amount) AS total_trans_amount_1, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_trans_amount_2, AVG(t1.balance) AS avg_balance_1, AVG(t2.balance) AS avg_balance_2, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS order_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS order_count_2, MAX(l1.amount) AS max_loan_amount_1, MAX(l2.amount) AS max_loan_amount_2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY (SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount)) DESC) AS district_trans_rank FROM loan l1 INNER JOIN loan l2 ON l1.account_id < l2.account_id AND l1.duration = l2.duration INNER JOIN account a1 ON l1.account_id = a1.account_id INNER JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id INNER JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id INNER JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id INNER JOIN district d ON c1.district_id = d.district_id AND c2.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id WHERE l1.amount > 261758 AND l2.amount > 106526 AND l1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l2.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l1.loan_id, l2.loan_id, d.district_id, a1.date, a2.date HAVING SUM(t1.amount) > 245225 AND SUM(t2.amount) > 733698 ORDER BY (SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount)) DESC LIMIT 977;
