ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE c.birth_date <= '300101' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, ast.transaction_count, ast.total_transaction_amount, ast.avg_transaction_amount, ast.loan_count, ast.total_loan_amount, ast.order_count, ast.total_order_amount, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.unemployment_rate, dm.entrepreneurs_rate, dm.client_count, dm.avg_client_age, cf.disposition_count, cf.card_count, cf.owner_accounts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_loan_amount DESC) AS loan_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_order_amount DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.transaction_count) AS transaction_percentile, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.loan_count) AS loan_percentile FROM account a JOIN account_stats ast ON a.account_id = ast.account_id JOIN district_metrics dm ON a.district_id = dm.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON a.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE ast.total_transaction_amount > 286667 AND ast.total_loan_amount > 487458 ) SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS total_accounts, AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transactions, AVG(total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, AVG(loan_count) AS avg_loans, AVG(total_loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, AVG(order_count) AS avg_orders, AVG(total_order_amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(transaction_rank) AS max_transaction_rank, MAX(loan_rank) AS max_loan_rank, MAX(order_rank) AS max_order_rank, AVG(transaction_percentile) AS avg_transaction_percentile, AVG(loan_percentile) AS avg_loan_percentile, SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_transaction_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN loan_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_loan_accounts FROM ranked_accounts WHERE transaction_percentile > 0.86 AND loan_percentile > 0.61 GROUP BY district_id HAVING AVG(total_transaction_amount) > 465758 AND AVG(total_loan_amount) > 746449 ORDER BY avg_transaction_amount DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT d.disp_id, d.client_id, d.account_id, d.type AS disp_type, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.district_id AS account_district_id, a.frequency, a.date AS account_date FROM disp d INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' ), loan_transactions AS ( SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date AS loan_date, l.status, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM loan l LEFT JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 156058 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2014 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS salary, d.a13 AS unemployment, d.a16 AS urban_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.client_id) AS total_clients FROM district d LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca ON d.district_id = ca.account_district_id WHERE d.a4 > 73188 AND d.a13 < 0.16 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13, d.a16 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) AS unique_banks FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 58581.77 AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count, MIN(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS first_issue_date, MAX(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS last_issue_date FROM card c WHERE TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD') >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.disp_id ) SELECT dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(lt.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(lt.loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(lt.total_trans_amount) AS grand_total_trans, AVG(lt.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT oa.account_id) AS accounts_with_orders, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.disp_id) AS clients_with_cards, SUM(ca.card_count) AS total_cards_issued, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lt.loan_amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oa.avg_order_amount) AS median_order_amount FROM district_metrics dm LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca_base ON dm.district_id = ca_base.account_district_id LEFT JOIN loan_transactions lt ON ca_base.account_id = lt.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca_base.account_id = oa.account_id LEFT JOIN card_analysis ca ON ca_base.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE dm.population > 368524 AND dm.salary > 22817.59 GROUP BY dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) > 40 AND SUM(oa.total_order_amount) > 507166.74 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_volume DESC LIMIT 80;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_loan_amount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 409789 AND l.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01'::DATE AND d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 4;

SELECT a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 805 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND c.gender LIKE 'F' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 643465 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 377701 AND t.amount < 25691 AND d.a4 > 1894 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1994 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 192352 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 899 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 88146 AND l.duration >= 51 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 43796 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, MAX(t.date) AS latest_transaction_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 39639.18) AS high_value_orders_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('B', 'D')) AND t.operation IS NOT NULL AND d.a10 > 80.27 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 54905 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 45 ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC, avg_loan_amount ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_balance FROM district d INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id INNER JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 3553 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2000 AND l.duration >= 20 AND t.amount > 43522 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 142 AND AVG(t.amount) < 11945.99 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 425082 AND d.a10 < 8397.85 AND l.amount > 509991 AND t.amount > 112507 AND o.amount > 406476.75 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 8664 AND SUM(l.amount) > 7912722 AND SUM(t.amount) > 7444029 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 28;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 591509 AND t.amount > 4216 AND o.amount > 7228.69 AND d.a4 > 2692 AND d.a5 > 9091 AND d.a6 > 4207 AND d.a7 > 1530 AND d.a8 > 6808 AND d.a9 > 2076 AND d.a11 > 5803 AND d.a14 > 4869 AND d.a15 > 3599 AND d.a16 > 4278 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 96377898 AND SUM(t.amount) > 89524617 AND SUM(o.amount) > 50498015.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4356 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 76163 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 4349 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) > 3419 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'CREDIT' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, (SELECT MAX(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account = a.account_id AND t.date >= '970101') AS max_recent_transaction, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, (SELECT AVG(sub.amount) FROM order1 sub WHERE sub.account_id = a.account_id AND sub.amount > 79902.14) AS avg_large_order FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans ON a.account_id = trans.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE a.date <= '930101' AND (l.duration >= 39 OR l.duration IS NULL) AND trans.balance > 839153 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 54 AND SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'CREDIT' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) > 468691 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_year, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 160053 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.district_id, d.a2, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2), (loan_year), ()) ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_year;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 451591 AND l.duration >= 12 AND t.amount > 738700 AND o.amount > 980853.9 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 456 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 12 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT s.client_id, s.district_name, s.total_loan_amount, s.avg_transaction, s.max_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT s.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(s.order_amount_sum) AS total_order_amount FROM ( SELECT c.client_id, d.a3 AS district_name, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, crd.card_id, SUM(o.amount) AS order_amount_sum FROM client c JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card crd ON dp.disp_id = crd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 222321 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.status = 'A') GROUP BY c.client_id, d.a3, crd.card_id ) s WHERE s.total_loan_amount > 4980821 GROUP BY s.client_id, s.district_name, s.total_loan_amount, s.avg_transaction, s.max_loan_duration HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.card_id) > 3 AND SUM(s.order_amount_sum) < 10424.8 ORDER BY s.total_loan_amount DESC, s.client_id;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 2499 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) > 35695.64 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 283358) AS high_loan_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 192495 ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id IN ( SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id = c.client_id ) AND o.amount > 38650.34) AS total_order_amount FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) < 1941 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS active_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS total_transactions, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_account_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS financial_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN account a2 ON l.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE a2.district_id = ds.district_id AND l.status = 'A' AND l.duration > 47) AS active_long_loans FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE ds.avg_salary > 30763.39 AND cf.total_order_amount > 64466.52 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 459 AND SUM(cf.total_order_amount) > 224575.52 ORDER BY district_order_volume DESC LIMIT 88;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 584883 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 2420641 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 32381 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 339812;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l1.loan_id) AS active_loans, SUM(l1.amount) AS total_active_amount, AVG(l2.amount) AS avg_other_account_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l1 ON a.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN loan l2 ON l1.duration = l2.duration WHERE l1.amount > 671223 AND l2.amount > 14611 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l1.loan_id) >= 10 ORDER BY total_active_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 514265 AND l.duration > 27 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1980950 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.amount > 46700 AND o.amount > 1857.29 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 14 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 894820 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount < 248.08 AND d.a10 > 477.25 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 5966606 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 132 ORDER BY trans_amount_rank, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 329164 AND l.duration > 75 GROUP BY c.client_id INTERSECT SELECT d.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 29282 AND t.balance < -92395 GROUP BY d.client_id;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS avg_transaction_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.amount > 889708 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a15 > 15135 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND c.gender = 'F' AND d.a3 LIKE 'north' AND l.amount > 7426 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND d.a10 >= 42.82 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 724728.69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 66.96 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND l.status = 'A' AND o.bank_to = 'CS' AND d.a12 >= 44.02 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) < 89950.9 AND SUM(o.amount) <= 30888.89;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 851825 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 52 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_in_district, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 980171 AND l.duration > 27 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 6 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 42867.83 ) AND l.duration >= 54 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 63000.95 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 4733 AND d.a5 < 19706 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 86 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 993976 AND t.amount > 50997 AND o1.amount > 82801.7 AND d.a4 > 2587 AND d.a5 > 3083 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 4660840 AND AVG(l.amount) > 158007 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 35 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 22397 AND l.duration >= 29 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 4 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_transactions FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a16 > 4818 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 3949.39 ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 523033 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS distinct_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS distinct_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS distinct_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_credit_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_sipo_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) DESC) AS client_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 682448 AND d.a10 > 571014.26 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 5935 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 8857 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) > 557010 ORDER BY distinct_accounts DESC, distinct_clients DESC LIMIT 223;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.loan_id IS NOT NULL) AS avg_loan_amount, MIN(CAST(a.date AS DATE)) AS first_account_date, MAX(CAST(a.date AS DATE)) AS last_account_date FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE CAST(a.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(a.date AS DATE) <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 29 ORDER BY total_loans DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('A', 'B')) AND c.district_id = d.district_id AND (d.a10 > 72.1 OR d.a12 < 63.43) AND NOT (d.a14 <= 985) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 8 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('A', 'B')) AND c.district_id = d.district_id AND (d.a10 > 88.33 OR d.a12 < 56.58) AND NOT (d.a14 <= 450) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 100 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 276001 AND t.amount < 16742 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1997 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 AND AVG(t.amount) BETWEEN 1207 AND 6322 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_unique_accounts, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) AS total_distinct_loan_amounts, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_withdrawal_amount, SUM(o.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) DESC) AS client_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 85226 AND d.a10 <= 5567.27 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.date, o.amount HAVING SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) > 584916 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 515 ORDER BY total_unique_clients DESC, total_distinct_loan_amounts ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 91291 AND l.date >= ( SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN ( SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id ) ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 41526.59 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount > 299334 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_loans FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 49 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemploy_rate, AVG(d.a13) AS avg_crime_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS trans_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE t.amount > 2939 AND l.amount > 485409 AND o.amount > 574937.27 AND d.a10 > 44.1 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 6242 AND SUM(t.amount) > 4628585 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 72 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, GROUPING(d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'))) AS grouping_id FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 742075 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND o.amount > 93380.28 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'))), (d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender), (d.district_id, d.a2), (d.district_id), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 69 AND SUM(l.amount) > 4141591 ORDER BY d.district_id, c.gender, birth_year DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id, c.gender ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 82766 AND t.amount > 49546 AND o.amount > 88055.8 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 695573 AND SUM(t.amount) > 904524 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 53 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, c.client_id, c.gender, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.operation = 'VYBER' WHERE d.a10 > 55051.19 AND d.a4 < 3774 AND c.birth_date >= '1950-01-01' AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a10, c.client_id, c.gender, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 211485 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 33 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (d.a4 > 5486 OR d.a5 < 775) AND (d.a6 BETWEEN 7870 AND 627) AND NOT (d.a7 = 492 AND d.a8 = 7239) AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 353674) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 990 AND AVG(l.amount) < 60896 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) AS birth_year, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 14921 AND t.amount > 76588 AND o.amount > 32320.68 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 1959 AND 1980 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')), a.frequency), (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, c.gender, a.frequency), (d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3), (d.district_id, d.a2), (d.district_id), () ) HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4490682 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 58 ORDER BY d.district_id, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, l.status AS loan_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 364929 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, l.status, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2), (loan_year), () ) ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_year DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, a.district_id, d.a4, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 269489) AS high_trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.duration > 53 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, a.district_id, d.a4 HAVING l.amount > 35588 ORDER BY high_trans_count DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 607148 GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, MAX(CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL)) AS max_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE l.amount > 9699 AND l.duration >= 53 AND t.amount > 12142 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 3 AND SUM(l.amount) <= 34588 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount FROM account a JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE o.amount > 47329.22 AND t.amount > 25615 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 2 AND SUM(o.amount) <= 8910.6 ORDER BY district_id, account_id;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 66943 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 50 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_average_salary, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_trans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.operation = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 >= 2.71 AND l.amount > 68870 AND t.amount > 58513 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 483915 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 122 AND AVG(d.a12) < 15092.36 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transactions DESC LIMIT 2155;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance_after_trans, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, MAX(TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS latest_loan_date, MAX(TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS latest_trans_date FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 653980 OR l.amount IS NULL AND l.duration > 18 AND o.amount > 60508.97 AND t.amount > 793262 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 962 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 185 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_by_district, SUM(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3) AS running_total_loans_by_region FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 211106 AND t.amount > 14236 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a16 >= 85477 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 2276146 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 5263 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(COALESCE(l.payments, 0)) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(COALESCE(o.amount, 0)) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(COALESCE(t.amount, 0)) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(COALESCE(t.balance, 0)) AS avg_transaction_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ca.issued FROM 1 FOR 8) AS DATE)) AS latest_card_issue_date FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 346845) AND (o.amount IS NULL OR o.amount > 52951.19) AND (t.amount IS NULL OR t.amount > 535607) AND (ca.issued IS NULL OR CAST(SUBSTRING(ca.issued FROM 1 FOR 8) AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01') AND (a.date IS NULL OR CAST(SUBSTRING(a.date FROM 1 FOR 8) AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) > 15390 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 16 AND SUM(COALESCE(t.amount, 0)) > 270902 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, a.district_id, a.frequency, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_crime_rate, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 62632 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 <= 0.56 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, a.district_id, a.frequency, d.a4, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 39 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id) as account_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.birth_date >= '1950-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, a.date as account_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.amount > 502078 AND l.duration >= 35 ), transaction_summary AS ( SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) as trans_count, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) as unique_symbols, MAX(t.date) as last_trans_date FROM trans t WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 7215580 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as population, d.a10 as crime_rate, d.a12 as salary, d.a13 as unemployment, (d.a10 * d.a13) as risk_factor FROM district d WHERE d.a4 > 103908 AND d.a13 < 0.02 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 18660.0 GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_info AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, c.card_id, c.type as card_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.disp_id) as cards_per_disp FROM card c WHERE c.issued >= '1993-01-01' ) SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_count, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.salary, ds.unemployment, ds.risk_factor, la.loan_amount, la.duration as loan_duration, la.payments, la.status as loan_status, ts.trans_count, ts.total_amount as trans_total, ts.avg_balance, ts.unique_symbols, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.unique_banks, oa.avg_order_amount, ci.card_type, ci.cards_per_disp, a.frequency as account_frequency, (ts.total_amount / NULLIF(la.loan_amount, 0)) as trans_loan_ratio, (oa.total_order_amount / NULLIF(ts.total_amount, 0)) as order_trans_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_amount DESC) as trans_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.loan_amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM client_accounts ca JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id AND la.loan_rank = 1 JOIN transaction_summary ts ON ca.account_id = ts.account_id JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN card_info ci ON ca.disp_id = ci.disp_id JOIN account a ON ca.account_id = a.account_id WHERE ts.trans_count > 165 AND oa.order_count >= 33 ORDER BY ts.total_amount DESC, la.loan_amount DESC LIMIT 118;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND l.amount > 939313 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_cards DESC, total_loans DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l2.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM loan l1 JOIN loan l2 ON l1.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN account a ON l1.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l1.amount > 566660 AND l2.duration >= 28 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(l2.amount) > 330181 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 28594 ) AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 308797 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, t.trans_id, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 40690 AND a.district_id = 70 ORDER BY a.account_id, t.date::DATE;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 850784) AS high_amount_trans_count FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration >= 51 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, d.a2 AS district_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 52272) AS high_loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND t.date >= '970101' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 845809 ORDER BY trans_rank;

SELECT a.account_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 334889 AND d.a4 > 608773 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_trans_amount, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount, AVG(di.a10) AS avg_district_unemploy_rate_95, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, MAX(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS latest_trans_date, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) DESC) AS order_amount_percentile FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' WHERE CAST(a.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a4 > 1589 AND (CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) > 858179 AND COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) > 841380 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) >= 3 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 30331 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 156125 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_balance FROM district d INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id INNER JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 5944 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1990 AND l.duration >= 58 AND t.amount > 27884 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 247 AND AVG(t.amount) < 39554.73 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;
