SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_transactions, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS total_credit_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 3848 AND l.amount > 187564 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 14 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE amount > 488595) AND l.amount > 22950 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 79 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_amount_per_district, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(c.issued, 1, 6) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_issue_yearmonth FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d.a10 > 5972.03 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 8229826.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 7 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.account_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 393728 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 30352 AND l.duration > 16 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency), (d.district_id, d.a2), (a.frequency), () ) ORDER BY d.district_id, a.frequency;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 77124 AND t.amount > 83411 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 57236.45 AND d.a4 > 72923 AND d.a10 > 111.8 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 690029 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 18 AND SUM(t.amount) > 976102 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_card_withdrawal, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, MAX(d.a10) AS avg_salary, MAX(d.a13) AS unemployment_rate_95, MAX(d.a14) AS crime_rate_95 FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2011 AND 1963 AND d.a4 > 561971 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 992255.54 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 17 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) > 9529097 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC, total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a15 AS urban_inhabitants, d.a16 AS avg_salary, COUNT(c1.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(c2.client_id) AS female_clients, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(c2.client_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(c1.client_id), 0), 2) AS female_percentage FROM district d JOIN client c1 ON d.district_id = c1.district_id JOIN client c2 ON d.district_id = c2.district_id AND c2.gender = 'F' WHERE d.a15 > 4726 AND d.a16 > 12472 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(c1.client_id) > 59 ORDER BY female_percentage DESC, d.district_id;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS num_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS num_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS num_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) DESC) AS client_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_percent_rank, LAG(SUM(l.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_loan_amount, LEAD(COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS next_district_account_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 23321 AND l.duration >= 46 AND t.amount BETWEEN 27517 AND 2460519 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 81566.04 AND d.a4 >= 39790 AND d.a5 <= 19705 AND d.a10 > 86.87 AND d.a12 < 62.1 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4212492 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 228 AND AVG(t.amount) > 6898 AND SUM(o.amount) > 4243210.99 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, num_clients DESC LIMIT 342;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a3 LIKE '%Prague%' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND l.status LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 10 AND SUM(l.amount) >= 537107 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, a.account_id, c.client_id, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_amount, COALESCE(AVG(t.amount), 0) AS avg_transaction_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) AS total_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(AVG(l.amount), 0) AS avg_loan_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount, COALESCE(AVG(o.amount), 0) AS avg_order_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id), 0) AS total_cards, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) DESC) AS transaction_rank_in_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS overall_loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) DESC) AS order_rank_in_region FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND c.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d.a10 >= 9.69 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id, c.client_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) > 956844.4 AND COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) >= 6.64 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction, MAX(sub.max_order) AS max_order_amount, MIN(sub2.min_client_age) AS min_client_age FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN ( SELECT o.account_id, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 92199.41 GROUP BY o.account_id ) sub ON a.account_id = sub.account_id JOIN ( SELECT c.district_id, MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'), TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')))) AS min_client_age FROM client c WHERE c.birth_date >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY c.district_id ) sub2 ON d.district_id = sub2.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 782786 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 6065691 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 400 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status LIKE '%B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS district_account_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON (a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER') LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 832322 OR l.amount IS NULL) AND (o.amount > 43479.42 OR o.amount IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 83065 OR t.amount IS NULL) AND (d.a4 > 13663 OR d.a4 IS NULL) AND (d.a10 > 31.68 OR d.a10 IS NULL) AND (d.a13 > 75.12 OR d.a13 IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 67 AND SUM(l.amount) > 4797944 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 3617 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 153 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 31.86 AND 32.44 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 195313 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 834 AND AVG(l.amount) BETWEEN 42610 AND 86071 AND SUM(t.amount) > 6365622 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account WHERE l.amount > 771998 AND t.amount < 923796 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.status, l.date AS loan_date, a.district_id, d.a4 AS district_population, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 57247 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.status, l.date, a.district_id, d.a4 ORDER BY l.account_id, l.date;

SELECT t1.account_id, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(t2.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id < t2.trans_id WHERE t1.amount > 416437.67 AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(t2.trans_id) > 84.46 ORDER BY avg_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 133902 AND d.a10 < 4.13 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(TO_DATE(card.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_card_issue_date FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE TO_DATE(card.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.loan_count DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.order_count DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.avg_balance) AS balance_percentile, LAG(as2.total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS prev_account_transaction_amount, LEAD(as2.total_loan_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY as2.total_loan_amount DESC) AS next_account_loan_amount, SUM(as2.total_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_total_transactions, AVG(as2.avg_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_avg_balance FROM account a JOIN account_stats as2 ON a.account_id = as2.account_id WHERE as2.transaction_count > 162 AND as2.loan_count >= 2 ) SELECT ra.account_id, ra.district_id, ra.frequency, ra.transaction_rank, ra.loan_rank, ra.order_rank, ra.balance_percentile, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.unemployment_rate, dm.entrepreneurs_rate, dm.client_count, dm.avg_client_age, cf.disposition_count, cf.card_count, cf.latest_card_issue_date, as2.transaction_count, as2.total_transaction_amount, as2.avg_balance, as2.loan_count, as2.total_loan_amount, as2.order_count, as2.total_order_amount, ra.prev_account_transaction_amount, ra.next_account_loan_amount, ra.district_total_transactions, ra.district_avg_balance, (as2.total_transaction_amount / NULLIF(ra.district_total_transactions, 0)) * 100 AS transaction_share_percent, (as2.avg_balance - ra.district_avg_balance) AS balance_deviation_from_district_avg FROM ranked_accounts ra JOIN district_metrics dm ON ra.district_id = dm.district_id JOIN account_stats as2 ON ra.account_id = as2.account_id LEFT JOIN client_financials cf ON ra.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE ra.transaction_rank <= 82 AND ra.balance_percentile > 0.74 AND dm.unemployment_rate < 0.16 AND dm.entrepreneurs_rate > 3.69 AND cf.card_count >= 2 ORDER BY ra.transaction_rank, ra.balance_percentile DESC, as2.total_transaction_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS client_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' AND l.date >= '930101' AND o.amount >= 802316.97 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 >= 87783 AND d.a10 <= 1.14 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.transaction_count, a.total_transaction_amount, a.avg_balance, a.loan_count, a.total_loan_amount, a.order_count, a.total_order_amount, a.card_count, a.client_count, d.population, d.crime_rate, d.unemployment_rate, d.entrepreneurs_rate, d.total_clients, d.avg_client_age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.loan_count DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.order_count DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.avg_balance) AS balance_percentile, LAG(a.total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS prev_transaction_amount, LEAD(a.loan_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.loan_count DESC) AS next_loan_count, SUM(a.total_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_total_transactions, AVG(a.avg_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_avg_balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS accounts_in_district FROM account_stats a JOIN district_metrics d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.transaction_count >= 792 AND a.loan_count <= 9 ) SELECT account_id, district_id, transaction_count, total_transaction_amount, avg_balance, loan_count, total_loan_amount, order_count, total_order_amount, card_count, client_count, population, crime_rate, unemployment_rate, entrepreneurs_rate, total_clients, avg_client_age, transaction_rank, loan_rank, order_rank, balance_percentile, prev_transaction_amount, next_loan_count, district_total_transactions, district_avg_balance, accounts_in_district, (total_transaction_amount / NULLIF(district_total_transactions, 0)) * 100 AS transaction_share_percent, (avg_balance - district_avg_balance) AS balance_deviation FROM ranked_accounts WHERE transaction_rank <= 28 AND balance_percentile >= 0.18 ORDER BY district_id, transaction_rank;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id) as account_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 18 AND 127 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(t.trans_id) as trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) as unique_symbols, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) as latest_trans_date FROM client_accounts ca JOIN account a ON ca.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 65574 OR t.amount IS NULL GROUP BY ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_id, a.frequency ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT am.client_id, am.district_id, am.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 'GOOD' WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'BAD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as loan_quality, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.client_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM account_metrics am JOIN loan l ON am.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount >= 228597 AND l.duration > 54 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as population, d.a10 as crime_rate, d.a12 as unemployment, d.a13 as entrepreneurs, d.a15 as urban_ratio, d.a16 as avg_salary, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 0.08 THEN 'HIGH_CRIME' WHEN d.a10 > 0.04 THEN 'MEDIUM_CRIME' ELSE 'LOW_CRIME' END as crime_category FROM district d ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount FROM loan_analysis la JOIN order1 o ON la.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount BETWEEN 2492.08 AND 84509.34 GROUP BY la.client_id, la.district_id, la.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.account_id, COUNT(c.card_id) as card_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 END) as gold_cards, MAX(CAST(c.issued AS INTEGER)) as latest_card_issue FROM order_analysis oa JOIN disp d ON oa.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id GROUP BY oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.account_id ), final_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.unemployment, ds.entrepreneurs, ds.urban_ratio, ds.avg_salary, ds.crime_category, am.trans_count, am.total_credits, am.total_withdrawals, am.avg_balance, am.unique_symbols, am.latest_trans_date, la.loan_amount, la.duration as loan_duration, la.payments as monthly_payment, la.loan_quality, la.loan_rank, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.unique_banks, oa.avg_order_amount, ca.card_count, ca.gold_cards, ca.latest_card_issue, (am.total_credits - am.total_withdrawals) as net_flow, (oa.total_order_amount / NULLIF(am.avg_balance, 0)) as order_to_balance_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY oa.total_order_amount DESC) as spending_rank FROM card_analysis ca JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN account_metrics am ON ca.account_id = am.account_id JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id AND ca.client_id = la.client_id JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id AND ca.client_id = oa.client_id WHERE am.trans_count > 624 AND oa.order_count >= 16 AND ca.card_count > 0 ) SELECT crime_category, loan_quality, COUNT(*) as client_count, AVG(loan_amount) as avg_loan_amount, AVG(total_order_amount) as avg_spending, AVG(avg_balance) as avg_account_balance, SUM(net_flow) as total_net_flow, AVG(order_to_balance_ratio) as avg_order_ratio, CORR(loan_amount, total_order_amount) as loan_spending_correlation, CORR(avg_salary, avg_balance) as salary_balance_correlation FROM final_metrics WHERE spending_rank <= 1378 GROUP BY crime_category, loan_quality HAVING AVG(loan_amount) > 499798 AND COUNT(*) >= 41 ORDER BY client_count DESC, avg_spending DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d GROUP BY d.district_id ), client_loan_analysis AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 277494 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ), account_trans_summary AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 7918 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), complex_metrics AS ( SELECT cla.client_id, cla.district_id, cla.loan_count, cla.total_loan_amount, cla.avg_loan_duration, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card cd JOIN disp dsp ON cd.disp_id = dsp.disp_id WHERE dsp.client_id = cla.client_id AND cd.type = '{{p4}}') AS card_count, (SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM order1 o JOIN account ac ON o.account_id = ac.account_id JOIN disp dsp ON ac.account_id = dsp.account_id WHERE dsp.client_id = cla.client_id AND o.amount > 512810.65) AS total_order_amount FROM client_loan_analysis cla JOIN district_stats ds ON cla.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE cla.total_loan_amount > 816899 ) SELECT cm.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(cm.loan_count) AS total_loans, AVG(cm.total_loan_amount) AS avg_loan_per_client, MAX(cm.avg_unemployment_rate) AS max_unemployment_rate, SUM(cm.total_crimes) AS district_crimes, SUM(cm.card_count) AS total_cards, SUM(cm.total_order_amount) AS total_orders_amount, (SELECT AVG(ats.avg_balance) FROM account_trans_summary ats WHERE ats.district_id = cm.district_id AND ats.total_transaction_amount > 254673) AS district_avg_balance FROM complex_metrics cm GROUP BY cm.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.client_id) > 11 AND SUM(cm.total_loan_amount) > 8921191 ORDER BY total_loans DESC, district_avg_balance DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a16) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 796 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) < 0.37 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.duration > 19 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(cl.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) < 1968 GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transaction_count, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.card_count) AS total_cards, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_unemployment_rate) AS unemployment_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 4494677 AND cf.total_order_amount < 2806510.07 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 11556 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) >= 116 ORDER BY district_transaction_count DESC, district_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND l.amount > 894571 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_cards DESC, total_loans DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 665523.28 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 736635 ) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) <= 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount, MIN(l.amount) AS min_loan_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) DESC) AS card_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT t2.account_id FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.amount > 159691 AND t2.balance < 652143) AND l.amount > 178511 AND d.a10 > 14658.96 AND d.a12 < 14.42 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2, d.a10, d.a12 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 5141106 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) > 4 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, card_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, t.date, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE t.amount > 72553 AND l.amount > 359797 AND di.a4 > 2497 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, t.date, t.amount, t.balance, t.account HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 532467 ORDER BY a.account_id, t.date;

SELECT a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a15, l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, MAX(TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS latest_loan_date, MIN(TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS earliest_trans_date, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank_per_district FROM account a INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a15 > 872155 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a15, l.loan_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 3318727 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 142 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 70581 AND l.duration >= 25 GROUP BY a.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 10 ORDER BY a.district_id, amount_rank;

SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 62315 AND t.amount > 259 GROUP BY c.client_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 7 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.district_id > 68 AND l.amount > 33410 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) >= 9 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.district_id < 54 AND l.amount < 165891 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) <= 4 ORDER BY district_id, client_id;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, MAX(o1.amount) AS max_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 7023 AND l.duration >= 25 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount > 29371.18 AND l.status = 'A' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 137827.82 AND SUM(t.amount) < 1074483 INTERSECT SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, MAX(o1.amount) AS max_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE d.a4 <= 3717 AND l.duration < 59 AND t.date < '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount <= 93478.34 AND l.status IN ('B', 'C') AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) <= 415904.1 AND SUM(t.amount) >= 524409 ORDER BY client_count DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank_in_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 544900 AND t.amount > 41876 AND d.a4 > 4409 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 31 AND AVG(t.amount) < 237418 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, l.status AS loan_status, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 855288 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, l.status HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 39347 AND l.duration >= 56 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 26330 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.account_id) AS avg_loan_per_account FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 60119 AND l.duration > 21 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 36079 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, AVG(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('A','C')) AS avg_active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS sipo_order_count, SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS total_sipo_amount, MAX(d.a10) AS district_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a11) AS district_crime_count, (SUM(t.amount) - COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0)) AS net_flow_vs_loan, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_rank_in_district, LAG(SUM(t.amount),1) OVER (ORDER BY a.account_id) AS prev_account_total_transaction FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 342092 AND l.amount > 182648 AND d.a10 > 2.45 AND o.amount > 19742.23 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 229 AND SUM(t.amount) > 9410072 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, net_flow_vs_loan DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 533778 OR l.amount IS NULL GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) < 31 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS num_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS num_transactions FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 744983 AND o.amount > 64470.97 AND t.amount > 550 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 14 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 40739 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 272 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON dp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 1493 AND d.a5 <= 2185 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 69884 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 68 AND SUM(t.amount) > 156571 INTERSECT SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON dp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a6 >= 4910 AND d.a7 <= 198 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 522987 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 100 AND SUM(t.amount) > 366089 ORDER BY district_id;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 418211 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.account_id IN (SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 100071 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 175558 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '1998-01-01') AS avg_recent_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 316720.74 AND l.duration >= 29.28 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4.3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 214406 AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE status = 'A' AND amount > 18821) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 43 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 46 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS rank_by_total_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 138977 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 58 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l1.loan_id) AS high_loan_count, COUNT(l2.loan_id) AS low_loan_count FROM district d JOIN account a1 ON d.district_id = a1.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id AND l1.amount > 61493 JOIN account a2 ON d.district_id = a2.district_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id AND l2.amount <= 48530 WHERE d.a11 > 1588 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l1.loan_id) > 3 ORDER BY high_loan_count DESC, low_loan_count ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, cl.card_id, cl.type AS card_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_month, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payments, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_trans_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id, c.gender ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC) AS district_gender_order_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cl ON dp.disp_id = cl.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 895712 AND o.amount > 90061.64 AND l.amount > 661287 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, cl.card_id, cl.type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender), (d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender), (d.district_id, d.a2), (c.gender), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 2 AND SUM(t.amount) > 311438 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 35 ORDER BY d.district_id, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS crime_rate_95, d.a11 AS crime_rate_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS repaid_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B','D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS defaulted_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a10 > 6116.36 AND d.a11 > 511.39 AND (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 500563 OR t.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a10, d.a11 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 734 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 355 AND SUM(t.amount) > 21395767 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND l.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.balance > 878060 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY t.account_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 56 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 484912 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) < 181906.29 ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 26033 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 418230 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.client_id, c.birth_date, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 203429 AND l.duration >= 37 AND c.birth_date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.birth_date, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 71674.97 ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, CAST(l.payments AS DECIMAL) AS monthly_payment, a.account_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date > l.date) AS transactions_after_loan FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 64160 AND l.duration >= 44 AND d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, a.account_id HAVING CAST(l.payments AS DECIMAL) > 2168.17 ORDER BY l.loan_id;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id) as account_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.birth_date >= '1950-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, a.date as account_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.amount > 583627 AND l.duration >= 44 ), transaction_summary AS ( SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) as trans_count, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) as unique_symbols, MAX(t.date) as last_trans_date FROM trans t WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 2910537 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as population, d.a10 as crime_rate, d.a12 as salary, d.a13 as unemployment, (d.a10 * d.a13) as risk_factor FROM district d WHERE d.a4 > 100356 AND d.a13 < 0.1 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 80761.13 GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_info AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, c.card_id, c.type as card_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.disp_id) as cards_per_disp FROM card c WHERE c.issued >= '1993-01-01' ) SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.account_count, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.salary, ds.unemployment, ds.risk_factor, la.loan_amount, la.duration as loan_duration, la.payments, la.status as loan_status, ts.trans_count, ts.total_amount as trans_total, ts.avg_balance, ts.unique_symbols, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.unique_banks, oa.avg_order_amount, ci.card_type, ci.cards_per_disp, a.frequency as account_frequency, (ts.total_amount / NULLIF(la.loan_amount, 0)) as trans_loan_ratio, (oa.total_order_amount / NULLIF(ts.total_amount, 0)) as order_trans_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_amount DESC) as trans_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.loan_amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM client_accounts ca JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id AND la.loan_rank = 1 JOIN transaction_summary ts ON ca.account_id = ts.account_id JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN card_info ci ON ca.disp_id = ci.disp_id JOIN account a ON ca.account_id = a.account_id WHERE ts.trans_count > 921 AND oa.order_count >= 45 ORDER BY ts.total_amount DESC, la.loan_amount DESC LIMIT 791;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemploy_rate FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 238406 AND t.amount < 15168 AND l.duration >= 38 AND d.a11 > 129 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 1 AND SUM(t.amount) < 67952 ORDER BY total_trans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 30076 AND t.amount < 3784 AND l.status = 'A' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND d.a16 > 1580 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 AND SUM(l.amount) < 13290 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a1.account_id AS account_id_1, a2.account_id AS account_id_2, a1.district_id AS district_id_1, a2.district_id AS district_id_2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) AS loans_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) AS loans_count_2, SUM(DISTINCT l1.amount) AS total_loan_amount_1, SUM(DISTINCT l2.amount) AS total_loan_amount_2, AVG(DISTINCT l1.payments) AS avg_payment_1, AVG(DISTINCT l2.payments) AS avg_payment_2 FROM account a1 JOIN account a2 ON a1.district_id = a2.district_id AND a1.account_id < a2.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN district d ON a1.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id WHERE l1.amount > 16853 AND l2.amount > 99945 AND d.a4 > 512 GROUP BY a1.account_id, a2.account_id, a1.district_id, a2.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount_1 DESC, total_loan_amount_2 DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(sub.total_loans) AS district_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN ( SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 247386 AND l.duration >= 41 GROUP BY l.account_id ) sub ON a.account_id = sub.account_id WHERE d.a15 > 4047 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 37 ORDER BY district_loans DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.status IN (SELECT status FROM loan WHERE amount > 15153) AND t.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE amount > 78638) AND a.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 795476 GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1244939 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 229 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, client_count ASC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender AS client_gender, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 972015 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.a2, c.gender), (d.a2), (c.gender), ()) ORDER BY district_name, client_gender;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 371124 AND t.amount < 17160 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 220861 AND SUM(t.amount) < 1380324 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 442967 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type AS disposition_type, a.frequency, TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS account_open_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1990-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS loan_date, CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 'good' WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN 'bad' ELSE 'unknown' END AS loan_quality FROM loan l WHERE l.amount >= 560459 AND l.duration <= 105 ), transaction_summary AS ( SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.type) AS distinct_trans_types, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) AS distinct_symbols FROM trans t WHERE t.amount BETWEEN -68943 AND 43517 GROUP BY t.account_id ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, d.a15 AS urban_ratio, d.a16 AS avg_salary FROM district d WHERE d.a4 >= 190518 AND d.a16 <= 15740 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.k_symbol) AS distinct_order_types FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount >= 25822.5 GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_info AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count, STRING_AGG(c.type, ', ') AS card_types, MAX(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_card_issue FROM card c GROUP BY c.disp_id ) SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.disposition_type, ca.frequency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date) AS account_year, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.unemployment_rate, ds.entrepreneurs_rate, ds.urban_ratio, ds.avg_salary, la.loan_quality, ts.trans_count, ts.total_amount, ts.avg_amount, ts.max_balance, ts.min_balance, ts.distinct_trans_types, ts.distinct_symbols, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.avg_order_amount, oa.distinct_order_types, ci.card_count, ci.card_types, COUNT(la.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(la.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(la.loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT la.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE la.loan_quality = 'good') AS good_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT la.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE la.loan_quality = 'bad') AS bad_loans FROM client_accounts ca LEFT JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id LEFT JOIN transaction_summary ts ON ca.account_id = ts.account_id LEFT JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id LEFT JOIN card_info ci ON ca.disp_id = ci.disp_id WHERE ca.account_open_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.disposition_type, ca.frequency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date), ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.unemployment_rate, ds.entrepreneurs_rate, ds.urban_ratio, ds.avg_salary, la.loan_quality, ts.trans_count, ts.total_amount, ts.avg_amount, ts.max_balance, ts.min_balance, ts.distinct_trans_types, ts.distinct_symbols, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.avg_order_amount, oa.distinct_order_types, ci.card_count, ci.card_types), (ca.district_id, ca.disposition_type, ca.frequency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date), la.loan_quality), (ca.district_id, la.loan_quality), (ca.disposition_type, la.loan_quality), (ca.frequency, la.loan_quality), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date), la.loan_quality), (la.loan_quality), () ) HAVING COUNT(la.loan_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a1.account_id AS acct1, a2.account_id AS acct2, d1.a2 AS district1, d2.a2 AS district2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) AS loans_acct1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) AS loans_acct2, SUM(t1.amount) AS trans_total_acct1, SUM(t2.amount) AS trans_total_acct2, AVG(o1.amount) AS avg_order_amount, AVG(d1.a10) AS avg_crime_rate_dist1, AVG(d2.a10) AS avg_crime_rate_dist2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount) DESC) AS combined_trans_rank FROM account a1 JOIN account a2 ON a1.district_id = a2.district_id AND a1.account_id < a2.account_id JOIN district d1 ON a1.district_id = d1.district_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd1 ON dp1.disp_id = cd1.disp_id LEFT JOIN card cd2 ON dp2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 23301 AND l2.amount > 44976 AND t1.date >= '970101' AND t2.date >= '970101' AND o1.amount > 44227.14 AND d1.a10 > 190.23 AND d2.a10 > 187.45 GROUP BY a1.account_id, a2.account_id, d1.a2, d2.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) > 0 AND SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount) > 6767644 ORDER BY combined_trans_rank ASC, loans_acct1 DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status LIKE '%B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS district_account_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON (a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER') LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 104081 OR l.amount IS NULL) AND (o.amount > 9883.53 OR o.amount IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 54424 OR t.amount IS NULL) AND (d.a4 > 17431 OR d.a4 IS NULL) AND (d.a10 > 76.44 OR d.a10 IS NULL) AND (d.a13 > 38.6 OR d.a13 IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 99 AND SUM(l.amount) > 5813238 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 90103 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;
