SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_transaction_rank FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 99750.62 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 48 AND SUM(t.amount) > 1013763 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, district_transaction_rank ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 56934 AND l.duration > 78 AND t.amount > 20130 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 341393.54 AND d.a10 > 4209.92 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 21 AND SUM(t.amount) > 4167694 AND AVG(l.amount) > 456256 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 546934 AND t.date >= '970101' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 66 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS net_transaction_flow, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) FROM order1 o1 WHERE o1.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND o1.amount > 119482.2) AS high_value_orders_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 1797 AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 9 AND SUM(l.amount) > 1342778 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 820175 AND d.a10 < 5352.06 AND l.amount > 364615 AND t.amount > 319762 AND o.amount > 523413.87 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 1687 AND SUM(l.amount) > 4101498 AND SUM(t.amount) > 9229953 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 46;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (d.a4 > 6005 OR d.a5 < 7544) AND (c.gender = 'M' OR dp.type = 'OWNER') AND NOT (l.status = 'A') AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 29 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) BETWEEN 578030 AND 669554 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 598314 AND l.duration >= 34 AND l.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 82713 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 17 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS no_of_inhabitants, d.a5 AS no_of_municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 AS no_of_municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 AS no_of_municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 AS no_of_municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 AS no_of_cities, d.a10 AS ratio_urban_inhabitants, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 AS no_of_entrepreneurs_per_1000, d.a15 AS no_of_crimes_95, d.a16 AS no_of_crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_or_completed_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.account_id) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.amount > 765721 AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id)) AS high_value_transaction_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a11 > 41287 AND d.a12 < 0.14 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 341 AND SUM(l.amount) > 6727486 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a3 AS region_name, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_by_region FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 282196 AND l.duration >= 31 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a3, a.frequency HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 493487 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 14 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 79710 AND t.amount > 39262 GROUP BY l.account_id ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 61618 GROUP BY l.loan_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 48 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount > 549940 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 780804 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 81 INTERSECT SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 187167 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 371679;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) < 7964 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 3290 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 296187 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 80200) AS high_amount_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 17151 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND l.amount > 5475 AND l.duration > 39 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 84295 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(CASE WHEN d.type = 'OWNER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS owner_ratio, (SELECT MAX(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id) AS max_order_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 657832.6 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(t.amount) BETWEEN 51697.57 AND 159264.92 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS transaction_volume_category FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a10 > 181.73 AND (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('A', 'B')) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 10 AND SUM(t.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, a.district_id;

COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.type AS disposition_type, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE a.district_id = 55 AND (c.issued >= '1993-01-01' OR c.issued IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.type HAVING COUNT(c.card_id) <= 3 ORDER BY card_count DESC, a.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, t.trans_id, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 16873 AND a.district_id = 61 ORDER BY a.account_id, t.date::DATE;

SELECT a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.payments) AS max_loan_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'INSURANCE PAYMENT' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_insurance_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS trans_rank, SUM(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS district_total_amount, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a4) AS avg_trans_per_region FROM account a JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 330867 AND d.a10 > 8505.32 AND o.amount < 382020.01 GROUP BY a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 9423420 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 476 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, amount_rank;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.account_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 83005 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 36117 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, c.client_id, c.gender, dp.type AS disp_type, COALESCE(cd.type, 'No Card') AS card_type, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 AND SUM(l.amount) > 353434 THEN 'High Loan Account' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 0 AND SUM(o.amount) > 54917.36 THEN 'High Order Account' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 0 AND SUM(t.amount) > 804709 THEN 'High Trans Account' ELSE 'Standard Account' END AS account_category, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 0.88 THEN 'High Urban Ratio' WHEN d.a11 > 11130 THEN 'High Avg Salary' WHEN d.a12 > 0.06 THEN 'High Unemployment Rate' ELSE 'Normal District' END AS district_category, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_bad_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO', 'LEASING', 'UVER') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_standing_orders FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1970-01-01' AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, c.client_id, c.gender, dp.type, cd.type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 3 OR COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 50 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_order_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_trans_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, l.loan_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 50841 AND t.amount < -88399 GROUP BY a.account_id, l.loan_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 636046 AND l.duration = 34 GROUP BY a.district_id UNION ALL SELECT d.district_id, 0 AS loan_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 321220.26 GROUP BY d.district_id;

SELECT a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS distinct_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS distinct_cards, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MIN(t.date) AS earliest_trans_date, MAX(t.date) AS latest_trans_date, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS credit_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.gender ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_gender_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 79823 AND t.amount > 51815 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 > 98.29 AND d.a11 > 949 GROUP BY a.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 455 AND SUM(l.amount) > 836619 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, distinct_loans DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, a.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration AS loan_duration, t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, o.order_id, o.amount AS order_amount, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_trans_total, AVG(o.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.district_id) AS avg_order_amount_by_district, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.amount > 387133 AND l2.date >= '1993-01-01') AS high_loan_count, (SELECT SUM(t2.amount) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-01-01') AS trans_sum_in_period, MAX(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS max_loan_in_district FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 58736 AND t.amount > 90782 AND o.amount > 10063.39 AND d.a4 > 9142 AND d.a10 > 78.43 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, a.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, t.trans_id, t.amount, o.order_id, o.amount, t.date, l.date HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 245957 AND COUNT(o.order_id) > 12 ORDER BY running_trans_total DESC, avg_order_amount_by_district DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND a.frequency LIKE 'POPLATEK MESICNE' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 955 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 10772 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district, (SELECT MIN(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.k_symbol = 'INSURANCE') AS min_insurance_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards_count FROM district d INNER JOIN client c1 ON d.district_id = c1.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON c1.client_id = dp.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE d.a15 > 7720 AND CAST(a.date AS DATE) >= CAST('1993-01-01' AS DATE) AND t.amount > 24270 AND l.duration BETWEEN 55 AND 44 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, l.amount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 74 AND SUM(t.amount) > 248720 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC, total_credits DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS crime_rate_95, d.a11 AS crime_rate_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS repaid_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B','D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS defaulted_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a10 > 3390.87 AND d.a11 > 4323.62 AND (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 817856 OR t.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a10, d.a11 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 584 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 313 AND SUM(t.amount) > 41997339 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a15 AS urban_inhabitants, d.a16 AS avg_salary, COUNT(c1.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(c2.client_id) AS female_clients, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(c2.client_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(c1.client_id), 0), 2) AS female_percentage FROM district d JOIN client c1 ON d.district_id = c1.district_id JOIN client c2 ON d.district_id = c2.district_id AND c2.gender = 'F' WHERE d.a15 > 3332 AND d.a16 > 11615 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(c1.client_id) > 70 ORDER BY female_percentage DESC, d.district_id;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_cards, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 7373 AND d.a10 < 991.83 AND l.amount > 276771 AND t.amount > 74834 AND o.amount > 79102.17 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 977 AND SUM(l.amount) > 29192 AND SUM(t.amount) > 5787044 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC LIMIT 815;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, a.account_id, c.client_id, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_amount, COALESCE(AVG(t.amount), 0) AS avg_transaction_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) AS total_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(AVG(l.amount), 0) AS avg_loan_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount, COALESCE(AVG(o.amount), 0) AS avg_order_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id), 0) AS total_cards, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) DESC) AS transaction_rank_in_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS overall_loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) DESC) AS order_rank_in_region FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND c.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d.a10 >= 207.91 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id, c.client_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) > 266630.23 AND COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) >= 2.84 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS inhabitants, d.a5 AS muni_lt_499, d.a6 AS muni_500_1999, d.a7 AS muni_2000_9999, d.a8 AS muni_gt_10000, d.a9 AS cities, d.a10 AS urban_ratio, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemp_95, d.a13 AS unemp_96, d.a14 AS entrepreneurs, d.a15 AS crimes_95, d.a16 AS crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank, SUM(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS cumulative_loan_amount_by_region FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 786098 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 90256 AND d.a11 > 11955 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 52 AND SUM(t.amount) > 8526217 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 60;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS population, d.a5 AS num_cities, d.a6 AS urban_ratio, d.a7 AS avg_salary, d.a8 AS unemployment_rate, d.a9 AS crime_rate, d.a10 AS avg_loan_amount, d.a11 AS num_entrepreneurs, d.a12 AS num_companies, d.a13 AS num_crimes, d.a14 AS num_crimes_prev, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount_per_loan, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_account_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_account_balance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense, (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS net_flow, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'gold' THEN cd.card_id END) AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'classic' THEN cd.card_id END) AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'junior' THEN cd.card_id END) AS junior_cards FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE ( (d.a4 > 29452 AND d.a5 < 19) OR (d.a6 BETWEEN 0.39 AND 0.97) OR (d.a7 > 20743 AND d.a8 < 1) ) AND ( l.amount > 36725 AND l.duration >= 19 AND (l.status = 'A' OR l.status = 'B' OR l.status = 'C') ) AND ( t.amount > 2076 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-02-01' AND (t.type = 'PRIJEM' OR t.type = 'VYDAJ') AND t.operation IN ('VYBER KARTOU', 'VKLAD', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') ) AND ( o.amount > 457.18 AND o.k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO', 'LEASING', 'UVER') ) AND NOT ( c.birth_date < '1930-01-01' AND c.gender = 'M' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 905 AND SUM(l.amount) > 487269 AND AVG(o.amount) < 1406.03 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, net_flow DESC LIMIT 49;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 6.04 THEN 'High Unemployment' WHEN d.a10 > 3.32 THEN 'Medium Unemployment' ELSE 'Low Unemployment' END AS unemployment_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 THEN SUM(l.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) ELSE 0 END AS avg_loan_per_loan, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 0 THEN SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) ELSE 0 END AS avg_transaction_per_transaction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_percent_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 615077 AND t.amount > 75146 AND d.a4 > 69979 AND d.a11 > 1395 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 894 AND SUM(l.amount) > 3179881 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d1.district_id, d1.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.account_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_count FROM district d1 JOIN account a ON d1.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district d2 ON dp.client_id = d2.a14 WHERE l.amount > 40609 AND l.duration > 54 GROUP BY d1.district_id, d1.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.account_id) > 10 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 104487 AND t.amount < 63956 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 636510 AND l.amount > 328403 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 7395512 INTERSECT SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.duration > 17 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 768 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 109294 AND d.a4 > 184814 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 132044 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC LIMIT 53;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date AS loan_date, l.status, AVG(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_30day_trans_before_loan, COUNT(t.trans_id) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_30day_trans_before_loan FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 982858 AND l.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date::DATE >= (l.date::DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') AND t.date::DATE <= l.date::DATE GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status, t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, t.trans_id ORDER BY l.loan_id;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS loans_in_district, SUM(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS total_loan_amount_in_district FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 737170 AND l.duration > 56 UNION ALL SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, NULL AS duration, NULL AS payments, t.type AS status, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS trans_in_district, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS total_trans_amount_in_district FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.amount > 960169 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ORDER BY district_id, loan_amount DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount > 968383 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 338526 GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

WITH account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.trans_id END) AS credit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE t.amount > 40267 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 30676.36 AND l.amount > 338189 AND dist.a4 > 7296 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_summary AS ( SELECT am.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS active_accounts, SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) AS district_total_transactions, SUM(am.total_order_amount) AS district_total_orders, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transaction_count, SUM(am.order_count) AS district_order_count, SUM(am.loan_count) AS district_loan_count FROM account_metrics am GROUP BY am.district_id HAVING SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) > 77687807.8 AND SUM(am.total_loan_amount) > 42676026.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) >= 292 ) SELECT ds.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, ds.active_accounts, ds.district_total_transactions, ds.district_total_orders, ds.district_total_loans, ds.district_avg_balance, ds.district_transaction_count, ds.district_order_count, ds.district_loan_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.district_total_transactions DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.district_total_loans DESC) AS loan_rank, (ds.district_total_transactions / NULLIF(ds.district_total_loans, 0)) AS transaction_to_loan_ratio FROM district_summary ds JOIN district d ON ds.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 3634 AND d.a5 > 5129 ORDER BY ds.district_total_transactions DESC, ds.district_total_loans DESC LIMIT 24;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, a.frequency, TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as account_open_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as loan_date, l.status, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) as transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as num_inhabitants, d.a5 as num_municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 as num_municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 as num_municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 as num_municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 as num_cities, d.a10 as ratio_urban_inhabitants, d.a11 as avg_salary, d.a12 as unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 as unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 as entrepreneurs_per_1000, d.a15 as num_crimes_95, d.a16 as num_crimes_96 FROM district d ), order_aggregates AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as
