SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND o.amount > 48754.92) AS large_orders_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank_by_region FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 1868 AND d.a10 < 50.46 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 70 AND SUM(l.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') AS male_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'F') AS female_clients, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.amount > 872228 AND t.amount > 60020 AND o1.amount > 60466.12 AND d.a15 > 92 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1413052 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 52 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS unique_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS unique_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS unique_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS unique_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(CAST(a.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_account_year, MAX(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_loan_year, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_trans_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 486623 OR l.amount IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 79712 OR t.amount IS NULL) AND (o.amount > 23109.08 OR o.amount IS NULL) AND (CAST(a.date AS INTEGER) >= 948655 OR a.date IS NULL) AND (CAST(l.date AS INTEGER) >= 949537 OR l.date IS NULL) AND (CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) >= 958000 OR t.date IS NULL) AND d.a10 > 5062.77 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) > 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 5229 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, unique_accounts DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 1888 AND t.amount > 3659 AND o.amount > 8346.51 AND d.a4 > 4346 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 463948 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 73 AND AVG(l.amount) > 40343 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 987294 AND t.amount > 64297 AND l.duration > 58 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1998 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 49 AND SUM(t.amount) > 9893257 AND AVG(l.amount) > 261671 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1984 AND 1984 GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 64 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 209355 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, MAX(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_loan_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) FILTER (WHERE ca.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE CAST(date AS INTEGER) >= '19930101' AND district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE a10 > 53.88 ) ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 128846 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 11 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 40411 AND l.duration < 27 AND l.status = 'A' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 178679 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'classic') AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_percentile FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE (t.date >= '930101' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (l.date >= '930101' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' OR o.k_symbol IS NULL) AND d.a10 > 3380.97 AND cl.birth_date < '1960-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 1994 AND 1998 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 443 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 258171 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, total_credits DESC LIMIT 214;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.payments ELSE NULL END) AS avg_active_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_transactions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS rank_by_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 586 AND l.date >= '930101' AND t.date >= '930101' AND l.amount > 460311 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 49 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 825734 UNION ALL SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC) AS rank_by_order_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 4604 AND o.amount > 8311.63 AND ca.issued >= '930101' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 935 AND SUM(o.amount) > 290225.7 ORDER BY district_id, rank_by_accounts;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a16 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(l.amount) / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS loan_to_transaction_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.bank_to = 'AB' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a16, d.a10, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 222501 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 22 AND SUM(t.amount) > 770833 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 3159 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a16 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(l.amount) / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS loan_to_transaction_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.bank_to = 'AB' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a16, d.a10, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 582184 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 57 AND SUM(t.amount) > 524467 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 6296 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS inhabitants, d.a10 AS urban_ratio, d.a12 AS avg_salary, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_closed_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) DESC) AS client_count_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a10 >= 0.98 AND d.a12 >= 18809.64 AND l.amount > 229357 AND t.amount > 46090 AND o.amount > 80635.65 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 619 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 4363 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 833 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS problematic_loans, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND t.date > '1998-01-01' AND t.amount > 840951) AS recent_high_trans_sum, (SELECT AVG(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id IN (SELECT a3.account_id FROM account a3 WHERE a3.district_id = d.district_id) AND o.amount > 15143.38) AS avg_large_order_amount FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 53015 AND d.a10 < 97.63 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 352 AND AVG(l.amount) < 95935 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC, avg_loan_amount ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status LIKE '%B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS district_loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS district_account_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON (a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER') LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 50785 OR l.amount IS NULL) AND (o.amount > 85614.52 OR o.amount IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 67297 OR t.amount IS NULL) AND (d.a4 > 1113 OR d.a4 IS NULL) AND (d.a10 > 78.26 OR d.a10 IS NULL) AND (d.a13 > 32.37 OR d.a13 IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 305 AND SUM(l.amount) > 7499675 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 6736 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, a.district_id, a.frequency, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_crime_rate, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 20172 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 <= 0.86 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, a.district_id, a.frequency, d.a4, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 61 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date AS loan_date, l.status, AVG(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_30day_trans_before_loan, COUNT(t.trans_id) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_30day_trans_before_loan FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 614481 AND l.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date::DATE >= (l.date::DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') AND t.date::DATE <= l.date::DATE GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status, t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, t.trans_id ORDER BY l.loan_id;

SELECT s.district_id, s.a2 AS district_name, s.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards, MAX(CAST(s.a10 AS numeric)) AS avg_salary, MAX(s.a13) AS unemployment_rate_95, MAX(s.a14) AS unemployment_rate_96, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district s JOIN client c ON s.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON d.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= DATE '1998-01-01' + INTERVAL '148' DAY AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= DATE '1998-01-01' + INTERVAL '932' DAY AND CAST(o.amount AS integer) > 213210.3 AND s.a10 > 33941.59 AND s.a13 < 2.74 GROUP BY s.district_id, s.a2, s.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1047380 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 621336 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transactions DESC LIMIT 98;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_amount FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 48247 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

WITH account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.trans_id END) AS credit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE t.amount > 66940 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 19930.92 AND l.amount > 419918 AND dist.a4 > 7055 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_summary AS ( SELECT am.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS active_accounts, SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) AS district_total_transactions, SUM(am.total_order_amount) AS district_total_orders, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transaction_count, SUM(am.order_count) AS district_order_count, SUM(am.loan_count) AS district_loan_count FROM account_metrics am GROUP BY am.district_id HAVING SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) > 40899363.51 AND SUM(am.total_loan_amount) > 19388659.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) >= 459 ) SELECT ds.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, ds.active_accounts, ds.district_total_transactions, ds.district_total_orders, ds.district_total_loans, ds.district_avg_balance, ds.district_transaction_count, ds.district_order_count, ds.district_loan_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.district_total_transactions DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.district_total_loans DESC) AS loan_rank, (ds.district_total_transactions / NULLIF(ds.district_total_loans, 0)) AS transaction_to_loan_ratio FROM district_summary ds JOIN district d ON ds.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 2201 AND d.a5 > 7253 ORDER BY ds.district_total_transactions DESC, ds.district_total_loans DESC LIMIT 28;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) < 5286 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 690447 ) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) <= 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 25 AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 346904) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) <= 3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 74 AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 13754) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) <= 5 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 13227 OR l.amount IS NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) < 182071 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount, MIN(l.amount) AS min_loan_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) DESC) AS card_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT t2.account_id FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.amount > 886362 AND t2.balance < 111097) AND l.amount > 247502 AND d.a10 > 14762.67 AND d.a12 < 9.67 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2, d.a10, d.a12 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 7096753 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, card_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.payments) AS max_loan_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'INSURANCE PAYMENT' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_insurance_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS trans_rank, SUM(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS district_total_amount, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a4) AS avg_trans_per_region FROM account a JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 182604 AND d.a10 > 3653.61 AND o.amount < 171161.26 GROUP BY a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 9444725 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 527 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, amount_rank;

SELECT a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_trans_amount, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount, AVG(di.a10) AS avg_district_unemploy_rate_95, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, MAX(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS latest_trans_date, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) DESC) AS order_amount_percentile FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' WHERE CAST(a.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a4 > 8076 AND (CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) > 90481 AND COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) > 623067 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) >= 4 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, 'account' AS source_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id >= 6 AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '930101') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id UNION ALL SELECT c.client_id, cl.district_id, 'client' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS record_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM client c JOIN district cl ON c.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dc ON c.client_id = dc.client_id JOIN trans t ON dc.account_id = t.account_id WHERE c.district_id >= 76 AND t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY c.client_id, cl.district_id ORDER BY district_id, source_type;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 64298 AND d.a4 > 9748 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id ORDER BY loan_count DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(o1.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS withdrawal_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.amount > 294599 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount < 91679.13 AND d.a10 > 8372.75 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 5610276 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 32148 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 43079.0 AND 195891.0 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND d.a10 >= 28.68 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 64776.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 54.94 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND l.status = 'A' AND o.bank_to = 'CS' AND d.a12 >= 95.95 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) < 76961.07 AND SUM(o.amount) <= 36936.27;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 = 748 AND l.amount > 97829 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a4 AS num_inhabitants, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a4 > 348051) AS avg_amount_by_population_segment FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration >= 41 AND l.amount > 85649 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a4, l.amount HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 828904 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 82219 OR l.amount IS NULL) AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND NOT (c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d.a4 > 842) GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 13 AND SUM(t.amount) < 667792 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 257311 AND t.amount < 46708 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 338778 AND SUM(t.amount) < 4405544 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 814054 AND t.amount < 43623 AND d.a4 > 1752 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) = 1995 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 198141 AND SUM(t.amount) < 2132887 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 11626 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 11 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 41037 AND l.duration >= 30 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 382143 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(lo.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON di.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE t.amount > 25366 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND lo.duration > 30 AND o1.amount < 6624.38 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, lo.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 13681 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 27 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a4) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district_region FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 369657 AND l.duration = 50 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 25 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a4) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district_region FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 92314 AND l.duration = 22 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 12 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL OR t.date IS NULL GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 80284 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 1964 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 57;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a3 AS region_name, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_by_region FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 343357 AND l.duration >= 17 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a3, a.frequency HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 461570 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 26 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a3 AS region_name, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_by_region FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 82651 AND l.duration >= 19 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a3, a.frequency HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 311318 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 29 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 35283 AND l.duration > 53 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.amount HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, a.date AS account_date, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance, t.date AS trans_date, t.type AS trans_type, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, o.order_id, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol AS order_symbol, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_trans, COUNT(t.trans_id) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id, t.type ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS recent_trans_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 71661.73 AND t.amount > 7459.2 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 > 120.53 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, a.date, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, l.date, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.date, t.type, t.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, o.order_id, o.amount, o.k_symbol HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 368492.37 ORDER BY a.account_id, l.date, t.date;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS distinct_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS distinct_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS distinct_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_credit_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_sipo_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) DESC) AS client_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 767605 AND d.a10 > 868462.33 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 8410 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 9256 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) > 766584 ORDER BY distinct_accounts DESC, distinct_clients DESC LIMIT 384;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS avg_withdrawal, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.balance) DESC) AS balance_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 34463 AND l.duration >= 20 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.balance) > 845974 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 47 ORDER BY total_balance DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS deposit_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_percentile, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemploy_rate_95, SUM(d.a16) AS total_crimes_95 FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 11999 AND d.a11 < 2933 AND (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 391012 OR t.amount IS NULL) AND (o1.amount > 632641.3 OR o1.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 8923 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 35031 ORDER BY total_deposits DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS high_loan_clients FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = dp.account_id AND l.amount > 400528 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 12 ORDER BY high_loan_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 22959.64 AND t.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE status = 'A')) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 89.49 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 558905 AND t.amount > 27986 AND o.amount > 95139.53 AND d.a4 > 4179 AND d.a5 > 5534 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 6652810 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 93 AND AVG(l.amount) > 167900 AND SUM(t.amount) > 3410133 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 707 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 34560 AND t.amount < 37163 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1995 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 351569 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 26 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 144875 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 77 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 715718 AND l.duration > 22 AND t.amount > 87770 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.amount > ( SELECT AVG(t3.amount) * 2.35 FROM trans t3 WHERE t3.account_id IN ( SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id WHERE dp2.type = 'OWNER' ) ) ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 125 AND SUM(l.amount) > 9816435 AND AVG(t.amount) > 5511 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 66083 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 5 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, ROUND(SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0), 2) AS amount_per_transaction, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_transaction_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND l.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 610789 AND l.amount > 342913 AND o.amount > 11722.11 AND d.a10 > 234.03 AND d.a12 > 448.67 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 678 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 AND SUM(t.amount) > 8904521 AND SUM(l.amount) > 1850140 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, district_transaction_rank ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, a.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS sipo_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS loan_rank_in_district, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district d JOIN client cl ON d.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a16 > 2315 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date <= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id, a.frequency HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 975 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 16797 ORDER BY total_income DESC, loan_rank_in_district;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_transaction_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, SUM(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id, c.gender) AS district_gender_loan_total FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 417939 AND CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 939612 AND 934818 AND d.a15 > 9585 AND o.amount < 56905.13 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 53 AND AVG(t.amount) > 58931 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 52;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS population, d.a5 AS num_cities, d.a6 AS urban_ratio, d.a7 AS avg_salary, d.a8 AS unemployment_rate, d.a9 AS crime_rate, d.a10 AS avg_loan_amount, d.a11 AS num_entrepreneurs, d.a12 AS num_companies, d.a13 AS num_crimes, d.a14 AS num_crimes_prev, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount_per_loan, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_account_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_account_balance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense, (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS net_flow, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'gold' THEN cd.card_id END) AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'classic' THEN cd.card_id END) AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'junior' THEN cd.card_id END) AS junior_cards FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE ( (d.a4 > 30749 AND d.a5 < 19) OR (d.a6 BETWEEN 0.19 AND 0.63) OR (d.a7 > 48324 AND d.a8 < 5) ) AND ( l.amount > 89692 AND l.duration >= 60 AND (l.status = 'A' OR l.status = 'B' OR l.status = 'C') ) AND ( t.amount > 1874 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-02-01' AND (t.type = 'PRIJEM' OR t.type = 'VYDAJ') AND t.operation IN ('VYBER KARTOU', 'VKLAD', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') ) AND ( o.amount > 3547.37 AND o.k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO', 'LEASING', 'UVER') ) AND NOT ( c.birth_date < '1930-01-01' AND c.gender = 'M' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 247 AND SUM(l.amount) > 863432 AND AVG(o.amount) < 881.62 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, net_flow DESC LIMIT 32;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_by_district, SUM(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3) AS running_total_loans_by_region FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 534583 AND t.amount > 49916 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a16 >= 79680 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4077221 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 5753 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a4, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 73667 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= CAST('1993-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 INTERSECT SELECT d.district_id, d.a4, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 10711 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= CAST('1993-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 24 ORDER BY district_id, a4;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 76226 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 541432) AS high_value_transactions FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dist.a4 > 3187 AND l.duration >= 15 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 234247 AND d.a4 > 9015 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, 'account' AS source_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.district_id >= 46 AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '930101') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id UNION ALL SELECT c.client_id, cl.district_id, 'client' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS record_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM client c JOIN district cl ON c.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dc ON c.client_id = dc.client_id JOIN trans t ON dc.account_id = t.account_id WHERE c.district_id >= 62 AND t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY c.client_id, cl.district_id ORDER BY district_id, source_type;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 3 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10, l.amount AS loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 181156) AS high_trans_count, SUM(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.loan_id) AS cumulative_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 > 7.28 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10, l.amount, l.loan_id HAVING l.amount > 480418 ORDER BY cumulative_loan_per_district DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_per_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 253707 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount < 5958.24 AND d.a10 > 1664.85 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 6817842 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 448 ORDER BY trans_amount_rank, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS order_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_crime_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_unemployment FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.amount > 441443 AND t.amount > 80186 AND o1.amount > 84545.39 AND d.a10 > 41.76 AND d.a12 > 1.43 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 8 AND SUM(t.amount) > 350972 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) > 18 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS order_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_crime_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_unemployment FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.duration > 52 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND d.a4 > 4018 AND d.a5 > 4179 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.payments) > 6080.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 893 AND SUM(o1.amount) > 455385.77 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 123082 AND d.a10 < 64.84 AND l.amount >= 238085 AND l.duration <= 19 AND o.amount > 872879.95 AND t.amount >= 240971 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 351 AND SUM(l.amount) < 6588333 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS rank_by_accounts, SUM(o1.amount) FILTER (WHERE o1.k_symbol LIKE '%POJ%') AS total_symbol_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FILTER (WHERE c.type = 'classic') AS card_count_by_type, CORR(l.duration, l.payments) AS correlation_duration_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, MIN(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS earliest_trans_date, MAX(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS latest_trans_date FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.amount > 362046 AND t.amount BETWEEN 88698 AND 715750 AND cl.birth_date >= '1970-01-01' AND d.a10 > 83.73 AND (t.bank LIKE 'AB%' OR t.operation LIKE '%VKLAD%') GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 39 AND AVG(l.amount) < 188535 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.82 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC, avg_loan_amount ASC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 167387 AND o.amount > 403823.76 AND t.amount > 91567 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 44 AND SUM(l.amount) <= 6769990 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 491394 AND l.duration > 28 AND d.a16 > 3370 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 914971 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 12623 AND l.duration = 17 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > (SELECT AVG(loan_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_count FROM loan GROUP BY account_id) sub) ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 857189 AND l.duration >= 40 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 25 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender AS client_gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS loan_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 928654 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.a2, c.gender, loan_year), (d.a2, c.gender), (d.a2, loan_year), (c.gender, loan_year), (d.a2), (c.gender), (loan_year), () ) ORDER BY d.a2, c.gender, loan_year;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(COALESCE(o.amount, 0)) AS avg_order_amount, (SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.date >= '980101') AS recent_loan_total, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT') AS debit_trans_count, MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance, MIN(d.a10) AS min_crime_rate, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_salary, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_id = a.account_id AND o2.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT MAX(t2.date) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.amount > 340375) AS last_large_trans_date, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'))) AS avg_birth_year, SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) AS avg_amount_per_transaction FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE t.date BETWEEN '970101' AND '970101' AND a.date >= '930101' AND d.a10 > 106.84 AND l.amount > 813358 GROUP BY d.a2, c.gender, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 1843061 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 271 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, account_count DESC LIMIT 603;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 22560.43) AS high_value_orders_per_account, (SELECT AVG(l2.payments) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.duration > 23) AS avg_payment_for_long_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' WHERE d.a4 > 37785 AND d.a10 < 3.53 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 AND SUM(t.amount) < 605184 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COALESCE(sub.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count, COALESCE(sub.avg_loan_amount, 0) AS avg_loan_amount, COALESCE(sub.max_trans_balance, 0) AS max_trans_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sub.avg_loan_amount, 0) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sub.loan_count, 0) DESC) AS loan_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(sub2.max_balance) AS max_trans_balance FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.account_id, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance FROM trans t WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 265110 GROUP BY t.account_id ) sub2 ON a.account_id = sub2.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 195549 GROUP BY a.district_id ) sub ON d.district_id = sub.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 69308 AND d.a10 < 64.24 ORDER BY loan_count DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS district_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 231893.71 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 395297.02 AND t.amount > 13795.52 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 32.44 AND SUM(l.amount) > 1339633.3 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;
