RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 219608 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 23910.82 AND 88123.15 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE c2.birth_date >= '1970-01-01' AND l2.amount > 841314 AND l2.duration >= 36 GROUP BY a2.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) >= 8 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 76 AND SUM(l.amount) > 5001362 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC, total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 55;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.status = 'A') AS loan_status_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 6235 AND l.date >= '930101' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 132056 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AS total_accounts_in_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 772602 AND l.duration >= 31 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 55 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date AS trans_date, t.amount, t.balance, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 582733 AND t.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01' ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date::DATE;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_crime_rate, d.a12 AS district_unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS district_entrepreneurs_rate FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN card c ON dsp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT account_id, district_id, transaction_count, total_transaction_amount, avg_balance, loan_count, total_loan_amount, order_count, total_order_amount, card_count, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC ) AS district_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_population > 101914 ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC ) AS population_percentile, LAG(total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC ) AS prev_account_transaction_amount, LEAD(avg_balance, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_unemployment_rate > 9.77 ORDER BY avg_balance DESC ) AS next_account_avg_balance FROM account_stats WHERE total_loan_amount > 179960 AND transaction_count >= 866 ) SELECT district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(*) AS high_value_accounts, AVG(total_transaction_amount) AS avg_high_value_transactions, SUM(total_loan_amount) AS total_high_value_loans, AVG(total_order_amount) AS avg_high_value_orders, MAX(transaction_count) AS max_transactions, MIN(avg_balance) AS min_avg_balance, CORR(total_transaction_amount, total_loan_amount) AS trans_loan_correlation, STDDEV(total_order_amount) AS order_amount_stddev FROM ranked_accounts WHERE district_rank <= 13 AND population_percentile >= 0.54 GROUP BY district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 13 AND AVG(total_transaction_amount) > 9758946 AND SUM(total_loan_amount) >= 4394384 ORDER BY total_high_value_loans DESC, avg_high_value_transactions DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a10 > 0.11 AND d.a12 > 8864 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 112 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.amount > 87801 AND (l.amount > 130774 OR l.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 15245.1 OR o.amount IS NULL GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS financial_clients, SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 448022) AS high_amount_loans_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND dist.a4 > 23224 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 99327 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 84842 AND o.amount > 36061.37 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, MAX(CAST(l.duration AS DECIMAL)) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(CAST(l.payments AS DECIMAL)) AS min_loan_payment FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 573826 AND t.amount > 69958 AND o.amount > 215874.86 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 40304756 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 133 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, a.frequency AS account_frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND t.k_symbol LIKE 'INSURANCE PAYMENT' AND o.k_symbol LIKE 'INSURANCE PAYMENT' AND d.a3 LIKE 'central Bohemia' AND l.amount > 247951 AND t.amount > 35287 AND o.amount > 45139.79 AND l.duration >= 48 AND t.balance > 923332 GROUP BY d.a2, a.frequency, d.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 9 AND SUM(l.amount) > 2207105 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 731 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_loans DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (d.a4 > 8837 OR d.a5 < 2333) AND (c.gender = 'M' OR dp.type = 'OWNER') AND NOT (l.status = 'A') AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 71 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) BETWEEN 660790 AND 151657 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_year FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 1997 AND 1996 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 59 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 31 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, ROUND(SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0), 2) AS amount_per_transaction, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_transaction_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '970101' AND l.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 153525 AND l.amount > 276893 AND o.amount > 47108.26 AND d.a10 > 100.82 AND d.a12 > 216.81 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 155 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 4 AND SUM(t.amount) > 879893 AND SUM(l.amount) > 974238 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, district_transaction_rank ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(d.a10) AS total_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_average_salary, SUM(d.a13) AS total_entrepeneurs_per_1000, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.amount) AS median_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC) AS order_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 4738 AND d.a5 > 4614 AND d.a6 > 6930 AND d.a7 > 9733 AND d.a8 > 8359 AND d.a9 > 6341 AND d.a10 > 64.34 AND d.a11 > 3976 AND d.a12 > 28542.72 AND d.a13 > 7072.15 AND d.a14 > 1928 AND d.a15 > 9323 AND d.a16 > 2306 AND l.amount > 855095 AND l.duration > 19 AND l.payments > 3457.13 AND t.amount > 424516 AND t.balance > 900279 AND o.amount > 387151.48 AND c.birth_date < '1900-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 576 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 913 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 627 AND SUM(l.amount) > 6651056 AND SUM(t.amount) > 5433250 AND SUM(o.amount) > 9870835.55 AND AVG(l.amount) > 177267 AND AVG(t.amount) > 687552 AND AVG(o.amount) > 657322.7 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a4 AS region_population, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_balance) FROM (SELECT t2.account_id, AVG(t2.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.date >= '970101' GROUP BY t2.account_id) sub WHERE sub.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id)) AS avg_account_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.status = 'A' AND l2.account_id IN (SELECT a3.account_id FROM account a3 WHERE a3.district_id = d.district_id AND a3.date <= '970101')) AS active_loans_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 148597 AND d.a10 < 19764.48 AND a.date <= '970101' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a4, d.a10 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 214214 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 67 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 574981 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) < 82923.1 ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_active_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a11 > 4580 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 57 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT di.district_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a10 AS crime_rate_95, di.a11 AS crime_rate_96, AVG(lo.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(tr.amount) AS total_transacted, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_holders_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ord.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(lo.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY di.district_id) AS district_total_loans, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(tr.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district di JOIN client cl ON di.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account ac ON dp.account_id = ac.account_id JOIN loan lo ON ac.account_id = lo.account_id JOIN trans tr ON ac.account_id = tr.account_id JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id JOIN order1 ord ON ac.account_id = ord.account_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan lo2 WHERE lo2.account_id = ac.account_id AND lo2.amount > 271546 AND lo2.status = 'A') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trans tr2 WHERE tr2.account_id = ac.account_id AND tr2.amount > 147326 AND tr2.date >= '1993-01-01') AND di.a10 > 59.07 AND di.a11 > 86 AND lo.amount > 43955 AND tr.amount > 256733 AND ord.amount > 8655.21 GROUP BY di.district_id, di.a2, di.a10, di.a11, lo.amount HAVING AVG(lo.amount) > 41295 AND SUM(tr.amount) > 708638 ORDER BY total_transacted DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_in_district FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 275576 AND l.duration > 17 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 9453 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2, l.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 57973864 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(CAST(l.amount AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(l.duration, 0)) AS avg_monthly_loan_payment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 934207 AND l.duration >= 49 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 620954 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_amount FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 42918 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d GROUP BY d.district_id ), client_loan_analysis AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 467942 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ), account_trans_summary AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 19327 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), complex_metrics AS ( SELECT cla.client_id, cla.district_id, cla.loan_count, cla.total_loan_amount, cla.avg_loan_duration, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card cd JOIN disp dsp ON cd.disp_id = dsp.disp_id WHERE dsp.client_id = cla.client_id AND cd.type = '{{p4}}') AS card_count, (SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM order1 o JOIN account ac ON o.account_id = ac.account_id JOIN disp dsp ON ac.account_id = dsp.account_id WHERE dsp.client_id = cla.client_id AND o.amount > 309531.53) AS total_order_amount FROM client_loan_analysis cla JOIN district_stats ds ON cla.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE cla.total_loan_amount > 113707 ) SELECT cm.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(cm.loan_count) AS total_loans, AVG(cm.total_loan_amount) AS avg_loan_per_client, MAX(cm.avg_unemployment_rate) AS max_unemployment_rate, SUM(cm.total_crimes) AS district_crimes, SUM(cm.card_count) AS total_cards, SUM(cm.total_order_amount) AS total_orders_amount, (SELECT AVG(ats.avg_balance) FROM account_trans_summary ats WHERE ats.district_id = cm.district_id AND ats.total_transaction_amount > 278914) AS district_avg_balance FROM complex_metrics cm GROUP BY cm.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.client_id) > 8 AND SUM(cm.total_loan_amount) > 9349758 ORDER BY total_loans DESC, district_avg_balance DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 2653 AND d.a5 < 876 GROUP BY d.district_id ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 69138 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 12978.39 OR ca.type = '{{p6}}' GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_account_transaction, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_total, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.card_count) AS total_cards, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_salary) AS salary_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 671597 AND cf.disposition_count >= 2 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 87660 AND SUM(cf.order_count) > 29 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, salary_percentile ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 221987) AS high_amount_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 86 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 236256 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 293866 ) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 313744 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '970101' AND t.amount > 317971 ) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) <= 7 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, c.gender, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS insurance_payments_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a2 ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_trans_rank FROM account a JOIN client c ON c.district_id = a.district_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON o.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1994-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1994-01-01' AND t.amount > 805884 AND l.amount > 265234 AND d.a15 > 3335 GROUP BY a.account_id, c.gender, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 9589302.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 84 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, c.gender, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'UVER' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS loan_payments_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a2 ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_trans_rank FROM account a JOIN client c ON c.district_id = a.district_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON o.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1994-01-01' AND t.date <= '1995-01-01' AND l.date >= '1994-01-01' AND l.date <= '1995-01-01' AND t.amount > 278426 AND l.amount > 552779 AND d.a15 > 4701 GROUP BY a.account_id, c.gender, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 16189621.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 196 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 590184 AND d.a4 > 8508 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10, l.amount AS loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 976879) AS high_trans_count, SUM(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.loan_id) AS cumulative_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 > 8.11 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10, l.amount, l.loan_id HAVING l.amount > 378339 ORDER BY cumulative_loan_per_district DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT AVG(trans.amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'CREDIT') AS avg_credit_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 783387 AND l.duration >= 34 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, l.status, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount >= 38463 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a.account_id, d.district_id, l.status), (d.district_id, l.status), (l.status), ()) ORDER BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.status;

SELECT a.account_id, l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 17054 AND t.amount > 5938 GROUP BY a.account_id, l.loan_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 33921 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 952120 AND l.duration > 44 AND t.amount > 38262 AND d.a14 > 5896 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 5 AND SUM(l.amount) > 165853 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(crd.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN card crd ON dp.disp_id = crd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE o.amount > 35556.03 AND t.balance < -600676 AND d.a10 > 81.65 AND crd.type = 'classic' GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(crd.card_id) > 5 AND SUM(o.amount) > 397310.59 ORDER BY district_id, client_id;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 605757 AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE')) GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 738820 AND l.duration >= 33 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 424661 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS population, d.a5 AS num_cities, d.a6 AS urban_ratio, d.a7 AS avg_salary, d.a8 AS unemployment_rate, d.a9 AS crime_rate, d.a10 AS avg_loan_amount, d.a11 AS num_entrepreneurs, d.a12 AS num_companies, d.a13 AS num_crimes, d.a14 AS num_crimes_prev, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount_per_loan, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_account_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_account_balance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense, (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS net_flow, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'gold' THEN cd.card_id END) AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'classic' THEN cd.card_id END) AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.type = 'junior' THEN cd.card_id END) AS junior_cards FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE ( (d.a4 > 37755 AND d.a5 < 13) OR (d.a6 BETWEEN 0.33 AND 0.82) OR (d.a7 > 47035 AND d.a8 < 14) ) AND ( l.amount > 56987 AND l.duration >= 30 AND (l.status = 'A' OR l.status = 'B' OR l.status = 'C') ) AND ( t.amount > 2837 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-02-01' AND (t.type = 'PRIJEM' OR t.type = 'VYDAJ') AND t.operation IN ('VYBER KARTOU', 'VKLAD', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') ) AND ( o.amount > 6994.44 AND o.k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO', 'LEASING', 'UVER') ) AND NOT ( c.birth_date < '1930-01-01' AND c.gender = 'M' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 200 AND SUM(l.amount) > 675786 AND AVG(o.amount) < 2684.92 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, net_flow DESC LIMIT 87;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount, MIN(t.amount) AS min_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 8956.64) AS high_value_orders_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 201497 AND t.amount > 45623 AND d.a10 > 176.92 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1827097 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 3.66 THEN 'High Unemployment' WHEN d.a10 > 4.36 THEN 'Medium Unemployment' ELSE 'Low Unemployment' END AS unemployment_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 THEN SUM(l.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) ELSE 0 END AS avg_loan_per_loan, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 0 THEN SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) ELSE 0 END AS avg_transaction_per_transaction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_percent_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 360448 AND t.amount > 83364 AND d.a4 > 27027 AND d.a11 > 4696 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 102 AND SUM(l.amount) > 4593182 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 64898 AND t.amount > 4610 GROUP BY l.account_id ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS trans_count_per_account, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS total_amount_per_account FROM trans t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = t.account_id AND l.amount > 229145 ) AND t.amount > 98413 GROUP BY t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.account_id ORDER BY total_amount_per_account DESC, trans_amount DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS high_value_trans_count, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id != t2.trans_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 14532 AND t2.amount > 20705 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) > 1 ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(aa.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 728 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(aa.total_amount) > 25966.41 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.trans_id END) AS credit_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY a.account_id ), loan_metrics AS ( SELECT l.account_id, median_trans_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_stats as1 ON a.account_id = as1.account_id LEFT JOIN loan_metrics lm ON a.account_id = lm.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON a.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 2787 AND d.a5 < 512216 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1997 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) > 6231681 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 44 AND AVG(as1.avg_balance) BETWEEN 4078 AND 732144 ORDER BY district_transaction_volume DESC, total_clients DESC WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS client_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' AND l.date >= '930101' AND o.amount >= 443744.91 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 >= 102789 AND d.a10 <= 1.41 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.transaction_count, a.total_transaction_amount, a.avg_balance, a.loan_count, a.total_loan_amount, a.order_count, a.total_order_amount, a.card_count, a.client_count, d.population, d.crime_rate, d.unemployment_rate, d.entrepreneurs_rate, d.total_clients, d.avg_client_age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.loan_count DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.order_count DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.avg_balance) AS balance_percentile, LAG(a.total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS prev_transaction_amount, LEAD(a.loan_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.loan_count DESC) AS next_loan_count, SUM(a.total_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_total_transactions, AVG(a.avg_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_avg_balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS accounts_in_district FROM account_stats a JOIN district_metrics d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.transaction_count >= 825 AND a.loan_count <= 6 ) SELECT account_id, district_id, transaction_count, total_transaction_amount, avg_balance, loan_count, total_loan_amount, order_count, total_order_amount, card_count, client_count, population, crime_rate, unemployment_rate, entrepreneurs_rate, total_clients, avg_client_age, transaction_rank, loan_rank, order_rank, balance_percentile, prev_transaction_amount, next_loan_count, district_total_transactions, district_avg_balance, accounts_in_district, (total_transaction_amount / NULLIF(district_total_transactions, 0)) * 100 AS transaction_share_percent, (avg_balance - district_avg_balance) AS balance_deviation FROM ranked_accounts WHERE transaction_rank <= 51 AND balance_percentile >= 0.65 ORDER BY district_id, transaction_rank;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 965 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) > 37192.29 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 218490) AS high_loan_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 510846 ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id IN ( SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id = c.client_id ) AND o.amount > 22048.01) AS total_order_amount FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) < 1944 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS active_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS total_transactions, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_account_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS financial_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN account a2 ON l.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE a2.district_id = ds.district_id AND l.status = 'A' AND l.duration > 31) AS active_long_loans FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE ds.avg_salary > 23162.09 AND cf.total_order_amount > 415377.76 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 182 AND SUM(cf.total_order_amount) > 515698.04 ORDER BY district_order_volume DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 1288 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) > 0 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 58290 AND l.duration >= 18 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 28673 AND l.duration >= 60 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.district_id > 64 AND l.amount > 3370 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) >= 3 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.district_id < 87 AND l.amount < 127735 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) <= 5 ORDER BY district_id, client_id;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.status, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.date) AS running_avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 221349 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id, l.amount, l.status, l.date ORDER BY d.district_id, l.date;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 13335.76 AND l.amount >= 96521 AND d.a4 >= 9175 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 AND SUM(l.amount) >= 5360337 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 645 AND AVG(t.amount) >= 4918 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 82 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 12 AND SUM(l.amount) > 126083 UNION ALL SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, NULL AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 48739.55 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 43 AND AVG(o.amount) < 4809.72 ORDER BY district_id, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 770698 AND l.duration = 47 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount < 34475 AND t.type = 'PRIJEM' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 44 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(DISTINCT l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 443153.53 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 67788.25 AND o.amount > 82760.97 AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 5 AND SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) >= 111340.13 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS num_inhabitants, d.a5 AS num_municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 AS num_municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 AS num_municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 AS num_municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 AS num_cities, d.a10 AS ratio_urban_inhabitants, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemploy_rate_95, d.a13 AS unemploy_rate_96, d.a14 AS num_entrepreneurs_per_1000, d.a15 AS num_crimes_95, d.a16 AS num_crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a11 DESC) AS avg_salary_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE d.a11 > 36940 AND d.a12 < 6.47 AND d.a13 < 4.26 AND d.a4 > 323700 AND l.amount > 693421 AND o.amount > 7300.98 AND t.amount > 90945 AND (l.date >= '1993-01-01' OR l.date IS NULL) AND (o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' OR o.k_symbol IS NULL) AND (t.type = 'PRIJEM' OR t.type IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 583 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 427 AND SUM(t.amount) > 20757068 AND AVG(l.amount) > 225947 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, account_count_rank ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, l.status AS loan_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 358695 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, l.status, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2), (loan_year), () ) ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_year DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 8.06 THEN 'High Unemployment' WHEN d.a10 > 0.93 THEN 'Medium Unemployment' ELSE 'Low Unemployment' END AS unemployment_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 THEN SUM(l.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) ELSE 0 END AS avg_loan_per_loan, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 0 THEN SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) ELSE 0 END AS avg_transaction_per_transaction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_percent_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 847960 AND t.amount > 2621 AND d.a4 > 23185 AND d.a11 > 413 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a10 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 718 AND SUM(l.amount) > 2864646 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, l.status, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, ROUND(AVG(a16) OVER (PARTITION BY l.status ORDER BY d.district_id), 2) AS moving_avg_crimes95, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 264405 AND l.duration >= 18 AND t.amount BETWEEN 328 AND 327197 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, l.status, d.a16 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 426832 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 21 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_id;

SELECT l.loan_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account WHERE l.amount > 693007 AND t.amount < 98650 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 5300 AND l.duration >= 24 GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 42728.44) AS high_value_order_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 76642 AND l.duration >= 52 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.gender HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 517161 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 AS region_code, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 92232 AND l.duration >= 23 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 88 AND t.type = 'CREDIT' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 279984 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) < 34 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS related_trans_count, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_amount, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_related_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id != t2.trans_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 96657 AND t2.amount < 2240 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_related_amount DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(aa.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 1414 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 42 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 2052 AND d.a5 < 4116 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) > 40869.1 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.amount > 23429 AND l.amount > 127193 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 5170.73 GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS financial_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_salary) AS salary_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_loan_amount > 638267 AND cf.total_order_amount > 219831.07 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 97086 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 204 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_avg_balance DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, d.district_id, d.a4 AS urban_inhabitants, COUNT(l.loan_id) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id, d.district_id) AS loan_count_per_client_district, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_loan_amount_running FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 11071 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, d.district_id, d.a4, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.date HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount_running DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS unique_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 29230 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 0 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 1528 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 36 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_in_district FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 49842 AND l.duration > 22 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 6 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT t2.account_id FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.amount > 165999 AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'PRIJEM') ) AND l.loan_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l2.loan_id FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.amount >= 973773 AND l2.duration > 18 AND l2.status = 'A' ) AND (d.a4 > 7100 OR d.a5 < 291) GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 669 AND SUM(l.amount) >= 1527567 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, MAX(t.trans_id) AS latest_trans_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > (SELECT AVG(o2.amount) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_to IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = a.district_id))) AS high_order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 50639 AND t.amount > 119842 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 10 AND SUM(l.amount) > 4239841 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND d.a10 >= 19.97 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 907818.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 63.94 INTERSECT SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND l.status = 'A' AND o.bank_to = 'CS' AND d.a12 >= 39.12 GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) < 85014.44 AND SUM(o.amount) <= 63066.11;

SELECT c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status LIKE 'A' AND d.a3 LIKE 'north' GROUP BY c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 4 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id)) * 100 AS bad_loan_percentage FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 235674 AND l.duration >= 16 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 191087 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id)) * 100 <= 23.07 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 966231 AND d.a16 > 640326 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1815284 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o1.amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE l.amount > 198354 AND t.amount > 29960 AND o1.amount > 55403.93 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2012 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 8379058 AND SUM(t.amount) > 2376773 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(t.max_balance) AS max_account_balance, MIN(t.min_balance) AS min_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account = a.account_id AND t2.type = 'CREDIT' AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01') AS recent_credits, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_payment) FROM (SELECT account_id, AVG(payments) AS avg_payment FROM loan GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(payments) > 8677.54) sub) AS avg_high_payment FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, MAX(balance) AS max_balance, MIN(balance) AS min_balance FROM trans GROUP BY account_id ) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 15166 AND d.a10 < 35.71 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 27473 OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 68 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients DESC;
