SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 426103 AND l.duration > 19 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 17369 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 436241 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS net_transaction_flow, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) FROM order1 o1 WHERE o1.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND o1.amount > 397457.24) AS high_value_orders_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 1842 AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 37 AND SUM(l.amount) > 8128664 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.type = 'credit' THEN c.card_id END) AS credit_cards_issued, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN client cl ON d.district_id = cl.district_id JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 190530.39 AND t.amount > 38050.81 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 236370.43 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 16087257.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 2880.94 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS latest_transaction_date FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE CAST(l.date AS DATE) BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-01-01' AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 343786.63 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS unique_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS unique_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS unique_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS unique_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(CAST(a.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_account_year, MAX(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_loan_year, MAX(CAST(t.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_trans_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 579395 OR l.amount IS NULL) AND (t.amount > 11452 OR t.amount IS NULL) AND (o.amount > 3395.8 OR o.amount IS NULL) AND (CAST(a.date AS INTEGER) >= 957999 OR a.date IS NULL) AND (CAST(l.date AS INTEGER) >= 941279 OR l.date IS NULL) AND (CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) >= 971511 OR t.date IS NULL) AND d.a10 > 549.81 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 1509 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, unique_accounts DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 804637 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 5507) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 47 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 12630 AND t.amount > 128 AND o.amount > 3388.17 AND d.a4 > 8086 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 362539 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 14 AND AVG(l.amount) > 37186 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 510 AND d.a5 < 5424 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 67 ORDER BY account_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 5236 AND d.a5 < 7298 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 96 ORDER BY account_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 252261 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 46 AND SUM(l.amount) < 4382839 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '970101') AS avg_recent_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND l.amount > 85204 AND d.a4 > 19288 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 35 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a16 >= 69744 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount HAVING COUNT(c.client_id) > 127 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE amount > 105587) AND l.amount > 48922 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 23 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, a.account_id, c.client_id, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_amount, COALESCE(AVG(t.amount), 0) AS avg_transaction_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) AS total_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(AVG(l.amount), 0) AS avg_loan_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount, COALESCE(AVG(o.amount), 0) AS avg_order_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id), 0) AS total_cards, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) DESC) AS transaction_rank_in_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) DESC) AS overall_loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) DESC) AS order_rank_in_region FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND c.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d.a10 >= 595.32 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id, c.client_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) > 314200.29 AND COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 0) >= 7.42 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d1.district_id, d1.a16 AS district_avg_salary, d2.a16 AS neighbor_avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d1 JOIN district d2 ON d1.district_id = d2.district_id AND d1.a4 = d2.a4 + 1 JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d1.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d1.a16 > 17617 AND d2.a16 > 14086 AND c.birth_date >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY d1.district_id, d1.a16, d2.a16 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 34075 OR AVG(l.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date::date) AS trans_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.date::date) AS trans_month, t.type AS trans_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE t.amount > 153253 AND t.date::date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.account_id, trans_year, trans_month, t.type), (trans_year, trans_month, t.type), (t.type)) ORDER BY trans_year, trans_month, t.type, total_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' AND l.date >= '930101' AND a.date >= '930101' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'), TO_DATE('1999-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 36367 AND d.a10 < 4.0 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.type = 'OWNER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS owner_accounts FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE c.birth_date <= '300101' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, ast.transaction_count, ast.total_transaction_amount, ast.avg_transaction_amount, ast.loan_count, ast.total_loan_amount, ast.order_count, ast.total_order_amount, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.unemployment_rate, dm.entrepreneurs_rate, dm.client_count, dm.avg_client_age, cf.disposition_count, cf.card_count, cf.owner_accounts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_loan_amount DESC) AS loan_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.total_order_amount DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.transaction_count) AS transaction_percentile, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY ast.loan_count) AS loan_percentile FROM account a JOIN account_stats ast ON a.account_id = ast.account_id JOIN district_metrics dm ON a.district_id = dm.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON a.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE ast.total_transaction_amount > 292906 AND ast.total_loan_amount > 270614 ) SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS total_accounts, AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transactions, AVG(total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, AVG(loan_count) AS avg_loans, AVG(total_loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, AVG(order_count) AS avg_orders, AVG(total_order_amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(transaction_rank) AS max_transaction_rank, MAX(loan_rank) AS max_loan_rank, MAX(order_rank) AS max_order_rank, AVG(transaction_percentile) AS avg_transaction_percentile, AVG(loan_percentile) AS avg_loan_percentile, SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_transaction_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN loan_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_loan_accounts FROM ranked_accounts WHERE transaction_percentile > 0.67 AND loan_percentile > 0.94 GROUP BY district_id HAVING AVG(total_transaction_amount) > 274057 AND AVG(total_loan_amount) > 258233 ORDER BY avg_transaction_amount DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_crime_rate, d.a12 AS district_unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS district_entrepreneurs_rate FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN card c ON dsp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT account_id, district_id, transaction_count, total_transaction_amount, avg_balance, loan_count, total_loan_amount, order_count, total_order_amount, card_count, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC ) AS district_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY district_population > 170721 ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC ) AS population_percentile, LAG(total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC ) AS prev_account_transaction_amount, LEAD(avg_balance, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY district_unemployment_rate > 5.36 ORDER BY avg_balance DESC ) AS next_account_avg_balance FROM account_stats WHERE total_loan_amount > 703675 AND transaction_count >= 667 ) SELECT district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(*) AS high_value_accounts, AVG(total_transaction_amount) AS avg_high_value_transactions, SUM(total_loan_amount) AS total_high_value_loans, AVG(total_order_amount) AS avg_high_value_orders, MAX(transaction_count) AS max_transactions, MIN(avg_balance) AS min_avg_balance, CORR(total_transaction_amount, total_loan_amount) AS trans_loan_correlation, STDDEV(total_order_amount) AS order_amount_stddev FROM ranked_accounts WHERE district_rank <= 46 AND population_percentile >= 0.24 GROUP BY district_id, district_population, district_crime_rate, district_unemployment_rate, district_entrepreneurs_rate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 AND AVG(total_transaction_amount) > 4820083 AND SUM(total_loan_amount) >= 4486241 ORDER BY total_high_value_loans DESC, avg_high_value_transactions DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 90886 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) > 0 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 34104 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 583314 AND d.a10 < 64.76 AND l.amount >= 424521 AND l.duration <= 65 AND o.amount > 379188.01 AND t.amount >= 33017 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 55 AND SUM(l.amount) < 801066 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 63235 AND l.duration > 38 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.amount HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 5 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 675517 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(lo.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.date) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id JOIN card ca ON di.disp_id = ca.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.amount > 57507 AND lo.amount >= 84754 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1991 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, a.date, lo.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 434254 ORDER BY d.district_id, transaction_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 387238 AND t.amount > 48917 AND o.amount > 80527.93 AND d.a4 > 7721 AND d.a5 > 6579 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1779275 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 83 AND AVG(l.amount) > 459446 AND SUM(t.amount) > 9945555 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 772 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 201535 OR l.duration > 14) AND (t.amount < -480023 OR t.amount IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.status = 'B' AND l.payments < 3119.69) AND (d.a10 > 7255.69 OR d.a12 < 2010.26) AND (a.date >= '1993-01-01' OR c.birth_date <= '1920-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 62 AND AVG(l.amount) <= 69999 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (d.a4 > 5935 OR d.a5 < 2334) AND (d.a6 BETWEEN 3899 AND 8600) AND NOT (d.a7 = 9737 AND d.a8 = 496) AND (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 82312) AND (t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 885 AND AVG(l.amount) < 43459 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d1.district_id AS d1_id, d2.district_id AS d2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.account_id) AS d1_account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id) AS d2_account_count, AVG(l1.amount) AS d1_avg_loan_amount, AVG(l2.amount) AS d2_avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS d1_withdrawal_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) AS d2_withdrawal_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS d1_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS d2_order_count, CORR(d1.a10, d2.a10) AS avg_salary_correlation, SUM(d1.a12) AS d1_unemployment_sum, SUM(d2.a12) AS d2_unemployment_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d1.a13) DESC) AS d1_crime_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d2.a13) DESC) AS d2_crime_rank FROM district d1 JOIN account a1 ON d1.district_id = a1.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN card cd1 ON dp1.disp_id = cd1.disp_id JOIN district d2 ON d1.district_id < d2.district_id JOIN account a2 ON d2.district_id = a2.district_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id JOIN card cd2 ON dp2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 33181 AND l2.amount > 234030 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount > 67372.05 AND o2.amount > 23372.57 AND c1.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND c2.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d1.a10 >= 7399.57 AND d2.a10 >= 13779.92 GROUP BY d1.district_id, d2.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.account_id) > 56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id) > 22 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) > 794508 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) > 731586 ORDER BY d1_account_count DESC, d2_account_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 56463 AND t.amount > 4210 AND d.a4 > 341359 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 37336 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS loans_in_district, SUM(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS total_loan_amount_in_district FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 731873 AND l.duration > 59 UNION ALL SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, NULL AS duration, NULL AS payments, t.type AS status, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS trans_in_district, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS total_trans_amount_in_district FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.amount > 2628 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ORDER BY district_id, loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, d.a4 AS district_population FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 592127 AND l.duration >= 58 AND t.amount <= 6294 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 21561.07) AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 426090 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 841520 GROUP BY t.account_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 251 ) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 978699 GROUP BY t.account_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 589 ) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, MAX(CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL)) AS max_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE l.amount > 72267 AND l.duration >= 22 AND t.amount > 47214 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 5 AND SUM(l.amount) <= 135403 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount FROM account a JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE o.amount > 1930.17 AND t.amount > 45013 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 10 AND SUM(o.amount) <= 37973.44 ORDER BY district_id, account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND d.client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = 16)) AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 761900 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10, l.amount AS loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 141578) AS high_trans_count, SUM(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.loan_id) AS cumulative_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a10 > 39.13 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a10, l.amount, l.loan_id HAVING l.amount > 260793 ORDER BY cumulative_loan_per_district DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS avg_transaction_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.amount > 814525 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a15 > 17792 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_bad_loan_amount, SUM(d.a10) AS district_unemploy_rate_sum, AVG(d.a10) AS district_unemploy_rate_avg, SUM(d.a12) AS district_crime_rate_sum, AVG(d.a12) AS district_crime_rate_avg, SUM(d.a13) AS district_entrep_rate_sum, AVG(d.a13) AS district_entrep_rate_avg, SUM(d.a14) AS district_municipality_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE t.amount > 708338 AND l.amount > 984180 AND o.amount > 694711.13 AND d.a10 > 12.61 AND d.a12 > 57.95 AND d.a13 > 51.0 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(a.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 382 AND SUM(t.amount) > 9221480 AND SUM(l.amount) > 3092335 AND SUM(o.amount) > 2355190.16 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, account_count DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 1616 AND l.duration = 32 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > (SELECT AVG(loan_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_count FROM loan GROUP BY account_id) sub) ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 311103 AND l.duration >= 36 ) GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 47 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 607670 AND t.amount > 39490 AND o1.amount > 95406.81 AND d.a4 > 5452 AND d.a5 > 7153 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 8104063 AND AVG(l.amount) > 363353 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 26 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 308875 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 958738 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1101784 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 403785 AND t.amount > 68738 AND o.amount > 16929.33 AND c.birth_date >= '1930-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 33 AND SUM(t.amount) > 7528095 AND AVG(t.amount) BETWEEN 186 AND 1764 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(tr.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(tr.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trans_id) AS total_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans tr ON a.account_id = tr.account_id JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 6772 AND d.a10 < 55.79 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND tr.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 843132 AND tr.amount > 89101 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 8302.99 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 408 AND SUM(l.amount) > 7157654 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 93;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 538842 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 30 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_amount_per_district, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS total_cards, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(c.issued, 1, 6) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_issue_yearmonth FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND cl.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d.a10 > 4279.21 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 190097.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a10 AS avg_salary, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 68436.41 THEN 'High Salary' WHEN d.a10 BETWEEN 39081.78 AND 34480.51 THEN 'Medium Salary' ELSE 'Low Salary' END AS salary_category, CASE WHEN d.a13 < 3.95 THEN 'Low Unemployment' WHEN d.a13 BETWEEN 6.12 AND 8.48 THEN 'Medium Unemployment' ELSE 'High Unemployment' END AS unemployment_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 718 THEN 'High Loan Activity' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) BETWEEN 5 AND 9 THEN 'Medium Loan Activity' ELSE 'Low Loan Activity' END AS loan_activity_category, CASE WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 26200329 THEN 'High Transaction Volume' WHEN SUM(t.amount) BETWEEN 677327 AND 572913 THEN 'Medium Transaction Volume' ELSE 'Low Transaction Volume' END AS transaction_volume_category FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a10 >= 131616.22 AND d.a10 <= 134328.46 AND d.a13 >= 7.01 AND d.a13 <= 11.66 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 221758.27 AND o.amount <= 297288.21 AND t.amount >= 309820 AND t.amount <= 273237 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a10, d.a13 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 1762 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 1011 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 203 AND SUM(l.amount) > 3321331 AND SUM(o.amount) > 7252911.9 AND SUM(t.amount) > 41850857 AND AVG(t.balance) > 207767 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary_ratio, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 6074 AND d.a5 < 5384 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) > 1.89 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.amount > 57321 AND l.amount > 205112 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 34488.8 GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary_ratio, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 1406654 AND cf.total_order_amount > 909109.51 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary_ratio, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 96524 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 60 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_total_loans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.duration > 45 AND l.payments < 9730.26 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM disp d WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' ) GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 ORDER BY loan_count DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_loan_amount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 295540 AND l.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01'::DATE AND d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 1;

SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 20816 AND l.duration >= 38 GROUP BY a.district_id, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 4 ORDER BY a.district_id, amount_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 66662 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 26 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 944370 AND l.duration >= 31 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount > ( SELECT AVG(amount) * 2.11 FROM trans WHERE type = 'CREDIT' ) ) GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 411574 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_district_unemployment, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_district_salary FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON di.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 26767 AND t.amount > 1288 AND d.a4 > 71882 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id), (d.district_id, a.account_id), (d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 3 ORDER BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS trans_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM to_date(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS trans_month, l.loan_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, MAX(d.a10) AS district_unemployment_rate, MIN(d.a13) AS district_avg_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_transaction_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE t.amount > 928218 AND l.amount > 389536 AND to_date(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_date('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND to_date(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_date('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, trans_year, trans_month, l.loan_id), (d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, trans_year, trans_month), (d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id), (d.district_id, a.account_id), (d.district_id), () ) HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 127512 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 59 ORDER BY d.district_id, total_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE t.amount > 25841 AND l.amount > 204451 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 84734 GROUP BY d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 491566 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 40 AND AVG(l.amount) > 411534 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, amount_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS distinct_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS distinct_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS distinct_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 716666 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 852 ORDER BY distinct_clients DESC, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a4, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 21291 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= CAST('1993-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 18 INTERSECT SELECT d.district_id, d.a4, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 34217 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= CAST('1993-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 7 ORDER BY district_id, a4;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE t.amount > 8279 AND t.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01'::DATE AND d.type = 'OWNER' ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

SELECT t1.account_id, t1.type, t2.operation, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(t1.amount) AS total_amount_t1, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_amount_t2 FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.date < t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 655569 AND t2.amount > 737476 GROUP BY t1.account_id, t1.type, t2.operation HAVING COUNT(*) > 51 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 77761) AS high_amount_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 48280 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.amount > 26714 LEFT JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE a.district_id IN (23, 51, 27) AND (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('A', 'B')) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) <= 5 AND SUM(l.amount) < 97909 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 402395 AND l.duration >= 25 AND t.amount > 54802 AND o.amount > 10956.76 AND d.a4 > 7166 AND d.a5 > 9075 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 3 AND SUM(t.amount) > 354838 AND AVG(o.amount) > 7076.33 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 1788298 AND l.duration >= 10 AND t.amount > 11575 AND o.amount > 14659.01 AND d.a4 > 3162 AND d.a5 > 1996 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 8 AND SUM(t.amount) > 73722 AND AVG(o.amount) > 2137.82 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 7719 AND d.a4 > 3570 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id ORDER BY loan_count DESC, avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(COALESCE(o.amount, 0)) AS avg_order_amount, (SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.date >= '980101') AS recent_loan_total, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'DEBIT') AS debit_trans_count, MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance, MIN(d.a10) AS min_crime_rate, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_salary, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_id = a.account_id AND o2.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT MAX(t2.date) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.amount > 263865) AS last_large_trans_date, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'))) AS avg_birth_year, SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id), 0) AS avg_amount_per_transaction FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE t.date BETWEEN '970101' AND '970101' AND a.date >= '930101' AND d.a10 > 122.28 AND l.amount > 632703 GROUP BY d.a2, c.gender, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 4410696 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 55 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, account_count DESC LIMIT 939;

SELECT d.district_id, a.frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 906691 AND l.duration >= 56 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, a.frequency), (d.district_id), (a.frequency), () ) ORDER BY d.district_id, a.frequency;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) AS active_loan_ratio FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a16 > 2633 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 90 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 141332 AND t.amount < 13997 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1993 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 348877 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 18 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a3 LIKE '%Prague%' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND l.status LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 92 AND SUM(l.amount) >= 117526 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, d.a4 AS district_population FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 582054 AND l.duration >= 10 AND t.amount <= 39458 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 95872.27) AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 139712 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemploy_rate FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 273269 AND t.amount < 34029 AND l.duration >= 21 AND d.a11 > 124 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 3 AND SUM(t.amount) < 415154 ORDER BY total_trans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND d.a15 > 53 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_total, MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount, MIN(l.payments) AS min_loan_payment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.gender ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank_by_gender, AVG(CAST(d.a10 AS numeric)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_district_unemploy_rate FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE ( (l.amount > 361028 AND l.duration >= 40) OR (t.amount > 187620 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01') OR (o.amount > 21158.11 AND o.k_symbol NOT IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO')) ) AND c.birth_date <= '1970-01-01' AND d.a10 > 9.46 AND (dp.type = 'OWNER' OR dp.type IS NULL) GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 3 AND SUM(t.amount) > 822001 AND AVG(t.balance) BETWEEN 23906 AND 171833 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 161522 AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE')) GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 83 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY l.status) AS avg_amount_by_status FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 34470 AND l.duration >= 39 GROUP BY d.a2, l.status, l.amount ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.loan_id END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 65656 ) AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 44 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(CAST(c.issued AS DATE)) AS latest_card_issue_date, (SUM(l.amount) / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0)) * 100 AS loan_to_transaction_ratio FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 976468 AND t.amount > 99283 AND o.amount > 1905.69 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 153 AND AVG(l.duration) <= 18 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.account_id) AS avg_loan_per_account FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 84341 AND l.duration > 33 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 43068 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_district_unemployment, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_district_salary FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON di.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 89367 AND t.amount > 1280 AND d.a4 > 46422 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id), (d.district_id, a.account_id), (d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id;

SUM(o.amount)) AS order_amount_cume_dist FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 490918 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 46929.99 AND t.amount > 361245 AND (d.a3 LIKE 'north' OR d.a2 LIKE 'Hl.m.') > 30188.17 AND cf.total_order_amount > 189390.68 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 427 AND SUM(cf.total_order_amount) > SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_95 FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 18813 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 31373 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 15210 AND l.duration >= 20 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 28585 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, MAX(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS latest_loan_date, MIN(CAST(l.date AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_loan_date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards, (SELECT AVG(sub.amount) FROM loan sub WHERE sub.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND sub.amount > 624251.5) AS avg_high_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, LAG(SUM(l.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_loan_amount FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND c.client_id = dp.client_id INNER JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id INNER JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id INNER JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id INNER JOIN account a2 ON a.account_id = a2.account_id INNER JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id AND l.loan_id <> l2.loan_id WHERE CAST(l.date AS INTEGER) >= 976489 AND CAST(t.date AS INTEGER) <= 970187 AND l.amount > 98802.7 AND t.amount < 605855.19 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 223 AND SUM(l.amount) > 3412760.35 AND AVG(t.amount) < 20481.41 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.frequency, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS loan_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 39737 AND t.amount > 66892 AND o.amount > 322922.45 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND c.gender IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency, c.gender, loan_year, loan_month), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency, c.gender, loan_year), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency, c.gender), (d.district_id, d.a2, a.frequency), (d.district_id, d.a2), (d.district_id), () ) HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 792098 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 62 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_year, loan_month, total_loan_amount DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) a.account_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id JOIN district_stats ds ON d.district_id = ds.district_id JOIN client_metrics cm ON c.client_id = cm.client_id WHERE aa.total_transaction_amount > 45957 AND aa.total_loan_amount < 931840 AND cm.client_age BETWEEN 24 AND 63 AND ds.avg_salary > 28015.98 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 345 AND AVG(aa.avg_balance) > 52578 ORDER BY transaction_rank;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type as disp_type, a.frequency, TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as account_open_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, TO_DATE(l.date, l.payments, l.date, l.status ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 as num_inhabitants, d.a5 as num_municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 as num_municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 as num_municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 as num_municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 as num_cities, d.a10 as ratio_urban_inhabitants, d.a11 as avg_salary, d.a12 as unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 as unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 as entrepreneurs_per_1000, d.a15 as num_crimes_95, d.a16 as num_crimes_96 FROM district d ), order_aggregates AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders, SUM(o.amount) as total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) as unique_banks, COUNT(DISTINCT o.k_symbol) as unique_symbols FROM order1 o GROUP BY o.account_id ) SELECT ca.client_id, ca.disp_type, ca.frequency, ds.num_inhabitants, ds.avg_salary, ds.unemployment_rate_95, ds.unemployment_rate_96, COUNT(DISTINCT la.loan_id) as total_loans, SUM(la.loan_amount) as total_loan_amount, AVG(la.loan_amount) as avg_loan_amount, SUM(la.total_credits) as lifetime_credits, SUM(la.total_withdrawals) as lifetime_withdrawals, AVG(la.avg_balance) as overall_avg_balance, SUM(oa.total_orders) as total_client_orders, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) as total_client_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.loan_amount) as median_loan_amount, CORR(la.loan_amount, ds.avg_salary) as loan_salary_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(la.loan_amount) DESC) as loan_amount_rank FROM client_accounts ca JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id LEFT JOIN order_aggregates oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id WHERE la.loan_amount > 162008 AND la.loan_date >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ds.avg_salary
