SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'F') AS female_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') AS male_clients, ROUND(SUM(t.amount) / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0), 2) AS transaction_to_loan_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 151164 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 65826 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1827739 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 60 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 87045 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loan WHERE payments > 2401.31) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(COALESCE(l.payments, 0)) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(COALESCE(o.amount, 0)) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(COALESCE(t.amount, 0)) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(COALESCE(t.balance, 0)) AS avg_transaction_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ca.issued FROM 1 FOR 8) AS DATE)) AS latest_card_issue_date FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 142231) AND (o.amount IS NULL OR o.amount > 2334.93) AND (t.amount IS NULL OR t.amount > 642902) AND (ca.issued IS NULL OR CAST(SUBSTRING(ca.issued FROM 1 FOR 8) AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01') AND (a.date IS NULL OR CAST(SUBSTRING(a.date FROM 1 FOR 8) AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) > 43740 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 28 AND SUM(COALESCE(t.amount, 0)) > 17276 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) > 2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l1.loan_id AS loan_id_1, l2.loan_id AS loan_id_2, a1.account_id AS account_id_1, a2.account_id AS account_id_2, d1.district_id AS district_id_1, d2.district_id AS district_id_2, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.trans_id) AS trans_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS trans_count_2, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.amount > 46159 THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_amount_sum_1, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.amount > 782322 THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_amount_sum_2, AVG(l1.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a1.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district_1, AVG(l2.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a2.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district_2, MAX(t1.balance) AS max_balance_1, MAX(t2.balance) AS max_balance_2, (SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a1.account_id AND o.amount >= 36289.98) AS order_sum_1, (SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a2.account_id AND o.amount >= 13465.91) AS order_sum_2 FROM loan l1 JOIN loan l2 ON l1.duration = l2.duration AND l1.payments = l2.payments JOIN account a1 ON l1.account_id = a1.account_id JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id JOIN district d1 ON a1.district_id = d1.district_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd1 ON dp1.disp_id = cd1.disp_id LEFT JOIN card cd2 ON dp2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 323201 AND l2.amount > 498813 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c1.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND c2.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' GROUP BY l1.loan_id, l2.loan_id, a1.account_id, a2.account_id, d1.district_id, d2.district_id, a1.district_id, a2.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.trans_id) > 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) > 27 ORDER BY high_amount_sum_1 DESC, high_amount_sum_2 DESC LIMIT 296;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 18668 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, 'loan' AS source_type, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.payments) AS min_loan_payment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(l.loan_id) DESC, SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.amount > 498734 AND l.duration >= 45 AND l.status = ANY (ARRAY['A', 'B']) AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND di.a10 > 4.81 AND di.a11 < 6866 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 4 AND SUM(l.amount) > 313930 UNION ALL SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, 'trans' AS source_type, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(t.trans_id) DESC, SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE t.amount > 21968 AND t.date >= '970101' AND t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'PRIJEM') AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND di.a10 > 4.61 AND di.a11 < 9564 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) >= 232 AND SUM(t.amount) > 245919 ORDER BY district_id, rank_in_district;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, MAX(t.trans_id) AS latest_trans_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > (SELECT AVG(o2.amount) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_to IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = a.district_id))) AS high_order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 263694 AND t.amount > 288533 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 AND SUM(l.amount) > 2717744 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_loan_amount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 308600 AND l.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01'::DATE AND d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 1;

SELECT a.account_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loaned, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction, MAX(CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS latest_trans_date, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND l.duration > 32 AND t.balance < -24726 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 54264 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_loaned DESC;

SELECT a1.account_id AS account1_id, a2.account_id AS account2_id, d1.a2 AS district1_name, d2.a2 AS district2_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) AS loans_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) AS loans_count2, SUM(t1.amount) AS total_trans_amount1, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_trans_amount2, AVG(o1.amount) AS avg_order_amount1, AVG(o2.amount) AS avg_order_amount2, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.card_id) AS cards_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.card_id) AS cards_count2, MAX(l1.amount) AS max_loan_amount1, MAX(l2.amount) AS max_loan_amount2, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_trans1, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_trans2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t1.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t2.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank2, (SUM(t1.amount) - SUM(t2.amount)) AS trans_amount_diff FROM account a1 JOIN account a2 ON a1.district_id = a2.district_id AND a1.account_id <> a2.account_id JOIN district d1 ON a1.district_id = d1.district_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id LEFT JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id AND dp1.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id AND dp2.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN card c1 ON dp1.disp_id = c1.disp_id LEFT JOIN card c2 ON dp2.disp_id = c2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 148025 AND l2.amount > 401251 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.date >= '1994-01-01' AND o1.amount >= 90593.98 AND o2.amount >= 41175.77 GROUP BY a1.account_id, a2.account_id, d1.a2, d2.a2 HAVING SUM(t1.amount) > 1063262 AND SUM(t2.amount) > 1924602 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) >= 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) >= 4 ORDER BY trans_amount_diff DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(sub.total_loans) AS district_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN ( SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 515900 AND l.duration >= 36 GROUP BY l.account_id ) sub ON a.account_id = sub.account_id WHERE d.a15 > 4871 GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 13 ORDER BY district_loans DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a3 LIKE 'Prague' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 15 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT d.a2, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 13596 AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND date >= '1993-01-01')) GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 84 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 30485 ) AND l.amount > 309496 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 25 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_row FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 483 AND SUM(t.amount) > 179302 AND AVG(o.amount) BETWEEN 1435.75 AND 46696.47 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_row FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 940 AND SUM(t.amount) > 307303 AND AVG(o.amount) BETWEEN 3092.03 AND 78099.05 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND o2.amount > 239111.57) AS high_value_order_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate_95, AVG(d.a12) AS avg_unemployment_rate_96, AVG(d.a13) AS avg_crime_rate_95, AVG(d.a14) AS avg_crime_rate_96, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') AS male_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'F') AS female_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, (SELECT AVG(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id IN (SELECT a3.account_id FROM account a3 WHERE a3.district_id = d.district_id) AND o.k_symbol = 'UVER') AS avg_loan_order_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 33257 AND d.a5 < 103218 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date <= '1998-12-31' AND l.status = 'A' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1857985 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 995624 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 638220 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 3844688 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS inhabitants, d.a5 AS muni_lt_499, d.a6 AS muni_500_1999, d.a7 AS muni_2000_9999, d.a8 AS muni_gt_10000, d.a9 AS cities, d.a10 AS urban_ratio, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemp_95, d.a13 AS unemp_96, d.a14 AS entrepreneurs, d.a15 AS crimes_95, d.a16 AS crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank, SUM(SUM(l.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS cumulative_loan_amount_by_region FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 194366 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 57295 AND d.a11 > 9778 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 34 AND SUM(t.amount) > 6299395 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 36;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT d.disp_id, d.client_id, d.account_id, d.type AS disp_type, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.district_id AS account_district_id, a.frequency, a.date AS account_date FROM disp d INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' ), loan_transactions AS ( SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date AS loan_date, l.status, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM loan l LEFT JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 866948 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2010 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS salary, d.a13 AS unemployment, d.a16 AS urban_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.client_id) AS total_clients FROM district d LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca ON d.district_id = ca.account_district_id WHERE d.a4 > 418714 AND d.a13 < 0.13 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13, d.a16 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) AS unique_banks FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 8083.93 AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count, MIN(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS first_issue_date, MAX(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS last_issue_date FROM card c WHERE TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD') >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.disp_id ) SELECT dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(lt.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(lt.loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(lt.total_trans_amount) AS grand_total_trans, AVG(lt.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT oa.account_id) AS accounts_with_orders, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.disp_id) AS clients_with_cards, SUM(ca.card_count) AS total_cards_issued, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lt.loan_amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oa.avg_order_amount) AS median_order_amount FROM district_metrics dm LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca_base ON dm.district_id = ca_base.account_district_id LEFT JOIN loan_transactions lt ON ca_base.account_id = lt.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca_base.account_id = oa.account_id LEFT JOIN card_analysis ca ON ca_base.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE dm.population > 417527 AND dm.salary > 47740.15 GROUP BY dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) > 66 AND SUM(oa.total_order_amount) > 960632.62 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_volume DESC LIMIT 88;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 3481 AND d.a5 < 4798 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) > 41155.58 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.amount > 36606 AND l.amount > 466584 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.amount > 4528.13 GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS financial_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_salary) AS salary_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_loan_amount > 841306 AND cf.total_order_amount > 437928.56 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_salary, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 83485 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 219 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_avg_balance DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a16) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 3379 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(d.a10) < 3.1 ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.duration > 47 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(cl.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) < 1946 GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transaction_count, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.card_count) AS total_cards, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS total_order_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_unemployment_rate) AS unemployment_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 6819216 AND cf.total_order_amount < 162876.26 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes HAVING AVG(am.avg_balance) > 13873 AND COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) >= 271 ORDER BY district_transaction_count DESC, district_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.loan_id END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 63969 ) AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 45 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE ( (d.a15 > 752 AND d.a16 < 423) OR (d.a10 >= 63.05 AND d.a10 <= 41.67) OR (d.a11 NOT BETWEEN 505 AND 964) ) AND ( (l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 84482) AND (t.amount IS NULL OR t.amount < 27217) AND (a.date >= '1993-01-01' OR a.date IS NULL) ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 82 AND SUM(l.amount) <= 964854 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 22237 AND t.amount > 44304 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 92 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, a.frequency, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.date >= '1997-01-01' AND l.amount > 166553.43 AND di.a11 > 8168.89 AND l.status = 'A' GROUP BY l.account_id, a.frequency HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 103529.63 AND AVG(l.duration) < 32.92 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT t1.account_id, t1.k_symbol, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 253942 AND t2.amount > 557431 GROUP BY t1.account_id, t1.k_symbol HAVING COUNT(*) > 58 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 85761 AND l.duration > 26 AND l.status = 'A' AND d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 4 AND SUM(l.amount) > 29524 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 50924 OR l.amount IS NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) < 345080 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.account_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 87969 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 6308 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS account_year, c.gender, card.type AS card_type, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_transaction_date, MAX(TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_loan_date FROM account a JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card ON dsp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.a4 >= 3489 AND d.a5 >= 195231 AND t.amount >= 619080 AND l.amount >= 244323 AND o.amount >= 251157.48 GROUP BY d.a2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), c.gender, card.type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 551 AND SUM(l.amount) > 9807336 AND SUM(t.amount) > 4593960 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 7572 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 5468 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_count_rank_in_district FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 964909 AND t.amount > 10814 AND d.a15 > 45493 AND l.duration >= 25 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2, a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 3011690 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 48492.11) AS high_value_orders_per_account, (SELECT AVG(l2.payments) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.duration > 48) AS avg_payment_for_long_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' WHERE d.a4 > 24629 AND d.a10 < 6.39 GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 6 AND SUM(t.amount) < 171354 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_clients ASC;

SELECT d.district_id AS district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 2825 AND l.amount > 81624 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 7819654 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 255 UNION ALL SELECT d.district_id AS district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC) AS order_amount_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_orders FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 3034 AND o.amount > 121209.1 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 3618673.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 944;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.date >= '930101' AND t.date >= '930101' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 21 AND 38 AND l.amount > 85251 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 9 AND SUM(l.amount) > 493909 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN l.payments ELSE NULL END) AS avg_loan_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, MAX(t.balance) FILTER (WHERE t.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM trans WHERE account = a.account_id AND amount > -706154)) AS latest_balance_above_threshold FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 383 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date <= '1993-01-01') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 93884.53) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 519 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 704361 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT t1.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS high_value_trans_count, AVG(t1.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.trans_id != t2.trans_id AND t1.date = t2.date WHERE t1.amount > 87763 AND t2.amount > 27724 AND t1.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t1.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) > 7 ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(aa.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 641 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 20 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 327347) AS high_value_transactions FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dist.a4 > 1942 AND l.duration >= 31 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 14023 AND l.duration > 57 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 3 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 9449 AND t.balance < 74314 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) <= 79 ORDER BY account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 52506 AND l.duration >= 48 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 4 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY a.account_id) AS avg_loan_per_district FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 47523 AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, l.amount HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 12476 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE l.amount > 128705 AND l.duration > 43 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 492935 AND COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 438122 AND l.duration >= 15 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4046904 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 23064 AND l.duration >= 51 GROUP BY d.a2 UNION ALL SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.amount > 89606 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.a2 ORDER BY district_name;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 334308 AND t.amount < 88831 AND d.a4 > 7416 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1992 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 441231 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 874 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(lo.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_by_district, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o1.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON di.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE t.amount > 86889 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' AND lo.duration > 51 AND o1.amount < 14777.32 GROUP BY d.district_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, lo.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 591613 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 48 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(DISTINCT l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 763873.15 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount > 38431.17 AND o.amount > 47593.09 AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 1 AND SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) >= 94322.21 ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_rank;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.disp_id, d.account_id, d.type AS disposition_type, a.frequency, TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS account_open_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '1990-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS loan_date, CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 'good' WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN 'bad' ELSE 'unknown' END AS loan_quality FROM loan l WHERE l.amount >= 799448 AND l.duration <= 87 ), transaction_summary AS ( SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT t.type) AS distinct_trans_types, COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) AS distinct_symbols FROM trans t WHERE t.amount BETWEEN -77826 AND 18737 GROUP BY t.account_id ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, d.a15 AS urban_ratio, d.a16 AS avg_salary FROM district d WHERE d.a4 >= 110839 AND d.a16 <= 13379 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.k_symbol) AS distinct_order_types FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount >= 41744.0 GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_info AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count, STRING_AGG(c.type, ', ') AS card_types, MAX(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_card_issue FROM card c GROUP BY c.disp_id ) SELECT ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.disposition_type, ca.frequency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date) AS account_year, ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.unemployment_rate, ds.entrepreneurs_rate, ds.urban_ratio, ds.avg_salary, la.loan_quality, ts.trans_count, ts.total_amount, ts.avg_amount, ts.max_balance, ts.min_balance, ts.distinct_trans_types, ts.distinct_symbols, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.avg_order_amount, oa.distinct_order_types, ci.card_count, ci.card_types, COUNT(la.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(la.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(la.loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT la.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE la.loan_quality = 'good') AS good_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT la.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE la.loan_quality = 'bad') AS bad_loans FROM client_accounts ca LEFT JOIN loan_analysis la ON ca.account_id = la.account_id LEFT JOIN transaction_summary ts ON ca.account_id = ts.account_id LEFT JOIN district_stats ds ON ca.district_id = ds.district_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca.account_id = oa.account_id LEFT JOIN card_info ci ON ca.disp_id = ci.disp_id WHERE ca.account_open_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ca.client_id, ca.district_id, ca.disposition_type, ca.frequency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date), ds.population, ds.crime_rate, ds.unemployment_rate, ds.entrepreneurs_rate, ds.urban_ratio, ds.avg_salary, la.loan_quality, ts.trans_count, ts.total_amount, ts.avg_amount, ts.max_balance, ts.min_balance, ts.distinct_trans_types, ts.distinct_symbols, oa.order_count, oa.total_order_amount, oa.avg_order_amount, oa.distinct_order_types, ci.card_count, ci.card_types), (ca.district_id, ca.disposition_type, ca.frequency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date), la.loan_quality), (ca.district_id, la.loan_quality), (ca.disposition_type, la.loan_quality), (ca.frequency, la.loan_quality), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.account_open_date), la.loan_quality), (la.loan_quality), () ) HAVING COUNT(la.loan_id) >= 5 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' OR t.date IS NULL GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) < 6141 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT a.account_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 362122 AND d.a4 > 430220 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.a2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND l.amount > 61760 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 6 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 644031 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id UNION ALL SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 874955 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id ORDER BY account_id, district_id;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT t2.account_id FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.amount > 601206 AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'PRIJEM') ) AND l.loan_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l2.loan_id FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.amount >= 820388 AND l2.duration > 51 AND l2.status = 'A' ) AND (d.a4 > 7761 OR d.a5 < 5982) GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 877 AND SUM(l.amount) >= 4347713 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993 GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 993 ) AND l.amount > 247141 AND t.amount > 84144 AND o.amount > 40572.02 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 68 AND SUM(t.amount) > 8165398 AND SUM(o.amount) > 1079049.59 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, a.frequency, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(SUM(t.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_trans, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, SUM(lo.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN loan lo ON a.account_id = lo.account_id WHERE l.amount > 506961 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 355614.74 GROUP BY l.account_id, a.frequency, d.a2, t.date HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 50017 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) > 4 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_account FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '930101' AND t.date >= '930101' AND l.amount > 40936 AND l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = 71) GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.date HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 427808 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT s.district_id, s.a2 AS district_name, s.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards, MAX(CAST(s.a10 AS numeric)) AS avg_salary, MAX(s.a13) AS unemployment_rate_95, MAX(s.a14) AS unemployment_rate_96, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank FROM district s JOIN client c ON s.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON d.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE CAST(l.date AS DATE) >= DATE '1998-01-01' + INTERVAL '3120' DAY AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= DATE '1998-01-01' + INTERVAL '1646' DAY AND CAST(o.amount AS integer) > 467179.89 AND s.a10 > 43283.1 AND s.a13 < 4.71 GROUP BY s.district_id, s.a2, s.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 6943531 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 305756 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transactions DESC LIMIT 60;

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 282302 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1792337 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(CASE WHEN d.type = 'OWNER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS owner_ratio, (SELECT MAX(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id) AS max_order_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 587646.37 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(t.amount) BETWEEN 70828.98 AND 835273.72 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS transaction_volume_category FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a10 > 135.33 AND (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('A', 'B')) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 99 AND SUM(t.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, a.district_id;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 709240 AND t.amount < 24990 AND d.a4 > 347 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1996 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 438048 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 587 ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 654116 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 7159 AND l.amount > 370694 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 901541 AND t.amount > 56145 AND o.amount > 19878.76 AND d.a4 > 4988 AND d.a5 > 9505 AND d.a6 > 9861 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 276033 AND SUM(t.amount) > 3081383 AND SUM(o.amount) > 440795.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 996 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 7139 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 418 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS num_cards, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payments, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_transactions, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_transaction_balance, MAX(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'INSURANCE PAYMENT' THEN o.amount ELSE NULL END) AS max_insurance_payment FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 597 AND d.a10 < 19.67 AND l.duration >= 53 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 23559.76 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 12 AND SUM(l.amount) > 620175 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, num_accounts DESC;

AS num_municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 AS num_cities, d.a10 AS ratio_urban, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 AS num_entrepreneurs, d.a15 AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) FILTER (WHERE ca.type = 'classic') AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) FILTER (WHERE ca.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE') AS monthly_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'C') AS finished_amount, SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'D') AS running_amount, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_incoming, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type
