o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'LEASING') AS leasing_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'UVER') AS loan_orders, SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_order_amount, SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_order_amount, SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'LEASING') AS leasing_order_amount, SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.k_symbol = 'UVER') AS loan_order_amount, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(l.duration) AS min_loan_duration, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, MAX(l.payments) AS max_loan_payment, MIN(l.payments) AS min_loan_payment, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT dp2.disp_id) AS total_dispositions, COUNT(DISTINCT dp2.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id) AS total_accounts_in_district, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) AS total_loans_in_district, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) AS total_orders_in_district, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.trans_id) AS total_transactions_in_district FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN disp dp2 ON c.client_id = dp2.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca2 ON dp2.disp_id = ca2.disp_id LEFT JOIN account a2 ON d.district_id = a2.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 127701 AND d.a11 > 58602 AND l.amount > 822504 AND o.amount > 755895.64 AND t.amount > 642298 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 8834 AND SUM(l.amount) > 2909053 AND SUM(o.amount) > 949102.3 AND SUM(t.amount) > 128115 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 305592 AND t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY l.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 512490 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC;

WITH account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_rankings AS ( SELECT am.*, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS district_avg_salary, d.a12 AS district_unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS district_crime_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.total_order_amount DESC) AS order_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.active_loan_amount DESC) AS loan_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.avg_balance) AS balance_percentile, LAG(am.total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS prev_transaction_amount, LEAD(am.avg_balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY am.district_id ORDER BY am.avg_balance DESC) AS next_avg_balance FROM account_metrics am JOIN district d ON am.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a10 >= 38427.33 AND d.a12 <= 0.05 ), client_analysis AS ( SELECT dr.*, cl.client_id, cl.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(TO_DATE(cl.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS client_age, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS client_card_count, CASE WHEN dr.transaction_rank <= 10 THEN 'TOP_TRANSACTION' WHEN dr.order_rank <= 5 THEN 'TOP_ORDER' WHEN dr.loan_rank <= 3 THEN 'TOP_LOAN' ELSE 'REGULAR' END AS client_segment FROM district_rankings dr JOIN disp dp ON dr.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE cl.birth_date <= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY dr.account_id, dr.district_id, dr.card_count, dr.loan_count, dr.active_loan_amount, dr.avg_loan_duration, dr.order_count, dr.total_order_amount, dr.transaction_count, dr.total_transaction_amount, dr.avg_balance, dr.median_transaction_amount, dr.district_population, dr.district_avg_salary, dr.district_unemployment_rate, dr.district_crime_rate, dr.transaction_rank, dr.order_rank, dr.loan_rank, dr.balance_percentile, dr.prev_transaction_amount, dr.next_avg_balance, cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date ) SELECT ca.client_segment, ca.gender, ca.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.account_id) AS account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(ca.total_transaction_amount) AS segment_total_transactions, SUM(ca.total_order_amount) AS segment_total_orders, SUM(ca.active_loan_amount) AS segment_active_loans, AVG(ca.avg_balance) AS segment_avg_balance, AVG(ca.client_age) AS segment_avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.total_transaction_amount) AS p25_transactions, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.total_transaction_amount) AS p75_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ca.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS segment_transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ca.active_loan_amount) DESC) AS segment_loan_rank FROM client_analysis ca WHERE ca.total_transaction_amount >= 781580 AND ca.active_loan_amount >= 291818 GROUP BY ca.client_segment, ca.gender, ca.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.account_id) >= 15 AND AVG(ca.avg_balance) >= 14701 ORDER BY segment_total_transactions DESC, segment_active_loans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_order_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 951324 AND t.amount > 11560 AND o.amount > 4486.78 GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 340191 AND SUM(t.amount) < 730471 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 48246 OR l.amount IS NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) < 423096 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 349342 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' AND a.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 8461 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY l.status) AS avg_amount_by_status FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 570204 AND l.duration >= 50 GROUP BY d.a2, l.status, l.amount ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 305082 AND l.duration >= 13 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT disp.account_id FROM disp WHERE disp.client_id IN ( SELECT client.client_id FROM client WHERE client.district_id = d.district_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(client.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) <= 1976 ) ) GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS unique_clients_with_cards, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_balance) FROM (SELECT account_id, MAX(balance) AS max_balance FROM trans WHERE date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY account_id HAVING MAX(balance) > 488353.2) sub WHERE sub.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id)) AS max_account_balance_in_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a15 > 5264 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) BETWEEN 1995 AND 1994 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 74270.55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) < 207 ORDER BY total_credit_transactions DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 252527 AND d.a5 < 280517 AND l.amount >= 909742 AND t.date >= '930101' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 818210 AND SUM(t.amount) < 426765638 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 421653 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 20 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a10 AS crime_rate_95, d.a11 AS crime_rate_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_post_trans_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards_issued, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 411827 AND l.duration >= 35 AND t.amount > 54242 AND d.a10 BETWEEN 52.11 AND 51.53 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2.account_id FROM account a2 JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE l2.status = 'A' AND l2.payments > 1459.62 ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a10, d.a11 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 87 AND AVG(t.balance) < 396154 AND SUM(o.amount) > 996045.63 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC LIMIT 68;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS avg_balance_per_account, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS count_prijem_trans, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, MIN(di.a10) AS min_district_unemployment_rate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.gender, ', ') AS client_genders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_trans_count, CORR(CAST(t.amount AS numeric), CAST(t.balance AS numeric)) AS amount_balance_correlation FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 83411 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a10 > 6.49 AND a.date <= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount < 42285.79 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id, t.amount, t.date, t.account_id, t.balance, t.type, t.trans_id, o.amount, l.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 36972 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 55 ORDER BY cumulative_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 1155 AND d.a5 < 11052 GROUP BY d.district_id ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE cd.issued >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 80767.55 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, MAX(t.trans_id) AS latest_trans_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > (SELECT AVG(o2.amount) FROM order1 o2 WHERE o2.account_to IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = a.district_id))) AS high_order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 991573 AND t.amount > 123652 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 7 AND SUM(l.amount) > 1791998 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM' GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING AVG(l.duration) BETWEEN 33 AND 38 AND SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 849013 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, l.amount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 23 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'A') AS active_loans_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 976642 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.duration >= 28 ) AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 7675284 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 9119 ORDER BY loan_amount_rank, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS cards_issued, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 957214 AND l.duration > 45 AND t.amount > 7382 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 41295.22 AND cl.birth_date <= '1930-01-01' AND d.a10 > 189.74 AND d.a12 > 112.16 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4715695 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 7 AND AVG(t.amount) > 24168 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.amount > 34711) AS high_value_trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount >= 32717 AND a.district_id = 15 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 190729 ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE c.client_id IN ( SELECT disp.client_id FROM disp JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id WHERE account.date >= '1993-01-01' ) AND d.a4 >= 4161 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 37 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE (l.amount > 622068 OR l.duration > 44) AND (t.amount < -954580 OR t.amount IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.status = 'B' AND l.payments < 2368.09) AND (d.a10 > 2979.35 OR d.a12 < 7564.49) AND (a.date >= '1993-01-01' OR c.birth_date <= '1920-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 22 AND AVG(l.amount) <= 85537 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE amount > 639155) AND l.amount > 1036 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 37 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

WITH account_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(aa.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account_aggregates aa ON a.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 >= 1311 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(aa.total_amount) > 46573.11 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT d.disp_id, d.client_id, d.account_id, d.type AS disp_type, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.district_id AS account_district_id, a.frequency, a.date AS account_date FROM disp d INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' ), loan_transactions AS ( SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date AS loan_date, l.status, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM loan l LEFT JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 657507 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2013 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS salary, d.a13 AS unemployment, d.a16 AS urban_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.client_id) AS total_clients FROM district d LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca ON d.district_id = ca.account_district_id WHERE d.a4 > 301944 AND d.a13 < 0.01 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13, d.a16 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) AS unique_banks FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 48024.62 AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count, MIN(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS first_issue_date, MAX(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS last_issue_date FROM card c WHERE TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD') >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.disp_id ) SELECT dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(lt.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(lt.loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(lt.total_trans_amount) AS grand_total_trans, AVG(lt.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT oa.account_id) AS accounts_with_orders, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.disp_id) AS clients_with_cards, SUM(ca.card_count) AS total_cards_issued, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lt.loan_amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oa.avg_order_amount) AS median_order_amount FROM district_metrics dm LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca_base ON dm.district_id = ca_base.account_district_id LEFT JOIN loan_transactions lt ON ca_base.account_id = lt.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca_base.account_id = oa.account_id LEFT JOIN card_analysis ca ON ca_base.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE dm.population > 364858 AND dm.salary > 18481.4 GROUP BY dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) > 60 AND SUM(oa.total_order_amount) > 969330.47 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_volume DESC LIMIT 59;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE amount > 18971) AND l.duration = (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = 53)) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 1042568 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'A') AS active_loans_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 857903 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = a.account_id AND l2.duration >= 94 ) AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 8451142 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 9509 ORDER BY loan_amount_rank, total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.gender, l.amount AS loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.amount > 15270) AS high_value_trans_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND l.status = 'A' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.gender, l.amount, a.account_id HAVING l.amount > 96781 ORDER BY high_value_trans_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, l.status, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, ROUND(AVG(a16) OVER (PARTITION BY l.status ORDER BY d.district_id), 2) AS moving_avg_crimes95, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 480396 AND l.duration >= 45 AND t.amount BETWEEN 21077 AND 80561 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, l.status, d.a16 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 312367 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 26 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, t.trans_id, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 29455 AND a.district_id = 7 ORDER BY a.account_id, t.date::DATE;

SELECT d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 835651 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' AND a.account_id IN (SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.balance > 150116) GROUP BY d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 94 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id) AND o.amount > 21106.36) AS large_orders_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank_by_region FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 1236 AND d.a10 < 61.1 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 25 AND SUM(l.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_active_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 59422 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_accounts DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 196885.74 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 105254 AND l.duration >= 19 GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 15 ORDER BY total_loans DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.balance) AS median_balance FROM district d INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id INNER JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 5239 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1990 AND l.duration >= 42 AND t.amount > 42859 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 474 AND AVG(t.amount) < 15974.16 ORDER BY total_clients DESC, active_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS inhabitants, d.a5 AS municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 AS municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 AS municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 AS municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 AS cities, d.a10 AS urban_ratio, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 AS entrepreneurs, d.a15 AS crimes_95, d.a16 AS crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT disp.disp_id) AS total_dispositions, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) FILTER (WHERE card.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) FILTER (WHERE card.type = 'classic') AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')) AS active_or_completed_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')) AS avg_active_or_completed_loan, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_withdrawal, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_credit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'LEASING') AS leasing_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'UVER') AS loan_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a11 DESC) AS avg_salary_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a12 DESC) AS unemployment_rate_95_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a13 DESC) AS unemployment_rate_96_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a16 DESC) AS crime_96_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a11 > 10179 AND d.a12 BETWEEN 0.21 AND 0.53 AND d.a13 BETWEEN 0.2 AND 0.18 AND d.a16 > 900 AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 44 AND SUM(l.amount) > 798175 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 9428 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loans DESC, d.a11 DESC LIMIT 2;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 AS region_code, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 479233 AND l.duration >= 40 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 32 AND t.type = 'CREDIT' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 757400 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) < 30 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, SUM(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS three_day_moving_sum, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS three_day_moving_avg FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 562675 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date, t.amount ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

WITH client_accounts AS ( SELECT d.disp_id, d.client_id, d.account_id, d.type AS disp_type, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.district_id AS account_district_id, a.frequency, a.date AS account_date FROM disp d INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' ), loan_transactions AS ( SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date AS loan_date, l.status, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM loan l LEFT JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 39981 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2002 GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS salary, d.a13 AS unemployment, d.a16 AS urban_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.client_id) AS total_clients FROM district d LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca ON d.district_id = ca.account_district_id WHERE d.a4 > 964652 AND d.a13 < 0.19 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13, d.a16 ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) AS unique_banks FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 95083.07 AND o.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE' GROUP BY o.account_id ), card_analysis AS ( SELECT c.disp_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count, MIN(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS first_issue_date, MAX(TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD')) AS last_issue_date FROM card c WHERE TO_DATE(c.issued, 'YYMMDD') >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.disp_id ) SELECT dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(lt.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(lt.loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(lt.total_trans_amount) AS grand_total_trans, AVG(lt.avg_balance) AS district_avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT oa.account_id) AS accounts_with_orders, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.disp_id) AS clients_with_cards, SUM(ca.card_count) AS total_cards_issued, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lt.loan_amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oa.avg_order_amount) AS median_order_amount FROM district_metrics dm LEFT JOIN client_accounts ca_base ON dm.district_id = ca_base.account_district_id LEFT JOIN loan_transactions lt ON ca_base.account_id = lt.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON ca_base.account_id = oa.account_id LEFT JOIN card_analysis ca ON ca_base.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE dm.population > 130863 AND dm.salary > 11705.3 GROUP BY dm.district_id, dm.population, dm.crime_rate, dm.salary, dm.unemployment, dm.urban_ratio, dm.total_accounts, dm.total_clients HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.loan_id) > 77 AND SUM(oa.total_order_amount) > 854080.83 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_volume DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance_after_trans, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, MAX(TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS latest_loan_date, MAX(TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS latest_trans_date FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 353334 OR l.amount IS NULL AND l.duration > 42 AND o.amount > 79601.43 AND t.amount > 558927 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 522 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 26 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(loan_counts.total_loans) AS avg_loans_per_account FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN ( SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans FROM loan l WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.account_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 4.03 ) loan_counts ON a.account_id = loan_counts.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 95473 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(sub.loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN ( SELECT l.account_id, l.amount AS loan_amount FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 910788 ) sub ON a.account_id = sub.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 65575 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) >= 14 ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 111754 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4742207 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.amount, AVG(t.amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date::DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE t.amount > 93037 AND t.date::DATE >= '1993-01-01'::DATE AND d.type = 'OWNER' ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date;

SELECT t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS trans_count_per_account, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS total_amount_per_account FROM trans t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = t.account_id AND l.amount > 387274 ) AND t.amount > 14980 GROUP BY t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.account_id ORDER BY total_amount_per_account DESC, trans_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.trans_id END) AS credit_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY a.account_id ), loan_metrics AS ( SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments FROM loan l WHERE l.date >= '930101' GROUP BY l.account_id ), district_aggregates AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) AS distinct_banks FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 31991.81 GROUP BY o.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) AS district_transaction_volume, SUM(lm.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_volume, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, AVG(as1.avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(lm.loan_count) AS total_loans, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_95, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes_95, CORR(as1.transaction_count, lm.total_loan_amount) AS trans_loan_correlation, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY as1.total_transaction_amount) AS median_trans_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_stats as1 ON a.account_id = as1.account_id LEFT JOIN loan_metrics lm ON a.account_id = lm.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON a.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 8996 AND d.a5 < 861458 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1998 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) > 9091508 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 366 AND AVG(as1.avg_balance) BETWEEN 7273 AND 471410 ORDER BY district_transaction_volume DESC, total_clients DESC LIMIT 99;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.amount > 24429.87) AS high_order_count, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.date >= '980101') AS recent_trans_sum, d.a10 AS district_unemploy_rate, d.a12 AS district_crime_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, (SELECT AVG(sub_t.amount) FROM trans sub_t WHERE sub_t.account_id = a.account_id AND sub_t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS avg_specific_trans_type_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS status_specific_loan_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM account a LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id LEFT JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.district_id IN (64, 32, 15) AND l.date >= '980101' AND cl.birth_date <= '700101' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, d.a10, d.a12 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 AND SUM(l.amount) BETWEEN 25053 AND 76797 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 101357.85 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.date::date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 47667 AND l.date::date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.date, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.client_id, c.gender, a.account_id, a.frequency, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date, MIN(CAST(a.date AS DATE)) AS account_open_date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)), MIN(CAST(a.date AS DATE)))) AS years_since_account_open_to_latest_loan, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank_in_district, SUM(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.gender) AS total_loan_amount_by_gender FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND l.status IN ('A', 'B') AND CAST(l.date AS DATE) BETWEEN (CAST(a.date AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3294 days') AND (CAST(a.date AS DATE) + INTERVAL '5587 days') AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(l.date AS DATE)) = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(l.date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 1997 AND 1996 AND l.amount > 486473 AND l.duration >= 46 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.client_id, c.gender, a.account_id, a.frequency, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 968 AND AVG(t.balance) < 102182 ORDER BY total_loan_amount_by_gender DESC, loan_amount_rank_in_district;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS no_of_inhabitants, d.a5 AS no_of_municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 AS no_of_municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 AS no_of_municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 AS no_of_municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 AS no_of_cities, d.a10 AS ratio_urban_inhabitants, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 AS no_of_entrepreneurs_per_1000, d.a15 AS no_of_crimes_95, d.a16 AS no_of_crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_or_completed_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.account_id) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.amount > 516818 AND t2.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t2.account_id IN (SELECT a2.account_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id)) AS high_value_transaction_accounts FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a11 > 48775 AND d.a12 < 0.03 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 132 AND SUM(l.amount) > 6971191 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 681002 AND l.duration >= 24 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 12889 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) DESC) AS loan_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 1836 AND l.amount > 213994 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_expenditure, (SELECT AVG(sub.amount) FROM trans sub WHERE sub.account = a.account_id AND sub.date >= '970101' AND sub.type = 'VYDAJ') AS avg_recent_expenditure FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 880310 AND dp.type = 'OWNER' AND t.date >= '970101' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 31 ORDER BY total_expenditure DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS inhabitants, d.a5 AS municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 AS municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 AS municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 AS municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 AS cities, d.a10 AS urban_ratio, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 AS entrepreneurs, d.a15 AS crimes_95, d.a16 AS SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, AVG(d.a11) AS district_avg_salary, AVG(d.a10) AS END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank_in_district, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC) AS order_amount_rank, LAG(SUM(t.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.date) AS prev_trans_amount, LEAD(SUM(t.amount), 1) OVER SUM(o.amount)) AS order_amount_cume_dist FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 528156 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 63004.94 AND t.amount > 610914 AND (d.a3 LIKE 'north' OR d.a2 LIKE 'Hl.m.') AND (t.type LIKE 'VYDAJ' OR t.operation LIKE 'VYBER') AND (l.status LIKE 'A' OR cr.type LIKE 'classic') AND (o.k_symbol LIKE 'POJISTNE' OR t.k_symbol LIKE 'POJISTNE') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.account_id, a.frequency, a.date, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.date, l.status, o.order_id, o.account_to, o.amount, o.bank_to, o.k_symbol, cr.card_id, cr.type, cr.issued, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.date, t.type, t.operation, t.k_symbol, t.bank HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 178595 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 92 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC, total_trans_amount DESC LIMIT 569;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, DATE(l.date) AS loan_date, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY DATE(l.date) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_loan_amount, COUNT(l.loan_id) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY DATE(l.date) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loans FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 83423 AND DATE(l.date) >= DATE('1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, l.date ORDER BY d.district_id, loan_date;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 202091 AND l.duration >= 27 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 59775 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 273099 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM loan l JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 29925 AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4 AS district_population, d.a10 AS avg_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, MAX(CAST(l.date AS DATE)) AS latest_loan_date FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 114877 AND d.a4 > 168606 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, c.client_id, d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10 HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 777502 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC LIMIT 45;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS client_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' AND l.date >= '930101' AND o.amount >= 50474.48 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), district_metrics AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS population, d.a10 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate, d.a13 AS entrepreneurs_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')))) AS avg_client_age FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 >= 118907 AND d.a10 <= 4.43 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a4, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13 ), ranked_accounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.transaction_count, a.total_transaction_amount, a.avg_balance, a.loan_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS transaction_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.loan_count DESC) AS loan_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.order_count DESC) AS order_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.avg_balance) AS balance_percentile, LAG(a.total_transaction_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.total_transaction_amount DESC) AS prev_transaction_amount, LEAD(a.loan_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY a.loan_count DESC) AS next_loan_count, SUM(a.total_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_total_transactions, AVG(a.avg_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS district_avg_balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id) AS accounts_in_district FROM account_stats a JOIN district_metrics d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.transaction_count >= 991
