(avg_balance - district_avg_balance) AS balance_deviation FROM ranked_accounts WHERE transaction_rank <= 31 AND balance_percentile >= 0.57 ORDER BY district_id, transaction_rank;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, t.date, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE t.amount > 49031 AND l.amount > 416638 AND di.a4 > 1919 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, t.date, t.amount, t.balance, t.account HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 767831 ORDER BY a.account_id, t.date;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 75295 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id UNION ALL SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 912841 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id ORDER BY account_id, district_id;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_duration FROM account a INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 788199 OR l.amount IS NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a4 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 10 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT a.account_id FROM account a WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id)) AS total_loans FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 >= 77432 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 268 ORDER BY total_clients DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 302863 AND t.amount > 387677 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 39 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id, c.gender ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 618977 AND t.amount > 46727 AND o.amount > 14437.57 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 2451882 AND SUM(t.amount) > 1618721 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 61 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

WITH account_stats AS ( SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.trans_id END) AS credit_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.date >= '930101' GROUP BY a.account_id ), loan_metrics AS ( SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments FROM loan l WHERE l.date >= '930101' GROUP BY l.account_id ), district_aggregates AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id ), order_analysis AS ( SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.bank_to) AS distinct_banks FROM order1 o WHERE o.amount > 51899.55 GROUP BY o.account_id ) SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) AS district_transaction_volume, SUM(lm.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_volume, SUM(oa.total_order_amount) AS district_order_volume, AVG(as1.avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(lm.loan_count) AS total_loans, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_95, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes_95, CORR(as1.transaction_count, lm.total_loan_amount) AS trans_loan_correlation, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY as1.total_transaction_amount) AS median_trans_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN account_stats as1 ON a.account_id = as1.account_id LEFT JOIN loan_metrics lm ON a.account_id = lm.account_id LEFT JOIN order_analysis oa ON a.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 663 AND d.a5 < 907224 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 1998 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(as1.total_transaction_amount) > 7454254 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) >= 333 AND AVG(as1.avg_balance) BETWEEN 1747 AND 412093 ORDER BY district_transaction_volume DESC, total_clients DESC LIMIT 42;

WITH ranked_transactions AS ( SELECT t.account_id, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.date, t.k_symbol, t.type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.amount DESC) as trans_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) as trans_count, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) as total_trans_amount FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 613314 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 168577 AND l.duration >= 46 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a10 DESC) as district_wealth_rank FROM district d WHERE d.a10 > 28879.41 AND d.a4 >= 77776 ), client_account_join AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.birth_date, a.account_id, a.frequency, d.disp_id, d.type as disp_type, cd.card_id, cd.type as card_type, o.order_id, o.amount as order_amount, o.k_symbol as order_symbol FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE CAST(c.birth_date AS DATE) <= '1930-01-01' AND o.amount > 10103.2 ) SELECT caj.client_id, caj.account_id, caj.district_id, rt.trans_rank, rt.trans_count, rt.total_trans_amount, la.loan_amount, la.loan_rank, la.status as loan_status, ds.district_wealth_rank, ds.a10 as district_avg_salary, ds.a12 as district_unemployment_rate, ds.a13 as district_crime_rate, caj.order_amount, caj.card_type, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rt.total_trans_amount DESC, la.loan_amount DESC) as overall_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rt.total_trans_amount) as trans_amount_percentile FROM client_account_join caj JOIN ranked_transactions rt ON caj.account_id = rt.account_id AND rt.trans_rank <= 8 JOIN loan_analysis la ON caj.account_id = la.account_id AND la.loan_rank = 1 JOIN district_stats ds ON caj.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE rt.trans_count > 70 AND la.loan_amount > 943093 GROUP BY caj.client_id, caj.account_id, caj.district_id, rt.trans_rank, rt.trans_count, rt.total_trans_amount, la.loan_amount, la.loan_rank, la.status, ds.district_wealth_rank, ds.a10, ds.a12, ds.a13, caj.order_amount, caj.card_type HAVING AVG(rt.amount) > 14358 AND MAX(la.payments) >= 5271.23 ORDER BY overall_rank, trans_amount_percentile DESC;

SELECT a1.account_id AS account_id_1, a2.account_id AS account_id_2, a1.district_id AS district_id_1, a2.district_id AS district_id_2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) AS loans_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) AS loans_count_2, SUM(DISTINCT l1.amount) AS total_loan_amount_1, SUM(DISTINCT l2.amount) AS total_loan_amount_2, AVG(DISTINCT l1.payments) AS avg_payment_1, AVG(DISTINCT l2.payments) AS avg_payment_2 FROM account a1 JOIN account a2 ON a1.district_id = a2.district_id AND a1.account_id < a2.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN district d ON a1.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id WHERE l1.amount > 3314 AND l2.amount > 99231 AND d.a4 > 1464 GROUP BY a1.account_id, a2.account_id, a1.district_id, a2.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_loan_amount_1 DESC, total_loan_amount_2 DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_expired_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_running_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS credit_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'junior' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS junior_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_amount_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 781641 AND t.amount > 83043 AND o.amount > 37845.64 AND d.a16 > 14016 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 4734419 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 97 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 41;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, SUM(t.balance) AS total_balance, MAX(t.date) AS latest_trans_date, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) DESC) AS client_count_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 4232.41 AND l.amount >= 168251 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3 HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 3793295 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 343 AND AVG(t.amount) > 6123 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, client_count DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS distinct_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_orders, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 294965 AND t.amount > 86224 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 26 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

WITH district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, SUM(d.a12) AS total_crimes FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.a4 > 1421 AND d.a5 < 6716 GROUP BY d.district_id ), account_metrics AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM account a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date <= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id ), client_financials AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.disp_id) AS disposition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE cd.issued >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 22412.04 GROUP BY c.client_id, c.district_id ) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes, COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(am.transaction_count) AS district_transactions, AVG(am.total_transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(am.total_loan_amount) AS district_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.client_id) AS active_clients, SUM(cf.total_order_amount) AS total_order_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(am.total_transaction_amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.avg_unemployment_rate) AS unemployment_percentile FROM district_stats ds JOIN account_metrics am ON ds.district_id = am.district_id JOIN client_financials cf ON ds.district_id = cf.district_id WHERE am.total_transaction_amount > 187281 AND cf.total_order_amount < 317562.27 GROUP BY ds.district_id, ds.total_clients, ds.avg_unemployment_rate, ds.total_crimes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT am.account_id) > 82 AND AVG(am.avg_balance) < 999863 ORDER BY district_transactions DESC, district_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 85;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, MAX(o1.amount) AS max_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.a4 > 7709 AND l.duration >= 13 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount > 21219.12 AND l.status = 'A' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 199890.55 AND SUM(t.amount) < 4283378 INTERSECT SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, MAX(o1.amount) AS max_order_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a.account_id = o1.account_id WHERE d.a4 <= 9523 AND l.duration < 45 AND t.date < '1993-01-01' AND o1.amount <= 18780.68 AND l.status IN ('B', 'C') AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) <= 224728.6 AND SUM(t.amount) >= 8764679 ORDER BY client_count DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS account_year, c.gender, card.type AS card_type, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_debt_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_debt_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, MAX(TO_DATE(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_transaction_date, MAX(TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_loan_date FROM account a JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card ON dsp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('1993-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.a4 >= 375341 AND d.a5 >= 827196 AND t.amount >= 462642 AND l.amount >= 660743 AND o.amount >= 167839.05 GROUP BY d.a2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), c.gender, card.type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 863 AND SUM(l.amount) > 2118789 AND SUM(t.amount) > 3929158 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 3245 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 2016 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_transaction_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.amount > 284908 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) > 52 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(CAST(c.issued AS DATE)) AS latest_card_issued, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS transaction_rank, LAG(SUM(t.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.district_id) AS prev_district_total_transaction FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount > 207973.59 AND t.amount BETWEEN 77616 AND 370343 AND d.a10 > 98.9 AND cl.birth_date < '1910-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 694 AND SUM(t.amount) > 2306210 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, district_id, account_id;

SELECT district.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(loan.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(trans.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, MAX(trans.balance) AS max_balance, MIN(loan.payments) AS min_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN disp.type = 'OWNER' THEN client.client_id END) AS owner_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(loan.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)) AS account_percentile, LAG(SUM(loan.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY district.a2) AS prev_district_loan_total FROM district JOIN account ON district.district_id = account.district_id JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id JOIN order1 ON account.account_id = order1.account_id JOIN trans trans2 ON trans.account_id = trans2.account AND trans.trans_id < trans2.trans_id WHERE loan.amount > 472711 AND loan.duration >= 39 AND trans.date >= '1993-01-01' AND client.birth_date <= '1950-01-01' AND district.a10 > 68.86 AND order1.amount > 20402.74 GROUP BY district.a2, district.district_id, client.district_id HAVING SUM(loan.amount) > 1895165 AND COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) >= 265 AND AVG(trans.amount) < 20661 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, district_name LIMIT 66;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 91113 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 47 ORDER BY client_count DESC;

SELECT l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS avg_balance_per_account, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) AS count_prijem_trans, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, MAX(o.amount) AS max_order_amount, MIN(di.a10) AS min_district_unemployment_rate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.gender, ', ') AS client_genders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_trans_count, CORR(CAST(t.amount AS numeric), CAST(t.balance AS numeric)) AS amount_balance_correlation FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 24956 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a10 > 2.25 AND a.date <= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount < 45092.33 GROUP BY l.loan_id, a.account_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id, di.district_id, t.amount, t.date, t.account_id, t.balance, t.type, t.trans_id, o.amount, l.amount HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 819290 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 100 ORDER BY cumulative_trans_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, c.client_id, cd.card_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_loan_amount_running, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, MIN(t.balance) AS min_trans_balance, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS trans_rank FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE l.amount > 45811 AND t.amount > 380090 AND d.a10 > 112.24 GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, c.client_id, cd.card_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, l.date HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 17829 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) < 95 ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, avg_loan_amount_running ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) >= 2012 AND l.amount >= 165158 AND t.amount >= 872447 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'))), (d.district_id, d.a2, c.gender), (d.district_id, d.a2), (c.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD'))), () ) ORDER BY d.district_id, c.gender, birth_year;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 34190 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 126386 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC;

SELECT a1.account_id AS acct1, a2.account_id AS acct2, d1.a2 AS district1, d2.a2 AS district2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) AS loans_acct1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) AS loans_acct2, SUM(t1.amount) AS trans_total_acct1, SUM(t2.amount) AS trans_total_acct2, AVG(o1.amount) AS avg_order_amount, AVG(d1.a10) AS avg_crime_rate_dist1, AVG(d2.a10) AS avg_crime_rate_dist2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount) DESC) AS combined_trans_rank FROM account a1 JOIN account a2 ON a1.district_id = a2.district_id AND a1.account_id < a2.account_id JOIN district d1 ON a1.district_id = d1.district_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id JOIN loan l1 ON a1.account_id = l1.account_id JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN trans t1 ON a1.account_id = t1.account_id JOIN trans t2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN order1 o1 ON a1.account_id = o1.account_id JOIN order1 o2 ON a2.account_id = o2.account_id JOIN disp dp1 ON a1.account_id = dp1.account_id JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id JOIN client c1 ON dp1.client_id = c1.client_id JOIN client c2 ON dp2.client_id = c2.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd1 ON dp1.disp_id = cd1.disp_id LEFT JOIN card cd2 ON dp2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id WHERE l1.amount > 442882 AND l2.amount > 176002 AND t1.date >= '970101' AND t2.date >= '970101' AND o1.amount > 17589.54 AND d1.a10 > 155.92 AND d2.a10 > 160.11 GROUP BY a1.account_id, a2.account_id, d1.a2, d2.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.loan_id) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.loan_id) > 1 AND SUM(t1.amount) + SUM(t2.amount) > 7583288 ORDER BY combined_trans_rank ASC, loans_acct1 DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount_per_district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 51661 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, l.amount ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 83334 AND l.duration > 49 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 5 INTERSECT SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 456 AND t.balance < 76462 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) <= 853 ORDER BY account_id;

SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 40753 AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.account_id IN (SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 95639 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY c.client_id HAVING SUM(l.amount) > 282183 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, a.date AS account_open_date, c.client_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYMMDD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS loan_amount_rank_in_district, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id)) AS transaction_count_percentile, LAG(SUM(l.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD')) AS prev_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.amount > 786839 AND TO_DATE(l.date, 'YYMMDD') >= '1993-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.date, 'YYMMDD') <= '1993-01-01' AND t.amount < -421079 GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, a.account_id, a.date, c.client_id, c.birth_date, l.date HAVING AVG(t.balance) > 441574 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 583 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, c.client_id, c.gender, dp.type AS disp_type, COALESCE(cd.type, 'No Card') AS card_type, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 AND SUM(l.amount) > 178805 THEN 'High Loan Account' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 0 AND SUM(o.amount) > 57942.76 THEN 'High Order Account' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 0 AND SUM(t.amount) > 127869 THEN 'High Trans Account' ELSE 'Standard Account' END AS account_category, CASE WHEN d.a10 > 0.57 THEN 'High Urban Ratio' WHEN d.a11 > 15636 THEN 'High Avg Salary' WHEN d.a12 > 0.05 THEN 'High Unemployment Rate' ELSE 'Normal District' END AS district_category, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_bad_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol IN ('POJISTNE', 'SIPO', 'LEASING', 'UVER') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_standing_orders FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND c.birth_date <= '1970-01-01' AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, c.client_id, c.gender, dp.type, cd.type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) >= 4 OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2 OR COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) >= 43 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_order_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_trans_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, MAX(l.duration) AS max_loan_duration, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.type = 'junior' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS junior_cards, d.a10 AS urban_unemploy_rate, d.a11 AS crime_rate, d.a12 AS avg_salary, d.a13 AS enterpreneurs_per_1000, d.a14 AS cities_population, d.a15 AS num_municipalities_lt_499, d.a16 AS num_municipalities_500_1999, d.a4 AS num_cities, d.a5 AS num_urban_inhabitants, d.a6 AS avg_urban_inhabitants, d.a7 AS district_surface, d.a8 AS num_urban_inhabitants_ratio, d.a9 AS avg_age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC) AS account_count_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a12 DESC) AS avg_salary_rank FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE ( (d.a10 > 11.94 AND d.a11 < 438) OR (d.a12 BETWEEN 21531.19 AND 16702.6 AND d.a13 > 66.75) OR (d.a14 > 1580907 AND d.a9 < 28.09) ) AND NOT ( d.a15 < 25 AND d.a16 > 26 ) AND ( l.amount IS NULL OR l.amount > 961958 ) AND ( t.amount IS NULL OR (t.amount > 933817 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01') ) AND ( o.amount IS NULL OR o.amount BETWEEN 92346.39 AND 60498.55 ) AND ( cd.type IS NULL OR cd.type IN ('classic', 'gold', 'junior') ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 2825 AND SUM(l.amount) > 1409875 AND (AVG(t.balance) < 367928 OR SUM(t.amount) > 35375814) ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC, total_accounts DESC, avg_salary DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4 AS inhabitants, d.a5 AS municipalities_lt_499, d.a6 AS municipalities_500_1999, d.a7 AS municipalities_2000_9999, d.a8 AS municipalities_gt_10000, d.a9 AS cities, d.a10 AS urban_ratio, d.a11 AS avg_salary, d.a12 AS unemployment_rate_95, d.a13 AS unemployment_rate_96, d.a14 AS entrepreneurs, d.a15 AS crimes_95, d.a16 AS crimes_96, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT disp.disp_id) AS total_dispositions, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) FILTER (WHERE card.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) FILTER (WHERE card.type = 'classic') AS classic_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')) AS active_or_completed_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')) AS avg_active_or_completed_loan, SUM(l.payments) AS total_loan_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_withdrawal, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_credit, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'POJISTNE') AS insurance_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'LEASING') AS leasing_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'UVER') AS loan_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_count_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a11 DESC) AS avg_salary_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a12 DESC) AS unemployment_rate_95_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a13 DESC) AS unemployment_rate_96_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a16 DESC) AS crime_96_rank FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a11 > 14123 AND d.a12 BETWEEN 0.5 AND 0.46 AND d.a13 BETWEEN 0.27 AND 0.34 AND d.a16 > 740 AND (l.date IS NULL OR l.date >= '1993-01-01') AND (t.date IS NULL OR t.date >= '1993-01-01') GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a7, d.a8, d.a9, d.a10, d.a11, d.a12, d.a13, d.a14, d.a15, d.a16 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 149 AND SUM(l.amount) > 55030 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 2489 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loans DESC, d.a11 DESC LIMIT 41;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS total_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_account_balance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS district_transaction_rank FROM district d INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND o.amount >= 85537.72 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 20 AND SUM(t.amount) > 8922398 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, district_transaction_rank ASC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.amount > 330661 AND l.duration >= 42 AND a.account_id IN ( SELECT t.account_id FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 23005 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING AVG(l.amount) > 408757 ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, AVG(CASE WHEN d.type = 'OWNER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS owner_ratio, (SELECT MAX(o.amount) FROM order1 o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id) AS max_order_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 359268.77 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(t.amount) BETWEEN 91008.97 AND 848640.27 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS transaction_volume_category FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND di.a10 > 85.18 AND (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('A', 'B')) GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id HAVING COUNT(t.trans_id) > 94 AND SUM(t.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_trans_amount DESC, a.district_id;

WITH ranked_transactions AS ( SELECT t.account_id, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.date, t.k_symbol, t.type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.amount DESC) as trans_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) as trans_count, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id) as total_trans_amount FROM trans t WHERE t.amount > 819499 AND CAST(t.date AS DATE) >= '1993-01-01' ), loan_analysis AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount as loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) as loan_rank FROM loan l WHERE l.amount > 342340 AND l.duration >= 24 ), district_stats AS ( SELECT d.district_id, d.a4, d.a5, d.a6, d.a10, d.a12, d.a13, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.a10 DESC) as district_wealth_rank FROM district d WHERE d.a10 > 12360.75 AND d.a4 >= 181808 ), client_account_join AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.birth_date, a.account_id, a.frequency, d.disp_id, d.type as disp_type, cd.card_id, cd.type as card_type, o.order_id, o.amount as order_amount, o.k_symbol as order_symbol FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE CAST(c.birth_date AS DATE) <= '1930-01-01' AND o.amount > 63056.27 ) SELECT caj.client_id, caj.account_id, caj.district_id, rt.trans_rank, rt.trans_count, rt.total_trans_amount, la.loan_amount, la.loan_rank, la.status as loan_status, ds.district_wealth_rank, ds.a10 as district_avg_salary, ds.a12 as district_unemployment_rate, ds.a13 as district_crime_rate, caj.order_amount, caj.card_type, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rt.total_trans_amount DESC, la.loan_amount DESC) as overall_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rt.total_trans_amount) as trans_amount_percentile FROM client_account_join caj JOIN ranked_transactions rt ON caj.account_id = rt.account_id AND rt.trans_rank <= 2 JOIN loan_analysis la ON caj.account_id = la.account_id AND la.loan_rank = 1 JOIN district_stats ds ON caj.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE rt.trans_count > 80 AND la.loan_amount > 162965 GROUP BY caj.client_id, caj.account_id, caj.district_id, rt.trans_rank, rt.trans_count, rt.total_trans_amount, la.loan_amount, la.loan_rank, la.status, ds.district_wealth_rank, ds.a10, ds.a12, ds.a13, caj.order_amount, caj.card_type HAVING AVG(rt.amount) > 37678 AND MAX(la.payments) >= 9920.44 ORDER BY overall_rank, trans_amount_percentile DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE t.amount > 5468 AND l.amount > 243958 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND d.a4 > 52322 GROUP BY d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 751373 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 31 AND AVG(l.amount) > 234224 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, amount_rank;

SELECT d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, o.order_id, cd.card_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(d.a16) AS max_district_unemployment, MIN(d.a15) AS min_district_crime_rate, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_district_salary, SUM(d.a12) AS total_district_entrants, SUM(d.a13) AS total_district_municipalities FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE l.amount > 938262 AND t.amount > 76958 AND o.amount > 353798.49 AND d.a16 > 113 AND d.a15 < 1558 AND d.a10 > 32510.15 AND d.a12 > 9009.33 AND d.a13 > 3634.77 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id, l.loan_id, t.trans_id, o.order_id, cd.card_id), (d.district_id, c.client_id, a.account_id), (d.district_id, c.client_id), (d.district_id), () ) HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 866365 AND SUM(l.amount) > 2688283 AND SUM(o.amount) > 1931498.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC, total_loan_amount DESC, total_order_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS distinct_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS distinct_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS distinct_loans, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 528355 AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) > 376 ORDER BY distinct_clients DESC, total_trans_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS distinct_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS distinct_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS distinct_cards, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS distinct_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS distinct_transactions, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(d.a10) AS avg_unemployment_rate, AVG(d.a13) AS avg_entrepreneurs_rate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.amount) AS median_loan_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS median_transaction_amount FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN order1 o ON a.account_id = o.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.a4 > 76248 AND d.a5 < 20502 AND a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND l.date >= '1993-01-01' AND t.date >= '1993-01-01' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 64 AND SUM(l.amount) > 105943 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, a.frequency, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, cl.type AS card_type, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration AS loan_duration, l.payments AS loan_payments, l.status AS loan_status, t.trans_id, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance AS trans_balance, t.type AS trans_type, t.k_symbol AS trans_k_symbol, o.order_id, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol AS order_k_symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_trans_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY
